scope.primary_schema: NASA ATMONTO remains the project schema constraint.
scope.airm_o_role: AIRM-O supplies an external ATM interoperability vocabulary and domain/range reference for mapping audits.
scope.alignment_role: ATMONTO2AIRM cells seed profile coverage and extension-gap analysis; they are not ABox facts.

license_or_access_note: AIRM-O README declares the ontology under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; alignment files are used as public reference artifacts.

ACDMIrregularity.comment: An irregularity which normally requires one or more partners to make a manual intervention to resolve the irregularity.

ADSBGroundStation.comment: A ground station that may automatically transmit and/or receive ADS-B data such as identification, position and additional data, as appropriate, in a broadcast mode via a data link.

ADSBGroundStationService.comment: Service for an ADS-B Ground Station

ADSBGroundStationServiceConfiguration.comment: Information concerning the configuration of an ADS-B Ground Station service.

ADSBGroundStationStatus.comment: Information concerning the status of an ADS-B Ground Station.

ATCBlindSpot.comment: A location on an aerodrome movement area that is not visible to ATC personnel due to obstructions and is not designated as a Hot Spot.

ATCClearance.comment: Authorization for an aircraft to proceed under conditions specified by an air traffic control unit.

ATFMBehaviour.comment: The behaviour of the flight when concerned by ATFM Measures.

ATFMDepartureSlot.comment: A calculated take-off time attributed by the central unit for ATFM with a time tolerance managed by the local ATS unit.

ATFMDepartureSlotImprovementProposal.comment: ATFM Slot amendment proposal in which a new Calculated Take-Off Time (CTOT) is provided which improves the original slot.

ATFMHotspot.comment: A time period on a traffic volume indicating that there is too much traffic according to occupancy counts or complexity analysis for a specific occupancy traffic count duration.

ATFMMeasure.comment: The actions taken to perform air traffic flow management and capacity management.

ATFMRegulation.comment: An ATFCM measure implemented by means of a departure slot in order to balance traffic demand against available ATC capacity.

ATFMRegulationSlot.comment: A slot within a regulation defined according to the regulation rate and period.

ActiveRunwayConfiguration.comment: The Runway Configuration that is currently used for flight operations in and out of the airport.

AerialRefuelling.comment: A procedure used by the military to transfer fuel from one aircraft to another during flight.

AerialRefuellingAnchor.comment: A prescribed pattern, established by air refuelling points, along which air-to-air refuelling of aircraft is performed.

AerialRefuellingTrack.comment: A sequence of points that define the trajectory to be flown during an aerial refuelling operation.

Aerodrome.comment: A defined area on land or water (including any buildings, installations and equipment) intended to be used either wholly or in part for the arrival, departure and surface movement of aircraft.

AerodromeAvailability.comment: Information about the operational status of the aerodrome.

AerodromeCollocation.comment: The sharing by two aerodromes of some or all of their ground facilities.

AerodromeCondition.comment: Weather observations and or forecast for an aerodrome

AerodromeContamination.comment: The presence or removal of hazardous conditions due to snow, ice, slush, water, etc. on aerodrome surfaces.

AerodromeHotSpot.comment: A location on an aerodrome movement area with a history or potential risk of collision or runway incursion, and where heightened attention by pilots/drivers is necessary.

AerodromeProtectionArea.comment: An area situated in the vicinity of a runway, Final Approach and Take-Off Area (FATO) or Touchdown and Liftoff Area (TLOF), provided to protect aircraft during manoeuvring, take-off and/or landing operations.

AerodromeProtectionAreaMarking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed on the edge of the landing protection area at an aerodrome.

AerodromeResponsibilityOrganisation.comment: The role of the organisation which is responsible for the aerodrome.

AerodromeSet.comment: Set of aerodromes used in the scope of Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management (ATFCM).

AerodromeSign.comment: A sign presenting messages related to aircraft and vehicle movement.

AerodromeSurfaceRoutingNetwork.comment: A connected and directed graph defined by Node and Edge features that represents logical and physical connections between taxiways, runways and other features related to the movement area of an aerodrome.

AerodromeSurfaceRoutingNetworkEdge.comment: A directional or bi-directional connection between nodes having an attached geometry which can be used for a graphical depiction of the taxi route.

AerodromeSurfaceRoutingNetworkNode.comment: Representation of the intersection of two or more aerodrome features related to taxi operations, or other special location such as holding position or entry or exit to a parking area.

AerodromeUsage.comment: A rule governing the functions that may be performed on an aerodrome.

AeronauticalGroundLight.comment: A light specifically provided as an aid to air navigation, with the exception of obstacle lights and lights forming part of surface or approach lighting systems

AeroplaneConfiguration.comment: A particular combination of the positions of the moveable elements, such as wing flaps and landing gear, etc. that affect the aerodynamic characteristics of the aeroplane.

AerospaceManufacturer.comment: A company or individual involved in the various aspects of designing, building, testing, selling, and maintaining Aircraft, aircraft parts, missiles, rockets, and/or spacecraft.

AirTrafficControlService.comment: A service provided for the purpose of: a) preventing collisions: 1. between aircraft, and 2. on the manoeuvring area between aircraft and obstructions; and b) expediting and maintaining an orderly flow of air traffic.

AirTrafficManagementService.comment: The provision of flight planning and flow management operations.

Aircraft.comment: Any machine that can derive support in the atmosphere from the reactions of the air other than the reactions of the air against the earth's surface.

AircraftAcceleration.comment: The acceleration of the aircraft at a given point of the trajectory.

AircraftAltitude.comment: The altitude of the aircraft at a given point of the trajectory.

AircraftAvionics.comment: Any electronic device - including its electrical part - for use in an aircraft, including radio, automatic flight control and instrument systems.

AircraftCapability.comment: The ability of an aircraft or an aircraft equipment to provide a service or perform a function that, either on its own or with other services or functions, can deliver a definable level of performance. This level of performance is measurable within a framework of performance indicators and safety requirements.

AircraftCategory.comment: The aircraft categorization according to a set of criteria.

AircraftColourAndMarking.comment: The colours of the aircraft and a description of the aircraft's significant markings.

AircraftConfiguration.comment: An arrangement of one or more aircraft equipments in a particular form, figure, or combination.

AircraftDimensions.comment: The measurable extent of an aircraft.

AircraftDirection.comment: The direction of the aircraft at a given point of the trajectory.

AircraftEquipment.comment: Articles, including first-aid and survival equipment and commissary supplies, but not spare parts or stores, for use on board an aircraft during flight.

AircraftGroundService.comment: The availability of maintenance, support and/or supply operations to aircraft at an aerodrome.

AircraftIdentification.comment: A group of letters, figures or a combination thereof which is either identical to, or the coded equivalent of, the aircraft call sign to be used in air-ground communications, and which is used to identify the aircraft in ground-ground air traffic services communications.

AircraftMakeModelSeries.comment: Aircraft model, make and series information as provided by the manufacturer.

AircraftOperator.comment: A person, organization or enterprise engaged in or offering to engage in an aircraft operation.

AircraftPerformance.comment: The performance delivered by an aircraft.

AircraftSpeed.comment: The speed of the aircraft at a given point of the trajectory.

AircraftStand.comment: A designated area on an apron intended to be used for parking an aircraft.

AircraftStandConfiguration.comment: Configuration of aircraft stands available for use in a given airport operational mode.

AircraftStandContamination.comment: The presence or removal of hazardous conditions due to snow, ice, slush, water, etc. at an Aircraft Stand.

AircraftState.comment: A vector describing the current state of an aircraft or a vehicle, e.g. position, speed, acceleration.

AirframeEquipment.comment: An individual component of the body of an aircraft as distinct from its engine.

AirportClearanceService.comment: An airport ground service providing clearance capabilities for airport surfaces.

AirportGroundService.comment: Services that provide maintenance of the airport infrastructure and direct support to aircraft on the ground.

AirportSlot.comment: The scheduled time of arrival or departure available for allocation by, or as allocated by, a coordinator for an aircraft movement on a specific date at a coordinated airport. For scheduling purposes, the slot is the scheduled time of arrival or departure at the terminal, not the time of landing or take-off from the runway. An allocated slot will take account of all the coordination parameters at the airport e.g. runway(s), taxiways, aircraft parking stands, gates, terminal capacity (e.g. check-in and baggage delivery), environmental constraints e.g. night restrictions etc.

AirportSuppliesService.comment: A service that provides supplies (fuel, oil, oxygen, etc.) to aircraft.

AirportTransitView.comment: The path and operations linked to an aircraft during its "visit" to the airport. It starts at the Initial approach fix (STAR) and includes the taxi-in segment, the turn round processes from the airspace user, the taxi-out segment and ends with the handover to the TMA departure controller at the SID.

Airspace.comment: A defined three dimensional region of space relevant to air traffic.

AirspaceActivation.comment: Information about the operational status of the airspace.

AirspaceCondition.comment: Weather-related observations and forecasts of relevance to an airspace.

AirspaceEntry.comment: The event of entering an airspace.

AirspaceExit.comment: The event of exiting an airspace.

AirspaceGeometryComponent.comment: The role of the component in the airspace geometry.

AirspaceLayer.comment: The portion of airspace between two specified vertical levels.

AirspaceLayerClass.comment: The airspace class for a portion of airspace between two specified vertical levels.

AirspaceReservation.comment: The procedure through which a volume is temporary reserved for an activity.

AirspaceVolume.comment: A defined volume in the air, described as horizontal projection with vertical limits.

AirspaceVolumeDependency.comment: The relationship between the geometry of an airspace volume and the geometry of another parent airspace.

Alert.comment: Indication of an actual or potential hazardous situation that requires particular attention or action.

AltimeterSource.comment: An instrument which measures vertical distance with respect to a reference level.

AltimeterSourceStatus.comment: The operational status of an altimeter source.

AltitudeAdjustment.comment: Operational factors applied to obstacle clearance altitudes to produce the safest usable altitude.

AltitudeRangeType.comment: The area of variation of an altitude between upper and lower limits.

AngleIndication.comment: An angular reference from a significant point.

AngleRangeType.comment: The area of variation of an angle between upper and lower limits.

AngleUse.comment: The role of the angle indication in the point reference.

ApproachAltitudeTable.comment: Altitude not defined by a segment that is to be depicted on the profile view, such as the height above touchdown for ILS CAT II approaches.

ApproachCondition.comment: The final approach condition that must be met to use the set of minima.

ApproachDistanceTable.comment: Distance not defined by a segment that is to be depicted on the profile view, such as the height above touchdown for ILS CAT II approaches.

ApproachLeg.comment: A portion of a terminal approach procedure as defined by two consecutive significant points.

ApproachLightingSystem.comment: An airport lighting facility which provides visual guidance to landing aircraft by radiating light beams in a directional pattern by which the pilot aligns the aircraft with the final approach path for landing.

ApproachTimingTable.comment: Table of timings usually between final approach fix and the missed approach point.

Apron.comment: A defined area, on a land aerodrome/heliport, intended to accommodate aircraft/helicopters for purposes of loading and unloading passengers, mail or cargo, and for fuelling, parking or maintenance.

ApronAreaAvailability.comment: Information about the operational status of an element situated in an aerodrome apron area.

ApronAreaUsage.comment: A rule governing the usage of an element situated in the apron area.

ApronContamination.comment: The presence or removal of hazardous conditions due to snow, ice, slush, water, etc. on the Apron surface.

ApronElement.comment: A part of a defined apron area.

ApronLightSystem.comment: The lighting system provided for illuminating apron areas of an aerodrome.

ApronMarking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed on the surface of an apron of an aerodrome.

ArrestingGear.comment: A series of devices (for example: engaging or catching devices and energy absorption devices) that are used to stop an aircraft by absorbing its momentum in a routine landing, emergency landing or aborted take-off.

ArrivalAirspaceEntry.comment: The event of entering an arrival management airspace.

ArrivalFeederLeg.comment: A segment leg designed in accordance with the rules for arrival feeder segments.

ArrivalLeg.comment: A portion of an arrival procedure (STAR) as defined by two consecutive significant points.

ArrivalManagementAdvisory.comment: An arrival management advisory to a flight to achieve its landing at the AMAN Planned Threshold Time (APTT).

ArrivalManagementHorizon.comment: A geometrical distance, flight time or set of airspace segment or points related to a Significant Point and used to define the geographical scope of an AMAN operation.

ArrivalOperations.comment: The set of flight operations following procedures associated with the destination aerodrome.

ArrivalPair.comment: Identifier of the lead and the following aircraft for a pair in the arrival sequence.

AtNode.comment: The event of arriving at an aerodrome surface routing network node.

AuthorityForAerialRefuelling.comment: The type of authority that the organisation has over the aerial refuelling route.

AuthorityForAirspace.comment: The responsibility that one organisation has for an airspace.

AuthorityForNavaidEquipment.comment: The level of responsibility of an organisation for a radio navigation aid.

AuthorityForSpecialNavigationStation.comment: The level of responsibility of an organisation for a special navigation station.

AuthorityForSpecialNavigationSystem.comment: The level of responsibility of an organisation for a special navigation system.

AuxiliaryPowerUnit.comment: A self-contained power-unit on an aircraft providing electrical/pneumatic power to aircraft systems during ground operations.

AviationCondition.comment: Weather observations and or forecast for a specific aeronautical location or airspace volume.

Boarding.comment: The boarding of an aircraft for the purpose of commencing a flight, except by such crew or passengers as have embarked on a previous stage of the same through-flight.

Bridge.comment: A structure forming or carrying a road over a river, a ravine, etc., or affording passage between two points at a height above the ground.

BridgeSide.comment: Line representing the side extent of aerodrome feature(s) associated with the vertical drop section of an overpass.

Capacity.comment: The maximum number of aircraft that can be accommodated in a given time period by the system or one of its components (throughput).

CircleSector.comment: A 3D pattern based on start angle, stop angle, inner distance, outer distance and upper/lower altitude.

CirclingArea.comment: The area in which aircraft circle to land under visual conditions after completing an instrument landing approach.

CirclingRestriction.comment: A (sub)sector used to restrict flight within a circling area.

City.comment: A town or other inhabited place.

CivilMilitaryCrossing.comment: The agreed and proposed civil military crossing conditions of an aircraft.

Cloud.comment: A hydrometeor consisting of minute particles of liquid water or ice, or of both, suspended in the free air and usually not touching the ground. It may also include larger particles of liquid water or ice and non-aqueous liquid or solid particles such as those present in fumes, smoke and dust.

CodeACASCapabilityType.comment: A code indicating the capability of the airborne collision avoidance system.

CodeACDMIrregularityType.comment: A code describing the type of A-CDM irregularity.

CodeADSBGSServiceStatusType.comment: Information concerning the status of the Service provided by a Ground Station

CodeAMANHorizonType.comment: A classification of a horizon in terms of its operational use in arrival management.

CodeAMANStatusType.comment: A code indicating the status of eligibility of a flight for the AMAN processing.

CodeATCReportingType.comment: A code indicating the type of position report required by an ATC Unit. Eg.: compulsory or on request.

CodeATFMHotspotSeverityType.comment: A code indicating the severity of an ATFM hotspot.

CodeATFMHotspotStatusType.comment: A code indicating the status of an ATFM hotspot.

CodeATFMMeasureStatusType.comment: A code indicating the status of an ATFM measure.

CodeAerialRefuellingPrefixType.comment: A prefix for the designator of the Aerial Refuelling route.

CodeAerialRefuellingType.comment: A code indicating the type of aerial refuelling pattern.

CodeAerodromeCollocationType.comment: A code indicating the extent of collocation between two aerodromes.

CodeAerodromeSystemType.comment: Indicates which operational systems are published in AIP for the aerodrome.

CodeAerodromeTrafficType.comment: A code describing the type of air traffic at an aerodrome.

CodeAerodromeType.comment: A code specifying whether a particular entity occurrence is an Airport or a Heliport.

CodeAirToAirEngagementType.comment: A list of codes indicating the type of air-to-air mission.

CodeAirTrafficServiceType.comment: A list of codes used to designate type of air traffic services.

CodeAirTrafficType.comment: A code specifying the air traffic views for which traffic count information is established.

CodeAircraftAirframeEquipmentType.comment: A code indicating a type of airframe equipment.

CodeAircraftAttitudeType.comment: The attitude of the aircraft in flight.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType.comment: A code indicating a type of aircraft avionics.

CodeAircraftClassificationType.comment: An aircraft characteristic that can be used as classification criteria.

CodeAircraftEngineNumberType.comment: A coded indication for the number of engines of an aircraft.

CodeAircraftEngineType.comment: A code indicating the type of aircraft engine.

CodeAircraftEquipmentType.comment: A code describing types of aircraft equipments.

CodeAircraftFlightStatusType.comment: Status of an aircraft at an aerodrome combining information about the outbound flight, the inbound flight and the turnaround process.

CodeAircraftGroundServiceType.comment: A code indicating a type of service provided to aircraft on the ground.

CodeAircraftLandingCategoryType.comment: Classification of aircraft based on 1.3 times stall speed in landing configuration at maximum certified landing mass.

CodeAircraftPerformanceStatusType.comment: The status of the aircraft performance assessment.

CodeAircraftStandType.comment: A code indicating the type of stand. For example, parking position on the apron, isolated aircraft stand, terminal building gate, etc..

CodeAircraftSurvivalEquipmentType.comment: A code indicating a type of aircraft survival equipment.

CodeAircraftType.comment: Classification of aircraft according to specified basic characteristics, e.g. aeroplane, helicopter, glider, free balloon.

CodeAircraftWingspanClassType.comment: A grouping of airplanes based on wingspan.

CodeAirportCDMActorType.comment: Party contributing to an airport collaborative decision making process

CodeAirportMovementType.comment: The distinct movement types at an airport are departure and arrival. Movement is a generic term for either of them.

CodeAirportSlotKindType.comment: Code indicating whether the Airport Slot is for the Departure or the Arrival of the flight.

CodeAirportWarningType.comment: A code indicating a reason for caution in airport operations. For example, work in progress on a runway.

CodeAirspaceActivityType.comment: A code indicating the primary activity taking place in the airspace or the reason for its establishment.

CodeAirspaceAggregationType.comment: An 'operator' in coded form according to which two 'operands' will be 'associated' in order to produce a result.

CodeAirspaceClassificationType.comment: A coded list of values that which determines the operating rules, flight requirements, and services provided in an airspace. According to Annex 11, Appendix 4.

CodeAirspaceDependencyType.comment: A code indicating the extent of dependency relation between an AirspaceVolume and another Airspace.

CodeAirspacePointPositionType.comment: A code indicating the location of a significant point in relation to airspace.

CodeAirspaceReservationImpactType.comment: A list of coded values indicating the operational impact of the Airspace over the route segment.

CodeAirspaceReservationPhaseType.comment: A coded list of values indicating steps of the Airspace reservation process, from the military end user point of view.

CodeAirspaceType.comment: A coded list of values that indicates a type of airspace.

CodeAlertActivationStatusType.comment: A code describing the activation status of the alert.

CodeAlertSeverityLevelType.comment: A code describing the severity level of the alert.

CodeAlertTriggerType.comment: A code describing how the alter is triggered.

CodeAlternativeFlightResponseKindType.comment: Whether an alternative flight is accepted by the downstream ATSUs or not.

CodeAlternativeFlightStateType.comment: The status of alternative flights (what-if flights).

CodeAltitudeAdjustmentType.comment: A code indicating the type of adjustment used to produce a usable altitude.

CodeAltitudeReportingCapabilityType.comment: A code indicating the capability of the aircraft to report altitudes with a given resolution.

CodeAltitudeUseType.comment: A code indicating, in situations where both an upper and a lower altitude may be specified, how the altitude information should be interpreted.

CodeApproachEquipmentAdditionalType.comment: A code indicating the additional equipment needed to fly the procedure not listed in approachType

CodeApproachLightingICAOType.comment: Classification of the approach lighting system using as criteria the ICAO Annex 14 standards and recommended practices.

CodeApproachLightingSystemType.comment: A regional or organisation specific classification of the Runway approach lighting system equipment. Could also be a brand name.

CodeApproachPrefixType.comment: Code indicating the prefix used in support of current approach procedure naming conventions

CodeApproachType.comment: A code describing the type of instrument approach procedure.

CodeApronElementType.comment: The type of an apron based upon its location on an aerodrome and its general purpose.

CodeApronSectionType.comment: A code indicating a location on the surface of an apron. For example: apron edge.

CodeApronServiceType.comment: Type of service available at an apron area, such as Marshal management service.

CodeArcDirectionType.comment: A code indicating the direction of an arc (clockwise or counter clockwise).

CodeArrestingGearEnergyAbsorbType.comment: The type of energy absorber (for example: a rotary brake) by which the arresting gear system rapidly dissipates the kinetic energy of a moving aircraft that engages the arresting system, bringing the aircraft to a stop.

CodeArrestingGearEngageDeviceType.comment: A code indicating the type of device (for example: a hook) that is used to engage an aircraft upon landing in order to immediately stop it.

CodeArrivalSeparationModeType.comment: Codes used to denote the separation modes for arrival sequence distance computation.

CodeAuthorityRoleType.comment: A code indicating the role of the OrganisationAuthority for the aeronautical feature.

CodeAuthorityType.comment: A code indicating the type of responsibility that one organisation/authority has for an aeronautical feature (for example, an airspace).

CodeAviationStandardsType.comment: A code indicating the standard referred to by a list of values, in case where different aviation authorities use different categorisation criteria.

CodeBasicCoordinationStatusType.comment: The state of coordination of the time and level at the coordination point.

CodeBearingType.comment: A code indicating the type of angle: magnetic, bearing, VOR radial.

CodeBoundaryCrossingType.comment: A code describing how the boundary between two ATC volumes will be crossed.

CodeBridgeDropSideType.comment: Relative location of the drop side, from startpoint to endpoint of line.

CodeBuoyType.comment: Code indicating the type of Buoy

CodeCTAStatusType.comment: A code indicating the possible statuses of the CTA negotiation process.

CodeCapacityType.comment: A code indicating the type of capacity.

CodeChangeIndicatorType.comment: A code describing the type of meteorological conditions changes.

CodeCheckpointCategoryType.comment: The position of the checkpoint; airborne or ground

CodeClassB2TransmitPowerCapabilityType.comment: A code indicating the class B2 power transmission capability.

CodeCloudAmountType.comment: Amount of cloud - assessed by category.

CodeCloudType.comment: A code describing the types of cloud.

CodeCommunicationCapabilityType.comment: A code indicating the capability of the aircraft and associated flight crew qualifications to communicate with ATS units.

CodeCommunicationDirectionType.comment: A coded indicator for the directionality of a communication channel.

CodeCommunicationModeType.comment: A coded indicator for the type of communication channel.

CodeCompassPointType.comment: The main points of the compass.

CodeConditionalRouteType.comment: The type of conditional route, according to the Flexible use of Airspace rules.

CodeConstraintCategoryType.comment: The list of categories for a trajectory constraint.

CodeConstraintHandlingType.comment: A code describing the open/closed status of a trajectory constraint.

CodeConstraintStatusType.comment: The state of acceptance of the trajectory constraint by the FDMP.

CodeContaminationType.comment: A code indicating the types of substances which can contaminate aerodrome movement areas.

CodeConvectionCellTopVariationType.comment: A code describing the dynamic behaviour of the top of a convection cell.

CodeConvectionCellType.comment: A code indicating whether a convection cell described is the base (cell base) of a cell, or the upper part of a cell (cell top).

CodeCoordinationAndTransferStatusType.comment: The state of progress of the coordination between civilian ATSUs or between a civilian and a military ATSU or with an Oceanic centre.

CodeCoordinationReasonType.comment: The reason for a coordination to have been : 1. Referred to manual processing: - Non standard conditions - Manual referral 2. Abrogated: - TFL if the reason is a change of transfer level - route if the reason is a change of route, - cancellation if the reason is a cancellation, - delay if the reason is a delay prior to departure, - hold if the reason is a hold, 3. Rejected: - Conflicting traffic - Work overload

CodeCountCalculationType.comment: A code describing the traffic count's calculation types.

CodeCourseQualityILSType.comment: A coded value indicating the signal quality of the ILS course structure based on the location the precision signal is usable to, according to ICAO Annex 10, Volume I, Chapter 3.

CodeCourseType.comment: A code indicating the type of course to be observed. For example, true track, magnetic track, heading, VOR radial, true bearing, magnetic bearing.

CodeDMEChannelType.comment: A code indicating the channel of a DME.

CodeDMEType.comment: A code indicating the type of UHF distance measuring equipment.

CodeDatalinkCommunicationCapabilityType.comment: A code indicating the capability of the aircraft to communicate or receive data.

CodeDayType.comment: A list of the days of the week.

CodeDeclaredDistanceType.comment: A code indicating the type of conventional declared distance for a runway. For example, TORA, TODA, LDA, etc...

CodeDeicingStatusType.comment: The progress status of the de-icing procedure.

CodeDepartureClearanceStatusType.comment: The progress status of granting of the departure clearance.

CodeDepartureSuspensionStatusType.comment: This enumerated class holds the possible values for the status of a Departure

CodeDesignStandardType.comment: A code indicating the rules used to design and evaluate terminal procedures

CodeDirectionTurnType.comment: A code indicating the direction of a turn.

CodeDirectionType.comment: A code indicating a 1-dimensional direction, for example, forward or backward.

CodeDistanceIndicationType.comment: Coding indicating the type of distance indication.

CodeEmergencyStatusType.comment: A code describing the status of an emergency.

CodeEngineOperationModeType.comment: A code describing the operating mode of the engine.

CodeEquipmentOperationalType.comment: Presumably meant to indicate the operational status of the additional equipment. Could be considered, if we are going to include the current operational status of equipment as well as the status as indicated in the flight plan.

CodeEquipmentStatusType.comment: An indication, for any type aircraft equipment, whether the aircraft is equipped, not equipped or the equipment status is unknown.

CodeEquipmentUnavailableType.comment: A code to indicate the type of unavailable equipment

CodeFFICEStatusType.comment: A code indicating the status of the flight for information management of the flight information.

CodeFacilityRankingType.comment: The order of priority of a facility, within a range of similar facilities. For example, "primary", "secondary" or "alternate".

CodeFiledFlightRulesType.comment: Indication about the category of flight rules with which the pilot intends to comply.

CodeFinalGuidanceType.comment: Codes describing the guidance used on the final approach segment of an instrument approach procedure.

CodeFireFightingType.comment: A code indicating the category of the fire fighting service provided at the aerodrome/heliport.

CodeFlightCrewQualificationType.comment: The type of flight crew qualification.

CodeFlightDataKindType.comment: A code distinguishing real flight information from copies of it (alternative or what-if flights).

CodeFlightOriginType.comment: A coded list of values indicating the source of a flight (local, national, international, etc.)

CodeFlightReadyStatusType.comment: Indication about the readiness status of the flight.

CodeFlightRestrictionType.comment: A code indicating if the restriction is an interdiction or a mandatory routing.

CodeFlightRulesType.comment: The regulations that govern all aspects of operations under which the pilot flies.

CodeFlightServiceAvailabilityType.comment: A list of values that designate the intentions of a flight in relation with a location, such as arrival, departure or over-flight.

CodeFlightStatusForCountType.comment: A code indicating the status and/or origin of a flight in the NM system.

CodeFlowCombinationRoleType.comment: Code indicating the role a flow fulfils within a traffic volume.

CodeFrictionDeviceType.comment: A code indicating the types of equipment used to determine the friction coefficient on an aerodrome movement area.

CodeFrictionEstimateType.comment: A code describing the qualitative estimates of the friction on a movement area.

CodeFuelType.comment: A code indicating the category of fuel available at an aerodrome/heliport.

CodeGradeSeparationType.comment: A list of coded values that indicate the placement of an element at a different height from another element.

CodeGroundLightingType.comment: A code indicating a type of aeronautical ground light. For example, Marine, RWY BCN, ABN, IBN, etc.

CodeGuidanceLineType.comment: A code indicating the type of guidance line.

CodeHeadingType.comment: Indication whether a heading is absolute or relative.

CodeHeightReferenceType.comment: A code indicating the reference surface for a height value, especially for approach procedures related heights.

CodeHelicopterPerformanceType.comment: A code indicating the performance class of a helicopter.

CodeHoldingSideType.comment: Relative location of the holding side of a holding position, from startpoint to endpoint of line.

CodeHoldingUsageType.comment: A code indicating the type of holding procedure. For example, en-route holding, terminal area holding.

CodeHoldingUseType.comment: A code to identify the holding is used by a segment

CodeIATACoordinationLevelType.comment: IATA classification of Airports according to level of activity.

CodeIATACountryCodeType.comment: The list of IATA Country Codes.

CodeIATASeasonType.comment: Scheduling season as used by the commercial aviation industry.

CodeICAOCertificationType.comment: The airport conformity to applicable safety regulatory requirements. An airport may have received ICAO certification or not and it may have received it with some exceptions not detailed here.

CodeICAONationalityLettersType.comment: The list of ICAO Nationality Letters.

CodeILSBackCourseType.comment: A code indicating the usability of the localizer signal in the back-course sector.

CodeInstructionToAircraftType.comment: The instruction that may be given to a flight that cannot depart for an APOP/DEP reason.

CodeInstrumentApproachCategoryType.comment: A description of the types of instrument approach.

CodeInstrumentRunwayType.comment: A description of the types of runway intended for the operation of aircraft using instrument approach procedures.

CodeIntegrityLevelILSType.comment: A coded value indicating the quality which relates to the trust which can be placed in the correctness of the information supplied by the ILS facility, according to ICAO Annex 10, Volume I, Attachment C.

CodeIntensityStandByType.comment: A code indicating the intensity level of the lighting when not in use.

CodeInternationalFlightType.comment: Indication about the type of domestic or international flight.

CodeLAHSOMarkingType.comment: The type of location being protected by the feature instance.

CodeLegPathType.comment: A code classifying the trajectory of a segment path.

CodeLevelSeriesType.comment: A series of predefined levels. For example Odd, Even.

CodeLevelTableDesignatorType.comment: A code identifying the table of discreet cruising levels. For example, ICAO IFR, ICAO VFR, ICAO RVSM, etc..

CodeLevelType.comment: A code indicating the level: upper airspace, lower airspace or both.

CodeLifeJacketEquipmentType.comment: The type of life jackets available on board the aircraft.

CodeLightBulbType.comment: The source type of the light.

CodeLightHoldingPositionType.comment: A coded list of light signs provided for a taxiway holding position.

CodeLightIntensityType.comment: A code indicating the intensity level of a light source. For example, LIL, LIM, LIH, etc.

CodeLightSourceType.comment: A code indicating a type of light source, such as strobe or flood.

CodeLightSystemActivationType.comment: A code indicating the activation / deactivation of a system following a specific command.

CodeLightingJARType.comment: Classification of the approach lighting system using as criteria JAR-OPS 1 - Subpart E, Appendix 1 to 1.430]

CodeLoadingBridgeType.comment: An coded list of values that indicate types of passenger loading bridges.

CodeLocationQualifierType.comment: A code qualifying a location (such as an airspace, aerodrome, point, etc.) in relation with a flight or with its availability.

CodeLocationToDeiceType.comment: This indicates the location where the aircraft will de-ice. it can be at its stand or at a de-icing platform.

CodeMCDMCoordinationApprovalStatusType.comment: A code indicating the approval status within MCDM.

CodeMCDMCoordinationLevelType.comment: A code indicating the level at which the MCDM coordination is being done.

CodeMCDMCoordinationStatusType.comment: A code indicating the status of an MCDM coordination.

CodeMLSAzimuthType.comment: A code indicating the type of azimuth equipment: normal or backward.

CodeMLSChannelType.comment: A code indicating the channel of an MLS.

CodeMarkerBeaconSignalType.comment: A code indicating the class of a radio marker.

CodeMarkingConditionType.comment: A coded list of values that indicate the status of the painted surface marking elements.

CodeMarkingPatternType.comment: The type of marking pattern used at this location.

CodeMarkingStyleType.comment: A coded list of values indicating styles of painted lines.

CodeMilitaryActivityType.comment: List of military activities that have a national specificity.

CodeMilitaryOperationsType.comment: A code indicating in terms of civil or military, the type of operations.

CodeMilitaryStatusType.comment: A code distinguishing between military and civil status.

CodeMilitaryTrainingType.comment: A code indicating the type of flying on a military training route.

CodeMinimaFinalApproachPathType.comment: Code indicating final approach path type for establishing valid set of minima on a procedure.

CodeMinimumAltitudeType.comment: A code classifying altitudes for approach procedure minima.

CodeMinimumHeightType.comment: A code classifying heights for approach procedure minima.

CodeNDBUsageType.comment: A code indicating the class of an NDB.

CodeNasRoleType.comment: Role of a Country with respect to Nas.

CodeNavaidPurposeType.comment: A coded list of values indicating the intended usage of a navaid (en-route or airport)

CodeNavigationAreaRestrictionType.comment: Indicates the type of restricted area that aircraft should avoid

CodeNavigationAreaType.comment: A code indicating the type of navigation area.

CodeNavigationCapabilityType.comment: A code indicating the navigation capability of the aircraft and associated flight crew qualifications.

CodeNitrogenSupplyType.comment: A code describing the type of nitrogen supplies for aviation usage.

CodeNoiseCertificationType.comment: Type of aircraft noise certification as defined by the ICAO Annex 16 V1

CodeNonStandardReasonType.comment: A code describing the reasons for a non standard coordination.

CodeNorthReferenceType.comment: A code indicating the type of the North reference used.

CodeNotePurposeType.comment: A list of values that indicate the goal with which a free text Note is provided.

CodeObscurationType.comment: A code describing the obscuration types.

CodeObstacleAreaType.comment: A code indicating the type of obstacle coverage area, according to ICAO Annex 15.

CodeObstacleAssessmentSurfaceType.comment: A code indicating the type of surface assessment. Used for indicating assessment surfaces used in design and evaluation activities such as approach procedure design.

CodeObstructionIdSurfaceZoneType.comment: Specifies zones within obstruction identification surfaces (OIS).

CodeOceanicClearanceStatusType.comment: The status of the oceanic clearance.

CodeOceanicReclearanceReasonType.comment: The reasons for an oceanic re-clearance.

CodeOilType.comment: A code indicating the category of oil available at an aerodrome/heliport.

CodeOperationAerodromeType.comment: A coded identifier indicating an operation executed by an aircraft in relation with an aerodrome.

CodeOperationManoeuvringAreaType.comment: A coded list of values that indicates a type of activity on an aerodrome manoeuvring area element.

CodeOrganisationHierarchyType.comment: The values indicating the type of association between two organisations.

CodeOrganisationType.comment: A code indicating the type of an Organisation/Authority. For example, State, Association of States, International Organisation, etc..

CodeOxygenSupplyType.comment: A code describing the type of oxygen supplies for aviation usage.

CodePARType.comment: Type of Precision Approach Radar equipment.

CodePCNMethodType.comment: A code indicating the method used in the evaluation of a PCN number.

CodePCNPavementType.comment: A code indicating the pavement behaviour (rigid or flexible) used for the ACN determination.

CodePCNSubgradeType.comment: A code indicating the sub-grade strength category related to a PCN number.

CodePCNTyrePressureType.comment: A code indicating the maximum allowable tyre pressure category related to a PCN number.

CodeParticularMatterType.comment: A list of particular matter types.

CodePassengerServiceType.comment: A code indicating a type of service provided to passengers at the airport.

CodePilotControlledLightingType.comment: A list to indicate the standard with which the pilot controlled lighting service complies.

CodePlanningStatusType.comment: Qualification of the planning stage where the information is coming from. In ATM, information exchanges do not only contain the best known planned value. They can contain several values coming from different planning stages such as the scheduled value, the estimated one and the target one.

CodePointUsageType.comment: A code describing the usage of a point within ATM context.

CodePositionInILSType.comment: A code indicating a position in the ILS system. For example, outer, middle, inner, backcourse.

CodePrecipitationType.comment: A code describing the precipitation types.

CodeProcedureAvailabilityType.comment: A code indicating the availability of a procedure for use.

CodeProcedureCodingStandardType.comment: Code indicating the standard used to encode the approach procedure.

CodeProcedureDistanceType.comment: Indicates the distance and altitude type associated with an approach procedure.

CodeProcedurePhaseType.comment: A code indicating a phase of a SID, STAR or IAP.

CodeProtectAreaSectionType.comment: A code indicating the location of the Protect Area lighting.

CodeRNAVFlightCapabilityType.comment: A code indicating which Area Navigation requirements can be met by the aircraft while operating in the context of a particular airspace when supported by the appropriate navigation infrastructure.

CodeRNPCapabilityType.comment: A code indicating which Required Navigation Performance requirements can be met by the aircraft while operating in the context of a particular airspace when supported by the appropriate navigation infrastructure.

CodeRVRReadingType.comment: A code indicating the position where the RVR reading is reported.

CodeRVRTendencyType.comment: A code indicating, when instrumented systems are used for the assessment of RVR, the tendency (upward or downward) of the variations in RVR during the 10-minute period immediately preceding the observation.

CodeRadarServiceType.comment: A list of service types for Radar Systems.

CodeRadioEmissionType.comment: A code indicating the type of emission, as defined at the 1979 ITU World Administrative Radio Conference. For example, A3E, NONA2a, G1D.

CodeRadioFrequencyAreaType.comment: A code indicating the type of radio navigation aid limitation.

CodeRadioSignalType.comment: A coded indicator for the type of information transmitted by a navaid or other radio emission source.

CodeReasonCancellationType.comment: A coded list of values indicating the reason for abandoning the use of an airspace by a planned military mission.

CodeReasonForDepartureSuspensionType.comment: The reasons for which a departure suspension may exist.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType.comment: The reason for special handling of a flight by ATS.

CodeReferenceRoleType.comment: A list describing the valid Point Reference makeups for use by navigation receivers.

CodeReflectorType.comment: Type of Reflector associated to the PAR.

CodeRegulationCauseLocationCategoryType.comment: A code indicating the location category for an ATFM regulation.

CodeRegulationCauseType.comment: A structured code indicating the reason for implementing an ATFM Regulation.

CodeRelativeDirectionType.comment: A list of values indicating a direction with regard to a reference point.

CodeRelativePositionType.comment: A list of values indicating a relative position, in relation with a reference point.

CodeReleaseIndicationType.comment: A code describing the release indications.

CodeResponsibilityKindType.comment: The kind of responsibilities that can be available in an ATSU.

CodeRoadType.comment: A code indicating the type of a road.

CodeRoleKindType.comment: The kind of roles that can be available in an ATSU.

CodeRouteAvailabilityType.comment: A code indicating the route segment availability.

CodeRouteDesignatorLetterType.comment: A one character designator for the route.

CodeRouteDesignatorSuffixType.comment: A suffix for the route designator.

CodeRouteNavigationType.comment: A code indicating the type of a route from a navigation point of view.

CodeRouteOriginType.comment: A code indicating if a route is international or domestic.

CodeRouteSegmentPathType.comment: A code indicating the type of segment path.

CodeRouteType.comment: A code indicating the route classification.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType.comment: An open list of values indicating a general heading by which a rule or procedure is usually identified in the Aeronautical Information Publications (AIP) or similar/related documents.

CodeRuleProcedureType.comment: An open coded list of values indicating the purpose of a rule or procedure.

CodeRunwayDirectionOperationModeType.comment: A runway direction may be operational for arrivals only, for departures only, for both (mixed mode) or it may be closed.

CodeRunwayElementType.comment: A code indicating the type of runway element.

CodeRunwayMarkingType.comment: Type of runway marking related to landing categories such as precision, non-precision and basic.

CodeRunwayProtectionAreaType.comment: A code indicating the type of protection area for a runway For example, clearway, obstacle free zone, ILS protection area, etc..

CodeRunwaySectionType.comment: A code indicating the position of an item on a surface of a runway. Eg: THR, runway end, runway centre line, TDZ, etc.

CodeRunwayType.comment: A code that makes a distinction between runways for airplanes and FATO for helicopters.

CodeSSRCodeStatusType.comment: The status of the SSR code.

CodeSSRModeType.comment: A code describing the different modes of surveillance.

CodeSafeAltitudeType.comment: A code indicating the type of altitude used, MSA or ESA.

CodeSafetyMitigationAdviceType.comment: The types of the safety mitigation advice.

CodeSeaStateType.comment: A code describing the state of the sea based on the height of waves, as specified in WMO Publication No. 306, Manual on Codes, Volume I,1, Part A - Alphanumerix Codes, Code Table 3700.

CodeSegmentPathType.comment: A code indicating the type of flight path and its associated type of termination.

CodeSegmentTerminationType.comment: A code indicating the end point of a terminal procedure segment leg.

CodeSeparationAdviceReasonType.comment: The reason for issuing the advice.

CodeSeparationFromLeadIndicatorType.comment: The types of indicator of separation not in lead.

CodeServiceATFMType.comment: A list of codes used to designate flight planning and air traffic flow management services.

CodeServiceClassType.comment: Information concerning the configuration of a Service.

CodeServiceInformationType.comment: A list of codes used to designate information provision services.

CodeServiceSARType.comment: A list of codes used to designate services in relation with search and rescue.

CodeSignalPerformanceType.comment: A coded value indicating the signal performance level in space corresponding to the precision of an ILS or MLS system according to ICAO Annex 10, Volume I, Chapter 3.

CodeSignificantPointDesignatorType.comment: A code indicating a specific type of significant point, in direct relation with the designator allocated to that point.

CodeSignificantWeatherQualifierType.comment: Qualifiers used in association with a reported significant weather phenomenon.

CodeSlotAllocationStatusType.comment: Indication whether a slot is pre-allocated to a flight (typically two hours before the Estimated Off-Block Time) or allocated (after these two hours).

CodeSlotImprovementProposalStatusType.comment: Indication whether a proposal is pending to be accepted or rejected, or if it has been rejected.

CodeSpecialHeightValueType.comment: ATM specific codes used to express height in non-numeric terms.

CodeSpecialNavigationStationType.comment: A code indicating the type of service provided by a station in a special navigation system chain, depending on the type of the system.

CodeSpecialNavigationSystemType.comment: A code indicating a type of special navigation system. For example, LORAN, DECCA, GNSS, etc.

CodeSpecialSSRCodeType.comment: The type of special SSR code.

CodeSpeedReferenceType.comment: A code indicating the reference system for a speed value.

CodeStandServiceType.comment: Type of service available at a stand, such as visual or instrumental docking guidance system.

CodeStandbyPowerType.comment: Type of power used when the radar is required to operate on standby.

CodeStatusAirportType.comment: A coded list of values that indicates the availability of an aerodrome facility for specific flight operations.

CodeStatusAirspaceType.comment: A coded list of values indicating the activation status of an Airspace.

CodeStatusConstructionType.comment: A code indicating the status of the construction of a Vertical Structure.

CodeStatusNavaidType.comment: The operational status of a Navaid or NavaidEquipment

CodeStatusServiceType.comment: A coded list of values that indicate the operational capability of a service.

CodeSupplyDistributionMethodType.comment: The method used for distributing supply at an apron.

CodeSurfaceCompositionType.comment: A code indicating the composition of a surface. For example, asphalt, concrete etc..

CodeSurfaceConditionType.comment: A code indicating the condition of a surface, such as a runway, taxiway, the marking of a threshold, etc..

CodeSurfacePreparationType.comment: A code indicating the preparation technique for a surface area.

CodeSurveillanceCapabilityType.comment: A code indicating the SSR and ADS capability of the aircraft.

CodeSurvivalEquipmentType.comment: The type of equipment carried on board the aircraft that can be used by the crew and passengers to assist survival in harsh environments in case of emergency.

CodeTAAType.comment: A code indicating the types of Terminal Arrival Altitude.

CodeTACANChannelType.comment: A code indicating the channel of a TACAN.

CodeTLOFSectionType.comment: A code indicating the position of an item on the surface of a Touch Down and Lift-off Area.

CodeTacticalIReroutingProposalStatusType.comment: A code describing the status of the tactical rerouting proposal.

CodeTacticalReroutingApplicationType.comment: A code indicating how the tactical rerouting measure is to be applied.

CodeTacticalReroutingConstraintType.comment: A code indicating the type of tactical rerouting constraint.

CodeTacticalReroutingReasonType.comment: Describes whether a flight was rerouted, and if that is the case, why.

CodeTacticalReroutingStatusType.comment: If a flight was rerouted, describes the current rerouting state.

CodeTargetTimeStatusType.comment: A code describing the status of the target take-off time.

CodeTargetTrajectoryChangeReportCapabili.comment: A code indicating the capability of the aircraft to report target trajectory change.

CodeTaxiRouteModeType.comment: A code indicating the type of taxi route mode.

CodeTaxiRouteStatusType.comment: Specifies whether the considered Taxi Route was the planned one or a deviation of it.

CodeTaxiwayElementType.comment: A code list of values indicating a component of the taxiway surface.

CodeTaxiwaySectionType.comment: A code indicating the position of an item on the surface of a taxiway.

CodeTaxiwayType.comment: A code indicating a type of taxiway. For example, normal taxiway, apron taxiway, air taxiway, etc..

CodeTelecomNetworkType.comment: Codelist containing the Telecom Networks that can be used to address an organisation.

CodeTerrainAwarenessAndGroundProximityAl.comment: A code indicating the capability of the aircraft to warn or alert about the proximity of the ground.

CodeTimeEventCombinationType.comment: A code indicating which event in a list of events in time should be given precedence over the others. E.g. the earliest or the latest.

CodeTimeEventType.comment: A code indicating an event occurrence during any day.

CodeTimeReferenceType.comment: A coded indication of a time reference system - UTC or local.

CodeTrajectoryDialogueStatusType.comment: A code indicating the 4D trajectory clearance states.

CodeTrajectoryPointAcceptanceStatusType.comment: The state of acceptance of the trajectory point by the FDMP.

CodeTrajectoryPointType.comment: A code indicating the type of trajectory point.

CodeTransponderType.comment: A code indicating a transponder mode.

CodeTurbulenceType.comment: A code describing the types of turbulence.

CodeUnitDependencyType.comment: A list of coded values that indicate the kind of dependency between a Unit and a related Unit.

CodeUnitType.comment: A unit providing particular ATS services.

CodeUomAreaType.comment: Units of measure for an area.

CodeUomDepthChangeRateType.comment: Units of measure for a rate of progress or change of a certain material as it builds up on solid objects.

CodeUomEddyDissipationRateType.comment: Units of measure for Eddy Dissipation Rate.

CodeUomElectricCurrentType.comment: Units of measure for electric current.

CodeUomEnergyFluxType.comment: Units of measure for energy flux.

CodeUomForceType.comment: Units of measure for a force.

CodeUomLuminousIntensityType.comment: Units of measure for light intensity.

CodeUomMassConcentrationType.comment: Units of measure for mass concentration.

CodeUomMassDensityType.comment: Units of measure for mass density.

CodeUomParticleContentType.comment: Units of measure for a particle content.

CodeUomParticleFluxType.comment: Units of measure for particle flux.

CodeUomPlaneAngleType.comment: Units of measure for the plane angle.

CodeUomRatioType.comment: Units of measure for the quantitative relation between two amounts showing the number of times one value contains or is contained within the other.

CodeUomSolidAngleType.comment: Units of measure for the solid angle.

CodeUomTimeType.comment: Units of measure an interval of time.

CodeUomVolumeType.comment: Units of measure for a volume measurement.

CodeUomWeightType.comment: Units of measure for a weight.

CodeUsageLimitationType.comment: A code indicating whether a limitation is of type permission, interdiction or exclusive usage.

CodeVASISType.comment: A code indicating a type of visual approach slope indicator system. For example, VASIS, AVASIS, 3-BAR VASIS, PAPI, APAPI, etc..

CodeVORType.comment: A code indicating the type of path to the next point. For example, great circle, clockwise arc, counter clockwise arc, etc.

CodeValidityPeriodInterpretationType.comment: Interpretation given to a validity period.

CodeValueContaminationExtentType.comment: A code describing the proportion of a runway surface that is contaminated by a contaminant, as a percentage of the total runway area.

CodeValueInterpretationType.comment: A code indicating how a value needs to be interpreted when used as a filter or condition. For example: above the value or below the value.

CodeVerticalReferenceType.comment: A code indicating the reference for a vertical distance. Two series of values exist: 1) real distance: from GND, from the MSL, from the WGS-84 ellipsoid; 2) distance based on a difference of pressures, according to the standard atmosphere.

CodeVerticalStructureMarkingType.comment: A code indicating the type and pattern of markings on a vertical structure.

CodeVerticalStructureMaterialType.comment: A coded list of values indicating the type(s) of material that could compose the load-bearing structure and/or exterior facing of a vertical construction.

CodeVerticalStructureType.comment: A code indicating the type of vertical structure.

CodeVisualDockingGuidanceType.comment: A coded list of values that indicate types of systems used at aircraft stands in order to help the pilot align and position the aircraft.

CodeWakeTurbulenceCategoryType.comment: A grouping of aircraft according to the effect of the rotating air mass created behind the wing tips.

CodeWakeVortexClassificationType.comment: Aircraft classification depending on wake vortex separation.

CodeWeatherIntensityType.comment: A code indicating the weather intensity.

CodeWeatherPhenomenonType.comment: A code describing the types of weather phenomenon.

CodeWindCharacteristicType.comment: When it is not possible to forecast a prevailing surface wind direction due to its expected variability, for example, during light wind conditions (less than 3 kt) or thunderstorms, the forecast wind direction should be indicated as variable using "VRB". When the wind is forecast to be less than 1 kt the forecast wind speed should be indicated as calm. When a wind speed of 20oKm/h (100kt) or more is forecast, it should be indicated as 200Km/h (or 100kt) [ICAO ANNEX 3, recommendation 6.2.12]

CodeWorkAreaType.comment: A code indicating the type of work performed in the work area.

ConstrainingAirspaceActivity.comment: A qualification of the impact of an airspace reservation over a route segment.

ContactInformation.comment: Information required to enable contact with the responsible person and/or organisation.

Contour.comment: An estimated or observed outline of a particular weather situation.

ControlledTimeOver.comment: An ATM imposed constraint over a point.

Convection.comment: In the atmosphere, convection is the dominant vertical transport process in convective boundary layers, which are common over tropical oceans and, during sunny days, over continents. Moist convection in the atmosphere is characterized by deep, saturated updrafts and downdrafts, and unsaturated downdrafts driven by the evaporation and melting of precipitation. This form of convection is made visible by cumulus clouds and cumulonimbus clouds in the case of precipitation convection.

CoordinationAndTransfer.comment: A dialogue procedure between ATC Units successively in control of a flight, comprising - notification of the flight - coordination of conditions of transfer by the transferring ATC unit - coordination, if necessary, and acceptance of conditions of transfer by the accepting ATC unit - transfer of control to the accepting ATC unit.

CoordinationAndTransferConstraint.comment: A constraint used during the coordination dialog through a WIFO.

CoordinationConditions.comment: The trajectory data coordinated for handover between adjacent ATC sectors or units. Coordination conditions (point, level, entry time ...) are of two types : standard and non-standard conditions. Non-standard conditions require an explicit acceptance by controllers, whereas standard ones are automatically accepted.

CrewMember.comment: A person assigned by an operator to duty on an aircraft during a flight duty period.

DME.comment: Ultra High Frequency (UHF) ground equipment that is used in conjunction with airborne equipment to determine distance between the airborne and ground equipment.

DateTimeWithPlanningType.comment: A combination of a date and a time type which allows the planning status to be recorded.

Deicing.comment: De-icing operation on an aircraft that may consist of removal of snow, ice or frost from the aircraft (de-icing), and/or also application of chemicals that remain on a surface and continue to delay the reformation of ice up (anti-icing).

DeicingArea.comment: An area comprising an inner area for the parking of an aeroplane to receive de-icing / anti-icing treatment and an outer area for the manoeuvring of two or more mobile de-icing / anti-icing equipment.

DeicingAreaMarking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed on the surface of a deicing area

DelayApportionment.comment: The apportionment of an AMAN or EMAN delay.

DeltaEmission.comment: The change in noise and gaseous emissions measured at a given waypoint.

DepartureClearance.comment: Authorization for an aircraft to take-off under conditions specified by an air traffic control unit.

DepartureLeg.comment: A portion of a departure procedure as defined by two consecutive significant points.

DepartureLegCondition.comment: A condition which is established for a departure leg.

DepartureOperations.comment: The set of flight operations following procedures associated with the departure aerodrome.

DepartureSuspension.comment: The action through which a flight departure is suspended either by the AO (e.g. when the aircraft meets a severe technical problem) or by the APOP for any reason.

DesignatedPoint.comment: A geographical location not marked by the site of a radio navigation aid, used in defining an ATS route, the flight path of an aircraft or for other navigation or ATS purposes.

DiplomaticClearance.comment: A special permission for military transport aircraft of the participants to fly over each other country's territory and to land at and take-off from military and civilian airports (to the exception of the airports and/or areas specifically mentioned in a list of exempted airports and/or areas to be completed by each participant) whilst adhering to all national rules, international agreements, ICAO rules, restrictions described in the national military and civilian Aeronautical Information Publications, ATC regulations, NOTAMs or other special requirements.

DirectRoute.comment: A direct route that can be added to heterogeneous flight plan routes and can participate in route proposal triggering.

DirectionFinder.comment: An electronic device used to determine the position of a radio source by means of directional antennas, which receives the strongest radio signal when it is pointing directly at the transmitter.

DistanceIndication.comment: A distance reference from a significant point.

DistanceVerticalRangeType.comment: The area of variation of a vertical distance between upper and lower limits.

DurationWithPlanningType.comment: Describes the length or distance in the temporal dimension and allows the planning status to be recorded.

EmergencyPhase.comment: A generic term meaning, as the case may be, uncertainty phase, alert phase or distress phase.

EmissionFactor.comment: Measure of the average amount of a specific pollutant or material discharged into the atmosphere by a specific process, fuel, equipment, or source.

EnRouteDelay.comment: A delay planned to occur while en-route.

Engine.comment: A unit used or intended to be used for aircraft propulsion. It consists of at least those components and equipment necessary for functioning and control, but excludes the propeller/rotors (if applicable).

EngineRegime.comment: The engine regime (throttle position) of an aircraft.

Entity.comment: A definition (type) of an data (ATM) item of interest that is implementation independent and it is subject to constraints.

EquipmentUnavailableAdjustment.comment: Adjustments to minima when equipment is not available.

EquipmentUnavailableAdjustmentColumn.comment: Adjustments that need to be applied in case equipment is inoperative.

FacilityForHandicappedPersonService.comment: Facilities available at the airport for handicapped persons.

FinalApproachSegmentDataBlock.comment: The additional information about the Precision Final Segment. Most attributes describe the LPV path point record required for WAAS procedures.

FinalArrivalSafetyMitigationAdvice.comment: In the context of final arrival sequence, the advice for safety mitigation.

FinalArrivalSeparationAdvice.comment: In the context of final arrival sequence, the advice to ensure additional spacing required between each arrival pair taking into account their respective landing stabilisation speed profile intentions or characteristics.

FinalLeg.comment: A segment leg designed in accordance with the rules for final segments.

FinalProfile.comment: The profile view of a final segment defined for an approach procedure.

FireFightingService.comment: An airport service that provides rescue and fire fighting capabilities for aircraft in emergency at and around the airport.

Flight.comment: The operation of an aircraft which, in the case of a manned aircraft, takes place between the time any person boards the aircraft with the intention of flight until such time as all such persons have disembarked, or in the case of an unmanned aircraft, takes place between the time the aircraft is ready to move with the purpose of flight until such time as it comes to rest at the end of the flight and the primary propulsion system is shut down.

FlightCapability.comment: The capabilities of the flight comprising of the: a) presence of relevant serviceable equipment on board the aircraft; b) equipment and capabilities commensurate with flight crew qualifications; and c) where applicable, authorization from the appropriate authority.

FlightConditionCircumstance.comment: Circumstance related to the elementary condition (such as departing from an aerodrome), which is used to further refine the selection of flights being affected by the restriction.

FlightConditionCombination.comment: A combination of conditions involving: 1) an operator such as \"AND\", \"OR\", \"AND NOT\", \"SEQUENCE\", \"NONE\" and 2) one or more operands, each of these being either a condition element or another combination of conditions.

FlightConditionElement.comment: An operand in a flight condition combination.

FlightCrewApplicationAndApproval.comment: Equipment and procedures for which the air crew is qualified.

FlightDesignator.comment: Identifier of one or several consecutive IATA flight leg(s) operated by an airline.

FlightEnvelope.comment: The range of airspeeds, altitudes and normal load factors at which the aircraft can (safely) operate.

FlightInMeasure.comment: Impact of an ATFM measure on a flight.

FlightLevelChange.comment: A change of Flight Level during the execution of the Flight.

FlightPerformance.comment: The climbing and descending capabilities of the aircraft specific to the flight, taking into account the performance of the airframe that is used to operate the flight as well as any other parameters that may influence it such as engine settings and status, cost factor applied by the operator etc. The Flight Performance Data may be provided either as climb and descent performance profiles or as the total weight of aircraft as part of the 4D trajectory.

FlightPhase.comment: A period-in-time occurrence during a Flight.

FlightPhaseEfficiency.comment: Environmental related information for a specific phase of a flight. Different interpretations of phase exists. From the environmental point of view, phases are defined to include pre-flight and post-flight parts of a flight. This is needed to capture fuel burn, gaseous emissions and noise from the auxiliary power unit while aircraft is at stand.

FlightRestriction.comment: A rule meant to regulate the use of the route network, by identifying a set of flights which fulfil a combination of elementary flow conditions and either forbidding them on a particular routing or obliging them to follow one routing out of a set of mandatory alternatives.

FlightRestrictionLevel.comment: A single level or a level band associated with a flight restriction, either condition or routing element.

FlightRestrictionRoute.comment: A sequence of routing elements (points, route portions or airspace) that must/must not appear in the specified order in the flight plan of an aircraft fulfilling the conditions of the related Flight Restriction.

FlightRoutingElement.comment: An airspace, route or point that is concerned by a specified flight restriction.

FlightRulesChange.comment: A change of Flight Rules during the execution of the Flight.

FlightTypeChange.comment: A change of flight type during the execution of the Flight.

FloatingDockSite.comment: Floating facility which can serve as a mooring place for vessels or as a floating dry dock.

Flow.comment: A pattern of traffic catching flights by origin, destination and crossings.

FlowElement.comment: A location being either an aerodrome, a set of aerodromes, an airspace or a significant point.

FormationComponent.comment: A set of airframes that belong to one Unit and are of the same type.

FourDimensionalPointType.comment: Derived from GM_Point and extended to include properties for describing a three dimensional point with a time.

Fuel.comment: The type(s) of fuel available for aircraft and helicopters.

Gate.comment: Access to an airport terminal on the passenger side.

GeoEnabledEntity.comment: An entity which has a geospatial character.

GeoTemporalEnabledEntity.comment: An entity which is both geospatial in character and has temporal aspects.

GroundHandling.comment: Services necessary for an aircraft's arrival at, and departure from, an airport, other than air traffic services.

GroundLightSystem.comment: One or more light sources located on the ground that provide visual assistance for air and ground navigation.

GroundLightingAvailability.comment: Information about the operational status of a ground light.

GroundTrafficControlService.comment: An ATC service provided for the purpose of: (a) preventing collisions on the manoeuvring area between aircraft and between aircraft and obstacles or vehicles; and (b) expediting and maintaining an orderly flow of aircraft operating on the manoeuvring area.

GuidanceLine.comment: A line used to guide aircraft on and between airport movement areas.

GuidanceLineLightSystem.comment: The lighting system for the centreline guidance line.

GuidanceLineMarking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed as the guidance line.

HeadingChange.comment: A change of heading during the execution of the Flight.

HoldingArea.comment: A defined area within which aircraft performs an en-route or approach holding.

HoldingAssessment.comment: The geometry of surfaces that define altitude levels and the structure of an area used to evaluate obstacles for determining holding patterns.

HoldingProcedure.comment: A predetermined manoeuvre which keeps an aircraft within a specified airspace while awaiting further clearance.

HoldingUse.comment: The usage of the holding procedure on a segment.

HorizontalVisibility.comment: An aggregation of horizontal visibility conditions typically reported together at an aerodrome, including the prevailing visibility and minimum visibility.

IATAUniqueFlightIdentifier.comment: A composed key whose fields together define a unique IATA flight leg.

ICAOAircraftAddress.comment: The unique 24-bits address of the aircraft allocated by the registering authority of the State within which the aircraft is registered.

ILSGlidepath.comment: A component of an ILS consisting of a UHF transmitter radiating signals and providing a straight line descent path in the vertical plane containing the centre line of the runway served by the ILS, and thereby furnishing descent information down to the lowest authorized decision height or to the surface of a runway, depending on the Facility Performance Category of the ILS.

Icing.comment: Formation of ice, rime, or hoarfrost on an aircraft in flight.

IdentifierType.comment: An identifier used to identify one instance of an entity within an identification scheme that is managed by a formal organisation.

InBlock.comment: The arrival of the aircraft at its parking position.

InformationService.comment: A service that consists in the provision of aeronautical, meteorological, traffic and related information to aircraft crew and other actors involved in flight operations, in flight or on the ground.

InitialLeg.comment: A segment leg designed in accordance with the rules for initial segments.

InstrumentApproachProcedure.comment: A series of predetermined manoeuvres by reference to flight instruments with specified protection from obstacles from the initial approach fix, or where applicable, from the beginning of a defined arrival route to a point from which a landing can be completed and thereafter, if a landing is not completed, to a position at which holding or en-route obstacle clearance criteria apply.

InstrumentLandingSystem.comment: A combination of radio navigation services intended to facilitate aircraft in landing by providing lateral and vertical guidance including indications of distance from the optimum point of landing.

IntermediateLeg.comment: A segment leg designed in accordance with the rules for intermediate segments.

LTOEmissionsIndex.comment: The index for emission of a specific gas from an engine for a specific LTO phase. Based on the ICAO Engine Exhaust Emissions Data Bank.

LTOFuelFlowIndex.comment: The index for fuel flow for an engine for a specific LTO phase. Based on the ICAO Engine Exhaust Emissions Data Bank.

LandAndHoldShortOperationsMarking.comment: Marking used for Land and Hold Short Operations (LAHSO).

Landing.comment: Event in which an aircraft touches down.

LandingSequence.comment: The order in which two or more aircraft are planned to land taking into account ATM constraints.

LandingSequencing.comment: Descriptors of the flight status in the arrival management process.

LateralConstraint.comment: A restriction brought to the lateral component of the trajectory of an aircraft.

LevelConstraint.comment: A constraint defined by an objective to set the cleared flight level for the flight. This constraint can be: - A Cleared Flight Level. The category is "executive". - A Requested Flight Level. The category is "planning" - An En-route Cruise Level. The category is "flight_plan".

LightActivation.comment: The status and the intensity of an airborne controlled lighting system when activated by the pilot.

LightElement.comment: An elementary light source, part of a lighting system.

LightStatus.comment: The operational status of the light(s).

Localizer.comment: A component of an ILS consisting of a VHF transmitter, radiating signals in the direction served by the ILS, to provide a straight line descent path in the vertical plane containing the centre line of the runway.

LongitudinalSeparationMinima.comment: The minimum spacing between the estimated positions of the aircraft being separated. The spacing may be based on time or distance.

MCDMCoordination.comment: Coordination, in the context of Measure Collaborative Decision Making, for an ATFM measure or an action on a flight.

MCDMCoordinationUserCategoryInvolvement.comment: The involvement of an organisation within an MCDM Coordination for an ATFM measure.

MLSAzimuth.comment: A component of an MLS consisting of an SHF transmitter and associated equipment, radiating signals in a volume of airspace served by the MLS, thereby furnishing azimuth indications to aircraft approaching the runway or back azimuth indications to aircraft departing from the runway or performing a missed approach procedure.

MLSElevation.comment: A component of an MLS consisting of an SHF transmitter, and associated equipment radiating signals within a volume of airspace served by the MLS, thereby furnishing elevation information as an angular value to aircraft approaching the runway.

ManoeuvringArea.comment: That part of an aerodrome to be used for the take-off, landing and taxiing of aircraft, excluding aprons.

ManoeuvringAreaAvailability.comment: Information about the operational status of the manoeuvring area elements.

ManoeuvringAreaUsage.comment: A rule governing the usage of the manoeuvring area element.

ManufacturerConfiguration.comment: Predefined aircraft configuration specified and delivered by the manufacturer of the aircraft or aircraft equipment(s).

MarkerBeacon.comment: A radio navigation service identifying a particular location in space by means of a 75 megahertz (MHz) transmitter which transmits a directional signal to be received by aircraft flying overhead.

Marking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed on the surface of the movement area in order to convey aeronautical information.

MarkingBuoy.comment: A floating object moored to the bottom in a particular place, as an aid to navigation or for other specific purposes.

MarkingElement.comment: A symbol displayed on an aerodrome surface in order to convey aeronautical information.

MatterEmission.comment: The emanation of gas or particle pollutants due to the operation of aircraft.

MicrowaveLandingSystem.comment: A precision approach and landing guidance system operating in the microwave spectrum, which provides position information and various ground-to-air data.

MilitaryAuthority.comment: The military authority designated by the State.

MilitaryFlightActivity.comment: Action or movement performed by an aircraft or a group of aircraft used in military service which may pose a threat to civil aircraft and which should be coordinated with ATS authorities.

Minima.comment: Vertical and horizontal visual minima for a procedure segment conditions such as aircraft category, navigation equipment usage, procedure type, altimeter, etc.

MissedApproachLeg.comment: A segment leg designed in accordance with the rules for missed approach segments.

MissedApproachProcedure.comment: The procedure to be followed if the approach cannot be continued.

Mission.comment: Operation carried out by an aircraft or a group of aircraft used in military service.

MovementArea.comment: That part of an aerodrome to be used for the take-off, landing and taxiing of aircraft, consisting of the manoeuvring area and the apron(s).

MovementDescription.comment: Movement information associated with a phenomenon.

NDB.comment: A low or medium radio navigation service transmitting signals whereby the pilot of a suitably equipped aircraft can determine bearings, 'home in' on, and/or track to or from the station.

NavaidComponent.comment: The navigation use of a radio navigation aid as a component of the radio navigation service.

NavaidEquipmentDistance.comment: The distances between various runway centreline points and a radio navigation aid.

NavaidEquipmentMonitoring.comment: Information about the radio navigation aid monitoring.
