NavaidOperationalStatus.comment: Information about the operational status of the radio navigation aid.

NavigationArea.comment: An area specified by sectors with altitude or procedure descent gradient limitations for omnidirectional departures or Pilot navigation area.

NavigationAreaRestriction.comment: Area that is restricted from use for a procedure.

NavigationAreaSector.comment: Subdivision of a sector to allow for different altitudes or gradients.

NonMovementArea.comment: Area where aircraft cannot be seen by a control tower and therefore are restricted to move.

Object.comment: A standardized or formalized collection of an (CLDM) Entity's Property/(ies). Object does not exist without the (CLDM) Entity but can be part of the operational language or system-specific property.

ObjectWithSchedule.comment: An object with a repetitive time period, occurring cyclically.

Obscuration.comment: A weather phenomenon which reduces the visibility due to hydrometeor or lithometeor in suspension in the air.

ObstacleArea.comment: An area used for the purpose of collecting obstacle data, as necessary for air navigation systems or functions.

ObstacleAssessmentArea.comment: The geometry of surfaces used to define the altitude the length of a segment, holding pattern, etc., in function of the obstructions located in the area.

ObstaclePlacement.comment: Provides the location relative to a given point.

Obstruction.comment: The highest airspace, obstacle or terrain relative to a prescribed plane within a specified area.

OccupancyTrafficMonitoringValue.comment: A set of values (peak, sustain, overload duration, duration of counting) dedicated to monitor the instantaneous density of aircraft in a sector, as represented in occupancy counts.

OceanicClearance.comment: The information associated with an oceanic clearance.

OceanicRestriction.comment: The restriction data received from the pilot by an Oceanic Control Center about some clearance previously given to the pilot.

OffBlock.comment: The departure of the aircraft from its parking position.

OffBlockReady.comment: Event at which all doors of an aircraft are closed and departure will be possible immediately after reception of the ATC clearance.

Offset.comment: Linear displacement established parallel to a designated ATS route at a given distance and in a given direction from the centre line relative to the direction of flight.

Oil.comment: The type(s) of lubricating oil available for aircraft at an aerodrome.

OnlineContact.comment: On-line or Network information that can be used to contact the individual or organisation, including eMail address and web site page.

OperatorConfiguration.comment: Aircraft configuration established by an aircraft operator for its fleet.

Organisation.comment: A collection of people organized together into a community or other social, commercial or political structure. The group has some common purpose or reason for existence which goes beyond the set of people belonging to it, and can act as an agent.

OrganisationAssociation.comment: A type of hierarchical or associative relationship between two organisations showing ownership, supervision or membership.

OverArrivalPoint.comment: The event of flying over a significant point associated with the aerodrome of arrival.

OverPoint.comment: The event of flying over a significant point.

OxygenSupply.comment: The type(s) of oxygen supplies available for aviation usage.

ParkingConfiguration.comment: Grouping of non-overlapping aircraft parking positions: a single ParkingConfiguration defines a way to divide the stand's area into one or more non-overlapping parking positions.

PartialDelayApportionment.comment: The objective of delay absorption that the AMAN or EMAN sets to a given ATSU.

PassengerLoadingBridge.comment: A mechanically operated, adjustable ramp to provide direct passenger access between aircraft and buildings.

PassengerService.comment: The availability of passenger amenities and facilities at or in the vicinity of an aerodrome.

PhaseFuelEfficiency.comment: Information needed for assessment of the KPIs for fuel efficiency. This is information about number of movements and amount of fuel burn for the phase within a specific timeframe for a specific kind if airspace (LandingTake-Off, TerminalControlArea, En-Route). Derived from the number of movements and amount of fuel burn, the average fuel burn for each flight in the phase for the airspace kind is derived. The amount of fuel burn is derived from the fuel burn in related PhaseOfFlight.

PilotControlledLighting.comment: An indication that radio control of lighting is available to provide airborne control of lights by keying the aircraft's microphone.

PilotInCommand.comment: The pilot designated by the operator, or in the case of general aviation, the owner, as being in command and charged with the safe conduct of a flight.

PointReference.comment: The location of a significant point not marked by the site of a radio navigation aid defined using a combination of angles and distances based on the navaid system, radar system or special navigation system.

PositionMarking.comment: Location on the movement area surface used for Air Traffic Control clearances. Position marking could be a painted marking or a sign.

PostalAddress.comment: Physical address at which the organization or individual may be contacted.

PreDepartureSequence.comment: An ordered set of planned startup approval events used in departure management.

Precipitation.comment: Hydrometeor consisting of a fall of an ensemble of particles. The forms of precipitation are: rain, drizzle, snow, snow grains, snow pellets, diamond dust, hail and ice pellets.

PrecisionApproachRadar.comment: Primary radar equipment used to determine the position of an aircraft during final approach, in terms of lateral and vertical deviations relative to a nominal approach path, and in range relative to touchdown.

Procedure.comment: A series of predetermined manoeuvres with specified protection from obstacles.

ProcedureAvailability.comment: The status of the procedure for flight planning/operations.

ProcedureDME.comment: DME facilities that are used for a particular segment for DME/DME navigation.

ProcedureTransition.comment: A group of consecutive segments that are part of a branch on an approach procedure, SID or STAR.

Qualification.comment: A particular equipment or procedure qualification.

RadarComponent.comment: The use of a radar equipment as a component of the radar service provided by a radar system.

RadarSystem.comment: One or more radar equipments providing radar services.

RadioCommunicationChannel.comment: A radio frequency band of sufficient width and associated identification data used for one- or two-way communication from or to a transmitter on the ground or in the air.

RadioCommunicationOperationalStatus.comment: Information about the operational status of the radio communication channel.

RadioFrequencyArea.comment: A limitation, such as coverage, usability, etc., of a radio navigation aid or service frequency.

RadioNavigationAid.comment: Any electronic system which provides information to be used by the pilot or aircraft navigation systems for position determination or flight path guidance.

RadioNavigationService.comment: A service providing guidance information or position data for the efficient and safe operation of aircraft supported by one or more radio navigation aids.

Ranked4DTrajectories.comment: A series of desired 4D trajectories, with tolerances supplied if necessary by the airspace user to define when the next ranked trajectory should be used.

RateOfClimbOrDescentChange.comment: A change of rate of climb or descend during the execution of the Flight.

ReclearanceInFlight.comment: A contingency procedure taken in case of unexpected fuel burns according to which the crew can decide, at a certain point of the flight route, whether they will normally follow the filed route or they will land at an alternative aerodrome by following an alternative route.

ReferenceLocation.comment: A code used in the Network Manager (NM) Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management (ATFCM) systems to describe one or more aerodromes, an Air Traffic Control (ATC) waypoint or an entire ATC sector.

Reflector.comment: A reflector used with a precision approach radar.

RegulationRate.comment: The coordinated number of flights that can be accommodated in a certain time period.

Release.comment: The release of a flight from the agreed transfer conditions after initial co-ordination has taken place.

RevisionTimes.comment: Times to insert aircraft in sequence and remove aircraft from sequence.

Ridge.comment: Ridges of deposited material to the left or right of the runway, relative to the runway direction with the lowest designation number.

Road.comment: An established surface route on the movement area meant for the exclusive use of vehicles.

Route.comment: A specified route designed for channeling the flow of traffic as necessary for the provision of air traffic service (ATS) from the end of the take-off and initial climb phase to the commencement of the approach and landing phase.

RouteAvailability.comment: The operational availability of a route.

RouteCondition.comment: Weather observations and / or forecasts related to routes.

RouteDME.comment: DME facilities that are used for a particular route for DME/DME navigation.

RouteOrProcedureChange.comment: A change of reference ATS Route or procedure during the execution of the Flight, including lateral offset.

RoutePortion.comment: A group of two or more consecutive segments of the same route, which have the usage and/or the same flight restrictions.

RouteSegment.comment: A route or portion of route usually flown without an intermediate stop.

RulesProcedures.comment: An instruction or regulation that needs to be considered by personnel involved in flight operations in relation with an aerodrome or an airspace.

Runway.comment: A defined rectangular area on a land aerodrome prepared for the landing and take-off of aircraft.

RunwayBlastPad.comment: Specially prepared surface placed adjacent to the end of a runway to eliminate the erosive effect of the high wind forces produced by airplanes at the beginning of their take-off rolls.

RunwayCondition.comment: Weather observations and / or forecasts related to a runway. May be defined for single or multiple runways.

RunwayConfiguration.comment: Configuration of runway directions available for use in a given airport operational mode.

RunwayContamination.comment: The presence or removal of hazardous conditions due to snow, ice, slush, water, etc. on the runway surface.

RunwayDeclaredDistance.comment: A conventional operational distance declared for a runway direction.

RunwayDirection.comment: One of the two possible landing and/or take-off directions of a runway or Final Approach and Take-off Area (FATO).

RunwayDirectionLightSystem.comment: The lighting system provided for a landing and take-off direction, including the stopway lights.

RunwayExitLine.comment: Guidance line painted on the runway exit.

RunwayMarking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed on the surface of the runway in order to convey aeronautical information.

RunwayMixSequence.comment: The order in which two or more aircraft are planned to land on or take-off from a given runway in a given direction, taking into account ATM constraints. The Runway Mix Sequence consists of a Landing Sequence and a Take-off Sequence.

RunwayMode.comment: The intended use of a runway direction for flight operations in the context of a certain runway configuration.

RunwayOperationalConstraints.comment: The operational parameters constraining the use of the runway direction in the given active configuration.

RunwayProtectArea.comment: An area situated in the vicinity of a runway or provided to protect aircraft during manoeuvring, take-off and landing operations.

RunwayProtectAreaLightSystem.comment: The lighting for the runway protect area.

RunwaySectionContamination.comment: The presence or removal of hazardous conditions due to snow, ice, slush, water, etc. on a section of the runway surface.

RunwaySequencing.comment: Descriptors of the flight in the runway sequencing process

RunwayVisualRange.comment: The range over which the pilot of an aircraft on the centre line of a runway can see the runway surface markings or the lights delineating the runway or identifying its centre line.

SSRCode.comment: The number assigned to a particular multiple pulse reply signal transmitted by a transponder in Mode A or Mode C.

SafeAltitudeArea.comment: A set of Minimum Sector Altitudes which completely describe an area centred on a significant point, usually contained within a sector of 46km (25NM) radius.

SafeAltitudeAreaSector.comment: Subdivision of the Minimum Sector Altitudes to allow for lower altitudes.

Sea.comment: Large body of (salt-) water which can have a high meteorological impact on air-traffic taking place above it.

SeaCondition.comment: Weather observations or forecasts over a defined area of sea.

SeaplaneLandingArea.comment: A defined area on water at an aerodrome prescribed for the landing and take-off of seaplanes.

SeaplaneRampSite.comment: Ramps specifically designed to transit seaplanes from land to water and vice versa.

SearchAndRescueService.comment: The performance of distress monitoring, communication, coordination and search and rescue functions, initial medical assistance or medical evacuation, through the use of public and private resources, including cooperating aircraft, vessels and other craft and installations.

SecondarySurveillanceRadar.comment: A surveillance radar system which uses transmitters/receivers (interrogators) and transponders.

SectorConfiguration.comment: The four dimensional description of an ATS unit airspace sector, or group of sectors, which may be operated on a permanent or temporary basis.

SectorConfigurationActivation.comment: Information about the operational status of the sector configuration.

SectorDesign.comment: Design criteria used for the navigation area sector.

SegmentLeg.comment: A part of an instrument or visual flight procedure defined by two consecutive significant points.

Sensor.comment: A generic piece of equipment which detects targets and generates target reports.

SeparationMinima.comment: The minimum displacements between an aircraft and a hazard which maintain the risk of collision at an acceptable level of safety.

SeparationMode.comment: An approved set of rules, procedures and conditions of application associated with separation minima.

Service.comment: The provision of tangible goods, information, instructions or guidance.

ServiceAtApron.comment: A service that is provided for the movements at an apron. For example: Marshal management service.

ServiceAtGate.comment: A service that is provided at a gate.

ServiceAtStand.comment: A service that is provided for the movements at a stand. For example: visual docking guidance system.

ServiceOperationalStatus.comment: The operational status of the service.

ServiceProviderCallsign.comment: Information about the operational identifier by which the provider of the service is called and the language used.

SignificantPoint.comment: A specified geographical location used in defining an ATS route or the flight path of an aircraft and for other navigation and ATS purposes.

SimplifiedDirectionalFacility.comment: A radio navigation aid providing a final approach course similar to, but less precise than, that of the ILS localizer.

SlotAllocationList.comment: List of all slots corresponding to the regulation rate and period.

SlotAssignmentHistory.comment: Date at which the airport slot had been assigned to the flight.

SpecialDate.comment: A calendar date that has a special meaning for a particular state or organisation.

SpecialNavigationStation.comment: A land based station of a special navigation system.

SpecialNavigationStationStatus.comment: Information about the status of the special navigation station.

SpecialNavigationSystem.comment: Wide area (worldwide) navigation systems based on a chain of land or maritime stations providing radio frequency signals which can be used by airborne equipment to determine at least, the mobile two-dimensional position.

SpecialSSRCode.comment: SSR Code used in case of an emergency.

SpeedChange.comment: A change of speed during the execution of the Flight.

SpeedConstraint.comment: A restriction brought to the speed component of the trajectory of an aircraft.

SpeedRangeType.comment: The area of variation of a speed between upper and lower limits.

StandMarking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed on the surface of the Aircraft Stand.

StandardInstrumentArrival.comment: A designated instrument flight rule (IFR) arrival route linking a significant point, normally on an ATS route, with a point from which a published instrument approach procedure can be commenced.

StandardInstrumentDeparture.comment: A designated instrument flight rule (IFR) departure route linking the aerodrome or a specified runway of the aerodrome with a specified significant point, normally on a designated ATS route, at which the en-route phase of a flight commences.

StandardLevelColumn.comment: A column of consecutive cruising levels within a standard level table.

StandardLevelSector.comment: The general rule by which standard level columns are used in a national airspace or within a region.

StandardLevelTable.comment: A table of consecutive cruising levels described under vertical separation criteria limited by an upper and lower level and used by General Air Traffic.

StartUp.comment: The start up of the aircraft engines by the flight crew upon the ATC approval.

StartUpClearance.comment: Approval from air traffic control to proceed with the Start-Up.

StartUpSequencing.comment: Descriptors of the flight in the pre-departure sequencing process

State.comment: An internationally recognized geographic entity that provides air traffic service.

SupplementaryRate.comment: Supplementary rate information expressed by a regulation for a specific supplementary period, expressed as number of slots per hour.

SurfaceCharacteristics.comment: The characteristics of an aerodrome surface.

SurfaceContamination.comment: Presence or removal of hazardous conditions on aerodrome movement areas due to snow, ice, slush, water.

SurfaceContaminationLayer.comment: An operationally significant contaminant of homogeneous type such as snow, ice, slush, water, sand, etc., which is present on a large surface of the aerodrome area.

SurveillanceGroundStation.comment: Information about the ground station where the radar scope is utilised.

SurveillanceRadar.comment: Radar equipment used to determine the position of an aircraft in range and azimuth.

SurvivalEquipment.comment: Aircraft equipment that can be used by the crew and passengers to assist survival in harsh environments in case of emergency.

TACAN.comment: A navigation system developed by military and naval forces providing, as far as the navigating pilot is concerned and for suitably equipped aircraft, the same indication as a VOR/DME system.

TacticalRerouting.comment: An ATFM measure which requires an aircraft operator to file an alternate route/flight level in order to resolve ATC capacity problems and minimise delays.

TacticalReroutingConstraint.comment: A constraint on a tactical rerouting.

TacticalReroutingProposal.comment: A tactical rerouting proposal by the ATFM.

TakeOff.comment: Event in which an aircraft takes-off.

TakeOffConfiguration.comment: Aircraft configuration for a given flight. It is the configuration at "take-off".

TakeOffSequence.comment: An ordered set of planned Take-off events used in departure management.

TakeOffSequencing.comment: Descriptors of the flight in the take-off sequencing process

TaxiInClearance.comment: Information relating to the taxi-in clearance of an aircraft.

TaxiOutClearance.comment: The clearance provided by the tower ground controller to the aircraft for taxiing from the parking stand to the take-off runway.

TaxiRoute.comment: A predefined path from a Runway to an aircraft Stand (and vice versa). A taxi route is a sequence of taxiways.

Taxiway.comment: A defined path on a land aerodrome established for the taxiing of aircraft and intended to provide a link between one part of the aerodrome and another, including: a) Aircraft stand taxilane. A portion of an apron designated as a taxiway and intended to provide access to aircraft stands only. b) Apron taxiway. A portion of a taxiway system located on an apron and intended to provide a through taxi route across the apron. c) Rapid exit taxiway. A taxiway connected to a runway at an acute angle and designed to allow landing aeroplanes to turn off at higher speeds than are achieved on other exit taxiways thereby minimizing runway occupancy times.

TaxiwayConfiguration.comment: Configuration of taxiways available for use in a given airport operational mode.

TaxiwayContamination.comment: The presence or removal of hazardous conditions due to snow, ice, slush, water, etc. on the taxiway surface.

TaxiwayHoldingPosition.comment: A designated position at which taxiing aircraft and vehicles must stop and hold position, unless otherwise authorized by the aerodrome control tower.

TaxiwayHoldingPositionLightSystem.comment: Lighting system for a taxiway hold position.

TaxiwayHoldingPositionMarking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed on the surface of a Taxiway indicating the location of the Taxiway Holding Position.

TaxiwayIntersectionMarking.comment: A marking painted at a position at which taxiing aircraft and vehicles are expected to stop and hold until further cleared to proceed, when so instructed by the aerodrome control tower.

TaxiwayLightSystem.comment: The lighting system provided for a taxiway at an aerodrome.

TaxiwayMarking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed on the surface of the taxiway.

TelephoneContact.comment: Telephone numbers at which the organisation or individual may be contacted.

TemporalEnabledEntity.comment: An entity which has a lifecycle, including a start of life, an end of life and various states along its life.

Terminal.comment: An installation on an aerodrome with facilities for loading and unloading aircraft and processing traffic (passengers, baggage, cargo and mail).

TerminalArrivalAltitude.comment: The lowest altitude that will provide a minimum clearance of 300 m (1 000 ft) above all objects located in an arc of a circle defined by a 46 km (25 NM) radius centred on the initial approach fix (IAF), or where there is no IAF on the intermediate approach fix (IF), delimited by straight lines joining the extremity of the arc to the IF. The combined TAAs associated with an approach procedure shall account for an area of 360 degrees around the IF.

TerminalArrivalAreaSector.comment: Subdivision of the TAA to allow for lower altitudes. The lowest altitude will provide a minimum clearance of 300m (1000ft) above all objects located in the sector.

ThreeDimensionalCurveType.comment: Derived from GM_Curve and extended to include properties that represent the vertical position (elevation, datum, accuracy).

ThreeDimensionalPointType.comment: Derived from GM_Point and extended to include properties for describing a point with elevation and vertical extent.

ThreeDimensionalSurfaceType.comment: Derived from GM_Surface and extended to include properties that represent the vertical position (elevation, datum, accuracy).

TimeConstraint.comment: A restriction brought to the time component of the trajectory of an aircraft.

TimeRangeType.comment: The area of variation of a time between earlier and later limits.

Timesheet.comment: The definition of a single time interval, that occurs repeatedly as part of a schedule.

TouchDownLiftOff.comment: A load bearing area on which a helicopter may touch down or lift off.

TouchDownLiftOffContamination.comment: The presence or removal of hazardous conditions due to snow, ice, slush, water, etc. on the Touch Down and Lift-Off (TLOF) surface.

TouchDownLiftOffLightSystem.comment: The lighting system provided for a touch down and lift-off surface at an aerodrome.

TouchDownLiftOffMarking.comment: A symbol or group of symbols displayed on the surface of the touch down and lift-off area at an aerodrome.

TouchDownLiftOffSafeArea.comment: An obstacle-free area situated in the vicinity of a touchdown and lift-off area, provided to protect helicopters during manoeuvring, take-off and / or landing operations.

TrackDirectionChange.comment: A change of track direction during the execution of the Flight.

TrafficCount.comment: The number of aircraft on a location during a time period.

TrafficSeparationService.comment: A service that provides control and separation services, to aircraft in the air and on the ground.

TrafficVolume.comment: A set of conditions used to identify the flights over an airspace, point, aerodrome or set of aerodromes so that they can be monitored or regulated within the tactical/pre-tactical Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management (ATFCM) system.

TrafficVolumeActivation.comment: Information about the operational status of the traffic volume.

TrafficVolumeLinkedFlow.comment: The role a flow fulfils within a traffic volume.

TrafficVolumeSet.comment: A set of Traffic volumes relating to a single Flow Management Position (FMP).

Trajectory.comment: The description of movement of an aircraft both in the air and on the ground including position, time, and at least via calculation, speed and acceleration.

TrajectoryConstraint.comment: Any restriction brought to the trajectory of an aircraft, being either a tactical constraint such as air traffic controller instruction, or a strategic constraint derived from the operations of the network.

TrajectoryElement.comment: A group of two or more consecutive trajectory segments of the same trajectory.

TrajectoryPoint.comment: A four dimensional point used in defining the flight path of an aircraft.

TrajectorySegment.comment: A line connecting consecutive trajectory points.

TransferData.comment: Data exchanged during the transfer phase. The receiving controller can issue: - A speed - A rate of climb / descent - A heading - A flight level - A supplementary flight level which become constraints of the trajectory.

TropicalCyclone.comment: Cyclone of tropical origin of small diameter (some hundreds of kilometres) with minimum surface pressure in some cases less than 900 hPa, very violent winds and torrential rain; sometimes accompanied by thunderstorms. It usually contains a central region, known as the "eye" of the storm, with a diameter of the order of some tens of kilometres, and with light winds and more or less lightly clouded sky.

Tropopause.comment: The boundary between the troposphere and the stratosphere, where an abrupt change in lapse rate usually occurs.

Turbulence.comment: Atmospheric flow regime characterized by chaotic and stochastic property changes. This includes low momentum diffusion, high momentum convection, and rapid variation of pressure and velocity in space and time.

TwoDimensionalCurveType.comment: Derived from GM_Curve and extended to include Horizontal Accuracy properties

TwoDimensionalPointType.comment: Derived from GM_Point and extended to include Horizontal Accuracy properties

TwoDimensionalSurfaceType.comment: Derived from GM_Surface and extended to include Horizontal Accuracy properties

Unit.comment: A generic term referring to all types of entities providing all types of ATM related services.

UnitAvailability.comment: Status and scheduling information about a unit.

UnitDependency.comment: The operational or functional relationship between two related units.

UnplannedHolding.comment: A specific holding procedure requested at an en-route fix on airway or route radials, bearings, or courses.

UsageCondition.comment: A rule governing the usage of an aerodrome or one of its surfaces.

VOR.comment: A short-range, very-high-frequency omnidirectional beacon which provides an indication in the aircraft of the bearing of the beacon, or left-right track indication.

ValAccelerationType.comment: Calculated acceleration of the target expressed in Cartesian co-ordinates.

ValAltitudeType.comment: The vertical distance of a level, a point or an object considered as a point, measured from mean sea level (MSL).

ValAltitudeWithBoundaryType.comment: An altitude contained within given limits.

Aerodrome-dateMagneticVariation.comment: The date on which an associated magnetic variation was measured at the aerodrome.

Aerodrome-designatorIATA.comment: The identifier that is assigned to a location in accordance with rules (resolution 767) governed by the International Air Transport Association (IATA).

Aerodrome-locationIndicatorICAO.comment: A four-letter code group formulated in accordance with rules prescribed by ICAO and assigned to the aerodrome.

Aerodrome-magneticVariation.comment: The angular difference between True North and Magnetic North measured at a given position and date.

Aerodrome-magneticVariationAccuracy.comment: The accuracy of the magnetic variation.

Aerodrome-magneticVariationChange.comment: The annual rate of change of the magnetic variation at a specified aerodrome.

Aerodrome-name.comment: The primary official name of an aerodrome as designated by an appropriate authority.

Aerodrome-transitionLevel.comment: The lowest flight level available for use above the transition altitude.

AerodromeHotSpot-designator.comment: An identifier by which the hot spot is labelled on airport maps.

AerodromeHotSpot-instruction.comment: Action to be taken by the crew and/or vehicle drivers when approaching a hot spot at the aerodrome.

AerodromeSet-designator.comment: Designator of the aerodrome set as defined by the Network Manager.

AerodromeSet-name.comment: Textual description of the aerodromes which compose the aerodrome set.

AerodromeSign-messageOnBack.comment: The text and graphics appearing in the back message inscription of the sign.

AerodromeSign-messageOnFront.comment: The text and graphics appearing in the front message inscription of the sign.

AerodromeSign-signDirection.comment: The bearing from true north which the front message side of the sign faces.

AerodromeTerrain-maximumGradient.comment: Maximum surface normal angle (gradient) magnitude of terrain near the movement area

AerodromeTerrain-maximumTerrainElevation.comment: Maximum terrain elevation near the movement area

AerodromeTerrain-meanTerrainElevation.comment: Mean terrain elevation near the movement area.

AerodromeTerrain-minimumTerrainElevation.comment: Minimum terrain elevation near the movement area

AerodromeTerrain-standardElevationDeviat.comment: Standard deviation for terrain elevations near the movement area

AerodromeTerrain-standardGradientDeviati.comment: Standard deviation for surface normal angles (gradient) of terrain near the movement area.

AeronauticalGroundLight-name.comment: The name by which the ground light is known.

AeroplaneConfiguration-flaps.comment: The specific setting of the flaps of an aircraft.

AeroplaneConfiguration-slats.comment: The specific setting of the slats of an aircraft.

Aircraft-aircraftRegistration.comment: A unique, alphanumeric string that identifies a civil aircraft and consists of the Aircraft Nationality or Common Mark and an additional alphanumeric string assigned by the state of registry or common mark registering authority.

Aircraft-militaryAircraftCallsign.comment: The aircraft callsign for a military aircraft.

Aircraft-selectiveCallingCode.comment: SELCAL code, for aircraft so equipped.

AircraftDirection-heading.comment: The direction in which the longitudinal axis of an aircraft is pointed, usually expressed in degrees from North (true, magnetic, compass or grid).

AircraftDirection-trackDirection.comment: The direction of the track at the current aircraft position, usually expressed in degrees from North (true, magnetic or grid).

AircraftGroundService-capacity.comment: The number of aircraft which can be handled by the service.

AircraftOperator-designatorIATA.comment: The identifier of the AircraftOperator as assigned by IATA.

AircraftOperator-designatorICAO.comment: The identifier of the AircraftOperator as assigned by ICAO.

AircraftStand-designator.comment: The designator of an aircraft stand used to uniquely identify it at an aerodrome.

AircraftStandConfiguration-standConfigur.comment: Percentage of the time where this stand configuration is used rather than another one for the same airport.

AircraftType-iataIdentifier.comment: The IATA identification of an aircraft type.

AircraftType-icaoIdentifier.comment: The ICAO designator of an aircraft type as published in ICAO doc 8643.

AircraftType-operationalName.comment: Operational name or short description. It is the name of an AircraftType as it might be encountered in field 18 TYP/ or as it is referred to in plain language. The first name in the list will be considered as the generic or primary name.

AirportClearanceService-snowPlan.comment: A description of the snow removal priorities.

AirportSlot-allocatedSlotTime.comment: Time allocated by the Slot Coordinator to the airport slot at which the movement can take place

AirportSlot-requestedSlotTime.comment: Time requested by the Airspace User

AirportSlot-yearIATASeason.comment: Year in which the scheduling season starts.

Airspace-designator.comment: A published sequence of characters allowing the identification of the airspace.

Airspace-localType.comment: A type designator used locally inside a State or a Region for a particular airspace sub-category.

Airspace-locationIndicatorICAO.comment: A four-letter code group formulated in accordance with rules prescribed by ICAO and assigned to the airspace.

Airspace-name.comment: The name given to an airspace by a responsible authority.

Airspace-skipIn.comment: The minimum duration of an entry event in an Airspace before to leave the same Airspace, to be considered as a real entry event.

Airspace-skipOut.comment: The minimum duration of an exit event out an Airspace before to re-enter in the same Airspace, to be considered as a real exit event.

Airspace-upperLowerSeparation.comment: A flight level that indicates the division of airspace between lower and upper airspace.

AirspaceGeometryComponent-operationSeque.comment: An indicator of the order of the component in an aggregation.

AngleIndication-angle.comment: The angle between the bearing and the North reference.

AngleRangeType-lower.comment: The lower limit of the angle range.

AngleRangeType-upper.comment: The upper limit of the angle range.

ApproachCondition-climbGradient.comment: The capability of an aircraft to climb with a certain gradient in take-off configuration.

ApproachCondition-requiredNavigationPerf.comment: The minimum navigation performance accuracy required in an airspace. It is the navigation performance accuracy of all the user and navigation system combinations within an airspace.

ApproachTimingTable-time.comment: The duration of the flight between the start point and the end point.

Apron-name.comment: The name or designator used to identify an apron at an aerodrome which has more than one apron.

ArrivalFeederLeg-requiredNavigationPerfo.comment: The minimum navigation performance accuracy required in an airspace. It is the navigation performance accuracy of all the user and navigation system combinations within an airspace.

ArrivalLeg-requiredNavigationPerformance.comment: The minimum navigation performance accuracy required in an airspace. It is the navigation performance accuracy of all the user and navigation system combinations within an airspace.

ArrivalManagementAdvisory-timeToGainOrLo.comment: An arrival management advisory in the form of the amount of time that a flight is supposed to lose or gain to arrive at the metering fix to land at the AMAN Planned Threshold Time (APTT).

ArrivalManagementAdvisory-timeToLoseOrGa.comment: Ground Delay proposed to be applied at the departure aerodrome in order to land at the AMAN Planned Threshold Time (APTT).

ArrivalManagementHorizon-remainingFlight.comment: Horizon definition by remaining (estimated) time of flight

AuxiliaryPowerUnit-fuelBurnCharacteristi.comment: Amount of fuel burned per time unit during normal operations.

AviationCondition-maximumAirTemperatureT.comment: The time of the occurrence of the maximum air temperature.

AviationCondition-minimumAirTemperatureT.comment: The time of the occurrence of the minimum air temperature.

AviationCondition-relativeHumidity.comment: At a given pressure and temperature, the percentage ratio of the gram-molecular weight of the water vapour to the gram-molecular weight that the air would have if it were saturated with respect to water at the same pressure and temperature.

Capacity-monitoringValue.comment: The agreed number of flights accepted to enter into a reference location per rolling hour beyond which coordinated actions may be considered between the concerned parties in order to better balance the traffic load.

CircleSector-fromAngle.comment: The angle from which the interpolation of the arc starts.

CircleSector-toAngle.comment: The angle at which the interpolation of the arc ends.

ContactInformation-name.comment: The official name of the contact.

ContactInformation-title.comment: The official title of the contact.

Contour-contourValue.comment: The value of the measure that applies to that contour. For example a pressure chart could have contours where each contour line represents a specific pressure value, this could be sorted in the contourValue.

CoordinationAndTransferConstraint-supple.comment: The flight level at or above which, or, at or below which, the aircraft will cross the Boundary Point.

CoordinationAndTransferConstraint-transf.comment: The flight level at which the aircraft will cross the boundary point.

CoordinationConditions-supplementaryFlig.comment: The level at which the aircraft is likely to pass the boundary between two controllers' areas of responsibility while in evolution.

CoordinationConditions-timeOverCoordinat.comment: The time at which the flight is estimated, or calculated to pass, or actually passes, the coordination point.

CoordinationConditions-transferFlightLev.comment: The flight level at which a flight has been or will be co-ordinated to cross one point (flight level number), if in level flight, or the cleared level to which it is proceeding if climbing or descending at the boundary point.

Deicing-deicingDuration.comment: The forecast duration of the de-icing procedure.

DeltaEmission-deicer.comment: The change which can be attributed to deicing.

DepartureLeg-requiredNavigationPerforman.comment: The minimum navigation performance accuracy required in an airspace. It is the navigation performance accuracy of all the user and navigation system combinations within an airspace.

DesignatedPoint-name.comment: The full textual name of a designated point.

DiplomaticClearance-clearanceNumber.comment: European permanent or blanket diplomatic clearance number for the calendar year or one or more national diplomatic clearance numbers.

EmergencyPhase-actionTaken.comment: A description of an action taken by an Air Traffic Service unit, in the event of search and rescue.

EmergencyPhase-communicationDefect.comment: An issue in the communication between the ground and the flight.

EmergencyPhase-timeAtLastReportedPositio.comment: Time at last reported aircraft position.

EmergencyPhase-timeOfLastTwoWayContact.comment: Time of the last two-way contact with the aircraft.

EmissionFactor-factor.comment: The value to use in the measurement.

EnRouteDelay-delay.comment: The duration of the en-route delay.

EngineRegime-correctedNetThrust.comment: The corrected net thrust for the engine type.

EngineRegime-enginePressureRatio.comment: The core engine exhaust pressure compared to the intake pressure.

EngineRegime-percentN1.comment: Engine regime expressed as the ratio of the low pressure fan speed (%N1)

EngineRegime-percentOfMaxRatedThrust.comment: Engine regime expressed by % of the maximum rated thrust for the engine type.

Entity-contextUsage.comment: The intended purpose of the data, whether that data is intended for publication, future development, research and development, or future predictions.

Entity-lifecycleStageStatus.comment: The lifecycle stage of data to enable controls, such as allowing or prohibiting changes to data that is in a specific status, or making data available to other systems when it is in a certain status.

FacilityForHandicappedPersonService-numb.comment: The number of other equipments available at the airport for handicapped persons.
The number of wheel chair high loaders available at the airport.

FinalApproachSegmentDataBlock-approachPe.comment: Approach Performance Designator. A number from 0 to 7 that identifies the type of approach.

FinalApproachSegmentDataBlock-codeICAO.comment: The first two designators of the ICAO location identifier, as identified in ICAO Doc 7910.

FinalApproachSegmentDataBlock-horizontal.comment: The radius of a circle in the horizontal plane (the local plane tangent to the WGS-84 ellipsoid), with its centre being at the true position, which describes the region which is required to contain the indicated horizontal position with the required probability for a particular navigation mode assuming the probability of a GPS satellite integrity failure being included in the position solution is less than or equal to E-4 per hour.

FinalApproachSegmentDataBlock-operationT.comment: Operation Type. A number from 0 to 15 that indicates the type of the final approach segment.

FinalApproachSegmentDataBlock-referenceP.comment: Reference Path Data Selector (RPDS). A number (0-48) that enables automatic tuning of a procedure by LAAS avionics.
Reference Path Identifier. A four-character identifier that is used to confirm selection of the correct approach procedure.

FinalApproachSegmentDataBlock-routeIndic.comment: Route Indicator. A single alpha character (A through Z or blank, omitting I and O) used to differentiate between multiple final approach segments to the same runway or heliport.

FinalApproachSegmentDataBlock-satelliteB.comment: SBAS Service Provider Identifier. A number from 0 to 15 that associates the approach procedure to a particular satellite based approach system service provider.

FinalApproachSegmentDataBlock-verticalAl.comment: Half the length of a segment on the vertical axis (perpendicular to the horizontal plane of WGS-84 ellipsoid), with its centre being at the true position, which describes the region which is required to contain the indicated vertical position with a probability of 1-E-7 per approach, assuming the probability of a GPS satellite integrity failure being included in the position solution is less than or equal to E-4 per hour.

FinalLeg-courseOffsetAngle.comment: The offset angle between the final approach course and the extended runway centreline.

Flight-fuelEndurance.comment: The estimated maximum length of time the aircraft can spend in the cruise phase of flight, determined by the amount of fuel at take-off.

Flight-globallyUniqueFlightIdentifier.comment: The reference of a flight that is unique for all eligible members of the global ATM Community.

Flight-ifplIdentifier.comment: A unique flight plan identifier allocated by the IFPS.

Flight-numberOfAircraft.comment: Number of aircraft flying in a formation in which the aircraft are governed by one flight plan.

Flight-operatorFlightPriority.comment: Value between 0 and 100 that the flight operator assigns to the aircraft to indicate a relative level or priority among its aircrafts arriving in a given airport in case of traffic, in order to assign delays.

Flight-totalEstimatedElapsedTime.comment: For IFR flights, the estimated time required from take-off to arrive over that designated point, defined by reference to navigation aids, from which it is intended that an instrument approach procedure will be commenced, or, if no navigation aid is associated with the destination aerodrome, to arrive over the destination aerodrome. For VFR flights, the estimated time required from take-off to arrive over the destination aerodrome.

FlightConditionElement-index.comment: A sequence number used to indicate the order of the operand when composing the flight condition combination.

FlightConfiguration-auxiliaryPowerUnitFu.comment: The fuel flow for the auxilliary power unit of aircraft at a specific time during a flight in terms of amount per time unit.

FlightConfiguration-mainEnginesFuelFlow.comment: The fuel flow for the main engines of an aircraft at a specific time during a flight in terms of amount per time unit.

FlightEnvelope-maxCruiseLevel.comment: The max_cruise_level is specific to this aircraft. It gives the flight envelope. It will be used by TP to correct the offline speed rules, etc. (could be in Aircraft or ground Trajectory)

FlightLevelChange-flightLevel.comment: The new flight level when the flight level change is completed.

FlightPhase-cruisingLevel.comment: Flight level at which an aircraft flies during the cruise phase.

FlightPhase-preferredCruiseFlightLevel.comment: The aircraft operator expresses a preference to the ATSU for cruise level.

FlightPhase-preferredDescentAngle.comment: For Air Ground cooperative air traffic services and especially for Pilot Preferences Downlink services, this data is part of the Aircrew's preferences on the way the flight is to be conducted for various operational reasons. In order to elaborate pertinent control strategies, Controllers need to be aware of these preferences.

FlightPhaseEfficiency-auxiliaryPowerUnit.comment: The amount of auxiliary power unit fuel burn during the flight phase.

FlightPhaseEfficiency-mainEnginesFuelBur.comment: The amount of main engines fuel burn during phase of flight.

FlightPhaseEfficiency-operationalConcept.comment: Operational concept parameters (e.g. ATC procedure) are affecting the aspects of the flight related to environment.

FlightRestriction-designator.comment: A coded value which identifies the restriction.

FlightRestriction-instruction.comment: A description of the operational instructions which form the flight restriction.

FlightRoutingElement-orderNumber.comment: A number in sequence used to indicate the order of the routing element in the flight restriction routing to which it belongs.

Flow-designator.comment: The designator of the stream condition.

FormationComponent-numberOfAircraft.comment: Number of aircraft with the same aircraft type in the fleet of one unit

FourDimensionalPointType-horizontalConfi.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

FourDimensionalPointType-temporalAccurac.comment: The difference between the recorded time of an entity and its true time.

FourDimensionalPointType-time.comment: The time corresponding to the point.

FourDimensionalPointType-verticalConfide.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

Gate-designator.comment: The textual designator of the gate. For example, 13, 84 A, etc..

GeoBorder-name.comment: The name of the geographical border.

GeoEnabledEntity-curveExtent.comment: The geometry of the entity expressed as a curve which is a connected sequence of points.

GeoEnabledEntity-position.comment: The geometry of the entity expressed as the position of a point on the surface of the Earth.

GeoEnabledEntity-surfaceExtent.comment: The geometry of the entity expressed as a surface or area described by a closed line.

GeoEnabledEntity-volume.comment: The geometry of the entity expressed as a volume.

GuidanceLine-designator.comment: The identifier of a guidance line on a taxiway.

HeadingChange-assignedHeading.comment: The heading that the flight is requested to follow.

HoldingProcedure-inboundCourse.comment: The radial, course or bearing of the inbound leg as it pertains to a holding procedure.

HoldingProcedure-instruction.comment: Operational instructions that must be observed when flying the holding procedure.

HoldingProcedure-outboundCourse.comment: The outbound course (for example, true track, magnetic track, heading, VOR radial, true bearing, magnetic bearing) from the significant point on which holding is based.

HoldingProcedure-outboundLegEndTime.comment: The duration of the holding pattern outbound leg.

HoldingUse-instruction.comment: Operational instruction concerning the use of the holding procedure in relation with a procedure.

IATAUniqueFlightIdentifier-originFlightD.comment: The UTC scheduled date of departure of a flight.

IATAUniqueFlightIdentifier-repeatNumber.comment: The number of the attempt to operate a flight, if more than one attempt were conducted by the aircraft operator.

ICAOAircraftAddress-codeBlock.comment: The code allocated to the aircraft.

ICAOAircraftAddress-headerBlock.comment: The header that identifies the country of registration of the aircraft.

ILSGlidepath-angleAccuracy.comment: Accuracy of the glide path angle.

ILSGlidepath-slope.comment: The angle of the glide path.

Icing-accretionRate.comment: Ratio of growth of the ice deposit.

IdentifierType-schemeAgencyIdentifier.comment: The identification of the agency that manages the identifier scheme.

IdentifierType-schemeIdentifier.comment: The identification of the identifier scheme.

IdentifierType-schemeVersionIdentifier.comment: The identification of the version of the identifier scheme.

InitialLeg-requiredNavigationPerformance.comment: The minimum navigation performance accuracy required in an airspace. It is the navigation performance accuracy of all the user and navigation system combinations within an airspace.

InstrumentApproachProcedure-channelGNSS.comment: Operating channel of electronic transceiving equipment.

InstrumentApproachProcedure-copterTrack.comment: The final approach track value for copter procedures.

InstrumentApproachProcedure-courseRevers.comment: Operational instruction that must be observed for procedure turns and tear drops.

IntermediateLeg-requiredNavigationPerfor.comment: The minimum navigation performance accuracy required in an airspace. It is the navigation performance accuracy of all the user and navigation system combinations within an airspace.

LTOFuelFlowIndex-fuelFlow.comment: The fuel flow for an engine for a specific LTO engine mode. Expressed in kg/sec.

Landing-landingTolerance.comment: The tolerance with which the Target Landing time is required to be achieved by the Aircraft.

LandingSequence-arrivalManagementStrateg.comment: The name of the set of operational rules and procedures underlying the AMAN tool optimisation algorithm. The strategy implements the trade-off between the goals of equity, high throughput, and trajectory efficiency which has agreed between the stakeholders.

LandingSequencing-landingSequencePositio.comment: The position of a given aircraft in the Arrival Sequence, relative to other Aircraft and the runway threshold.
The time at which landing sequence management plans to freeze the sequence position of the flight

LevelConstraint-executionKind.comment: The way to execute the order.

LightActivation-clicks.comment: The number of clicks on the microphone required for activation of airborne controlled lights at a particular intensity step.

Localizer-declination.comment: The angular difference between True North and the station declination (Magnetic North - as indicated by the station).

Localizer-magneticBearing.comment: The measured angle between the localizer beam and Magnetic North at the localizer antenna.

Localizer-magneticBearingAccuracy.comment: Accuracy of the measured angle between the localizer beam and Magnetic North at the localizer antenna.

Localizer-trueBearing.comment: The measured angle between the localizer beam and True North at the localizer antenna.

Localizer-trueBearingAccuracy.comment: Accuracy of the measured angle between the localizer beam and True North at the localizer antenna.

Localizer-widthCourse.comment: The localizer course width, in degrees.

Localizer-widthCourseAccuracy.comment: Accuracy of the localizer course width, in degrees.

MCDMCoordination-timeToCoordinate.comment: The deadline to finish the coordination activities.

MCDMCoordination-timeToImplement.comment: The deadline to finish the implementation activities.

MCDMCoordination-timeToStartImplementati.comment: The deadline to start the implementation activities.

MLSAzimuth-angleCoverLeft.comment: The value of the angle from the zero indication direction within which the azimuth indication is usable, and left of this direction from the azimuth antenna.

MLSAzimuth-angleCoverRight.comment: The value of the angle from the zero indication direction within which the azimuth indication is usable, and right of this direction from the azimuth antenna.

MLSAzimuth-angleProportionalLeft.comment: The value of the angle within which the azimuth indication is proportional to the deviation from the azimuth zero indication direction, and left of this direction from the azimuth antenna.

MLSAzimuth-angleProportionalRight.comment: The value of the angle within which the azimuth indication is proportional to the deviation from the azimuth zero indication direction, and right of this direction from the azimuth antenna.

MLSAzimuth-magneticBearing.comment: The measured angle between the direction of the azimuth beam and Magnetic North at the azimuth antenna.

MLSAzimuth-trueBearing.comment: The measured angle between the azimuth beam and True North at the azimuth antenna.

MLSAzimuth-trueBearingAccuracy.comment: Accuracy of the measured angle between the azimuth beam and True North at the azimuth antenna

MLSElevation-angleMinimum.comment: The value of the lowest elevation angle authorized for an MLS procedure.

MLSElevation-angleNominal.comment: The normal glide path angle for the MLS installation.

MLSElevation-angleSpan.comment: The value of the span angle of the elevation transmitter signal between the lower and the upper limits.

ManufacturerConfiguration-maximumNumberO.comment: The maximum number of passengers carried on an aircraft.

MarkerBeacon-auralMorseCode.comment: The Morse code transmitted by the beacon.

MarkerBeacon-axisBearing.comment: The true bearing of the minor axis of the marker beacon.

MarkingBuoy-designator.comment: Official number of the marking buoy at a seaplane landing area.

MissedApproachLeg-requiredNavigationPerf.comment: The minimum navigation performance accuracy required in an airspace. It is the navigation performance accuracy of all the user and navigation system combinations within an airspace.

MissedApproachProcedure-alternateClimbIn.comment: A second climb-to-altitude provided on a missed approach based off the remote altimeter source.

MissedApproachProcedure-instruction.comment: Operational instructions that must be observed when flying the Missed Approach.

Mission-name.comment: A free text name by which the mission is known.

MovementDescription-directionTowards.comment: Heading of the movement of a meteorological phenomenon.

NavaidComponent-collocationGroup.comment: A number identifying the collocation group to which the radio navigation aid belongs.

ObjectWithSchedule-specialDateAuthority.comment: The organisation responsible for the special dates within the schedule.

ObstacleAssessmentArea-gradientLowHigh.comment: Low to high gradient within the airspace.

ObstacleAssessmentArea-safetyRegulation.comment: Identifier for the safety regulations in effect within the zone.

ObstacleAssessmentArea-sectionNumber.comment: A sequence number indicating a part of an assessment area.

ObstacleAssessmentArea-slope.comment: The slope value of the extent.

ObstaclePlacement-obstacleBearing.comment: The bearing from a given point to the obstruction.

ObstaclePlacement-pointType.comment: The type of point referenced when determining the bearing and distance to the obstruction.

Obstruction-slopePenetration.comment: A value calculated by dividing 102.0 (a constant) with the angle of the glidepath.

OccupancyTrafficMonitoringValue-crossing.comment: Number of crossing occurrences of the sustained threshold within elapsed, before the Occupancy Traffic Monitoring Value (OTMV) triggers an alert.

OccupancyTrafficMonitoringValue-elapsed.comment: Duration of the time window on which the crossing occurrences are counted.

OccupancyTrafficMonitoringValue-overload.comment: Maximum duration beyond which a potential hotspot should be considered in case the occupancy count exceeds the sustain threshold.

OccupancyTrafficMonitoringValue-peakThre.comment: Maximum number of flight that could be handled by a sector.

OccupancyTrafficMonitoringValue-sustaine.comment: Acceptable number of flights that could be handled by a sector under specific circumstance, in particular if the duration of the overload is not too long.

OceanicClearance-flightLevel.comment: The entry flight level of the aircraft in the oceanic area.

OceanicRestriction-timeIntervalRestricti.comment: Time interval constraint to respect, with respect to an earlier flight.

OffBlockReady-tobtUpdateCount.comment: The number of updates of TOBT after TSAT has been issued.

OnlineContact-eMail.comment: The address of the electronic mailbox of the responsible organisation or individual.

OnlineContact-linkage.comment: A contact's location (address) for on-line access using a Uniform Resource Locator address or similar addressing scheme.

OnlineContact-protocol.comment: The connection protocol to be used for accessing an contact's online resource.

OperatorConfiguration-numberOfSeats.comment: The number of seats installed on the aircraft.

Organisation-commonMark.comment: A mark assigned by the International Civil Aviation Organization to the common mark registering authority registering aircraft of an international operating agency on other than a national basis.

Organisation-designator.comment: A distinguishing label, term, abbreviation or acronym used to identify an organisation, authority, agency or unit.

Organisation-name.comment: The full official name of the organisation.

Organisation-nationalityMark.comment: A nationality symbol included in the radio call signs allocated to the State of Registry by the International Telecommunication Union.

ParkingConfiguration-designator.comment: A name identifying a Parking Configuration.

PartialDelayApportionment-partialTimeToL.comment: The elementary delay to be absorbed by a given ATSU traversed by the flight.

PhaseFuelEfficiency-fuelEfficiency.comment: The fuel efficiency calculated based on baseline and current average fuel burn for phase. Expressed in percent.

PhaseFuelEfficiency-numberOfMovements.comment: The number of movements in this phase within a specific timeframe.

PhaseFuelEfficiency-timeframe.comment: The timeframe used in establishing the phase fuel efficiency.

PilotControlledLighting-activationInstru.comment: Operational instructions for controlling the lighting systems.

PilotControlledLighting-duration.comment: The duration the lighting is illuminated.

PilotControlledLighting-intensitySteps.comment: The number of intensity steps/levels for a particular type of lighting system.

PostalAddress-administrativeArea.comment: The state or province of an organisation's or individual's physical address.

PostalAddress-city.comment: The city portion of the physical address for an organisation or individual.

PostalAddress-country.comment: The country name portion of the physical address for an organisation or individual.

PostalAddress-deliveryPoint.comment: The street address portion of the physical address for an organisation or individual.

PostalAddress-postalCode.comment: The ZIP or other postal code portion of the physical address for an organisation or individual.

Precipitation-amount.comment: Total amount of precipitation measured over a defined period, expressed in mm/hours.

PrecisionApproachRadar-slope.comment: The glideslope angle at which the PAR provides landing assistance.

PrecisionApproachRadar-slopeAccuracy.comment: The accuracy of the glideslope angle at which the PAR provides landing assistance.

Procedure-communicationFailureInstructio.comment: Operational instructions which must be observed in case of communication failure.

Procedure-instruction.comment: Operational instructions, other than communication failure instructions, which must be respected when flying the procedure.

Procedure-name.comment: The name of the instrument procedure.

ProcedureTransition-instruction.comment: Operational instructions that must be observed when flying the procedure transition part.

ProcedureTransition-vectorHeading.comment: A heading provided for use, when a departure is designed to incorporate radar vectors at the termination point, in the event ATC instructions are not received prior to or at the termination fix.

RadarComponent-collocationGroup.comment: A number identifying the collocation group to which the radar equipment aid belongs.

RadarEquipment-dateMagneticVariation.comment: The date at which the magnetic variation had this value.

RadarEquipment-magneticVariation.comment: The angular difference between True North and Magnetic North measured at a given position and date.

RadarSystem-broadcastIdentifier.comment: The identifier broadcasted for a secondary radar.

RadioCommunicationChannel-logon.comment: A specified code used for data link, for instance for logon to an ATS unit.

RadioFrequencyArea-angleScallop.comment: The value of the scalloping angle, which may affect the radial reading of a VOR or TACAN in plus or minus.

RadioNavigationAid-dateMagneticVariation.comment: The year the magnetic variation was measured.

RadioNavigationAid-designator.comment: The identifying code given to the radio navigation aid.

RadioNavigationAid-magneticVariation.comment: The measured angle between Magnetic North and True North at the VOR, at the time the magnetic variation was measured.

RadioNavigationAid-magneticVariationAccu.comment: The accuracy of the magnetic variation.

RadioNavigationAid-name.comment: The long name given to the radio navigation aid.

RadioNavigationService-designator.comment: The coded identifier given to the radio navigation service.

RadioNavigationService-name.comment: The long name given to the composite radio navigation service.

ReferenceLocation-designator.comment: Reference location designator as defined by the Network Manager.

RegulationRate-equipmentRate.comment: Number of slots available for Microwave Landing System (MLS) equipped aircrafts per hour.

RegulationRate-normalRate.comment: Number of slots per hour to be allocated during the slot allocation process. In Microwave Landing System (MLS) operations, this rate corresponds to the slots available for non-MLS equipped aircrafts.

RegulationRate-pendingRate.comment: Number of remaining free slots per hour after the slot allocation process is calculated used for later filers or during the slot improvement process.

Release-releaseRequestReference.comment: The reference to the release request.

RevisionTimes-timeToInsertInSequence.comment: Time to insert aircraft in sequence

RevisionTimes-timeToRemoveFromSequence.comment: Time to remove aircraft in sequence

Road-designator.comment: The designator or name of the service road.

Route-designatorNumber.comment: The number of the route designator.

Route-locationDesignator.comment: A description of the area in which the designated route is situated.

Route-name.comment: The name by which the route is known.

RouteSegment-requiredNavigationPerforman.comment: The required navigation performance for the route portion expressed in NM.

RulesProcedures-content.comment: The definition of the actual content of the rule or procedure.

Runway-designator.comment: The designator of a runway, used to uniquely identify it at an aerodrome.

RunwayConfiguration-description.comment: Free text field used to describe a runway configuration.

RunwayConfiguration-runwayConfigurationU.comment: Percentage of the time where this runway configuration is used rather than another one for the same airport.

RunwayDirection-designator.comment: A designator for one of the two possible landing and/or take-off directions of a runway or final approach and take-off area.

RunwayDirection-magneticBearing.comment: The measured angle between the runway direction and magnetic north at a given position.

RunwayDirection-touchDownZoneSlope.comment: Touchdown zone longitudinal slope (slope of 1/3 of the runway length from threshold or first 3000 feet for runways longer than 9000 feet) for a runway direction.

RunwayDirection-trueBearing.comment: The measured angle between the runway direction and true north at a given position.

RunwayDirection-trueBearingAccuracy.comment: The accuracy of the measured angle between the runway direction and true north at a given position.

RunwayOperationalConstraints-currentLand.comment: The number of aircraft allowed to approach the Runway Direction per hour, taking all operational constraints into account.

RunwaySequencing-runwayUsePositionFixedT.comment: The time at which runway sequence management plans to freeze the sequence position of the flight

RunwaySequencing-runwayUseSequencePostio.comment: The position of a given aircraft in the time order of using the runway (runway mix sequence), i.e. relative to all other aircraft landing on or taking off from the same runway.

SSRCode-code.comment: Four numerics giving the SSR code assigned to the aircraft by ATS.

SegmentLeg-bankAngle.comment: The recommended bank angle of the aircraft on the turn.

SegmentLeg-course.comment: The value of the course angle.

SegmentLeg-verticalAngle.comment: The vertical climb angle of the aircraft on the procedure leg.

Sensor-systemAreaCode.comment: System Area Code identifying the region where the system is located

Service-name.comment: A free text name by which the service is identified.

ServiceAtGate-type.comment: Type of service available at a Gate.

ServiceProviderCallsign-callSign.comment: The full textual service provider identification or call-sign for a particular frequency.

ServiceProviderCallsign-language.comment: A code indicating the language in which the service is provided on a particular frequency, as associated with a particular call-sign.

SignificantPoint-checkpointAngle.comment: The indication of a bearing (at a given point) by the measurement of the angle between the checkpoint and the navaid equipment (VOR).

SignificantPoint-designator.comment: The coded identifier of the significant point.

SignificantPoint-leadRadial.comment: The lead radial provides information for aircraft with single receiving equipment to change the receiver to the localizer or other facility providing the course guidance and to ensure the aircraft is within the clearance coverage area of LOC facilities before changing frequency or accepting on-course indication.

SimplifiedDirectionalFacility-magneticBe.comment: The measured angle between the localizer beam and Magnetic North at the localizer antenna.

SimplifiedDirectionalFacility-trueBearin.comment: The measured angle between the localizer beam and True North at the localizer antenna.

SlotAssignmentHistory-dateAssigned.comment: Date at which the airport slot had been assigned to the flight.

SpecialDate-name.comment: The name by which the date is known by the public (especially for public holidays).

SpecialNavigationStation-name.comment: The textual name of the station.

SpecialNavigationSystem-designator.comment: The designator of a special navigation system chain.

SpecialNavigationSystem-name.comment: The textual name of the chain of a special navigation system.

SpeedChange-assignedSpeed.comment: Speed to be respected when flying over the point.

StandardLevelSector-fromTrack.comment: The start angle of the sector relative to the North.

StandardLevelSector-toTrack.comment: The end angle of the sector relative to the North.

StartUpSequencing-startUpSequencePositio.comment: The position of a given aircraft in the start up sequence.
The time at which start up sequence management plans to freeze the sequence position of the flight.

SupplementaryRate-supplementaryRate.comment: Number of extra free slots per hour to be added during short periods to the normal rate without triggering a recalculation of the slot allocation process.

SurfaceCharacteristics-classLCN.comment: A value which denotes the peak bearing moment the surface can handle repeatedly without shortening its service life.

SurfaceCharacteristics-classPCN.comment: The bearing strength of a pavement for unrestricted operations.

SurfaceContamination-frictionCoefficient.comment: The average ratio of the weight of an object being moved along an aerodrome surface with contamination and the force that maintains contact between the object and that surface.

SurfaceContamination-furtherClearanceTim.comment: The time when it is expected to complete further clearance of an aerodrome surface with contamination.

SurfaceContamination-nextObservationTime.comment: The date and time of the next intended measurement of conditions on an aerodrome surface.

SurfaceContamination-observationTime.comment: The date and time of surface contamination measurement completion.

SurfaceContamination-proportion.comment: The percentage of the contaminated area of the overall extent of the surface.

SurfaceContaminationLayer-layerOrder.comment: The order of the layer (starting from the uppermost, towards the movement area surface), in case overlapping contaminants are present.

SurveillanceRadar-automatedRadarTerminal.comment: A system in the air traffic control system using radar intelligence to detect and display pertinent data such as flight identification, altitude, and position of aircraft operating in the terminal area.

SurveillanceRadar-tiltAngle.comment: Angle at which the antenna is tilted.

SurveillanceRadar-verticalCoverageAzimut.comment: Azimuth for which the radar provides vertical coverage.

SurvivalEquipment-dinghyTotalCapacity.comment: The total number of persons which can be accommodated by the dinghies carried onboard the aircraft.

SurvivalEquipment-number.comment: The number of the specific equipment available onboard the aircraft.

TACAN-declination.comment: The angular difference between the direction of the 'zero bearing' indicated by the station and the direction of the True North.

TacticalRerouting-manualReroutingConstra.comment: The definition of a manual rerouting.

TacticalReroutingProposal-designator.comment: Designator of a proposed tactical improvement route.

TacticalReroutingProposal-respondBy.comment: Time to answer to the reroute proposed.

TakeOffConfiguration-numberOfPassengers.comment: The number of passenger for the flight.

TakeOffConfiguration-numberOfPersons.comment: The total number of persons (passengers and crew) on board.

TakeOffConfiguration-numberOfTrafficUnit.comment: Number of traffic units for the flight. One traffic unit is equivalent to one passenger or 100Kg air freight or 10 kg air mail.

TakeOffSequencing-takeOffPositionFixedTi.comment: The time at which take-off sequence management plans to freeze the sequence position of the flight

TakeOffSequencing-takeOffSequencePositio.comment: The position of a given aircraft in the take-off sequence.

TaxiRoute-intendedPosition.comment: The intended position at the end of the taxi route.

TaxiRoute-startPosition.comment: The start of the taxi route.

TaxiRoute-taxiRouteConstraint.comment: A limitation applied to the taxi route.

TaxiRoute-taxiRouteProcedure.comment: The procedures applicable to the taxi route.

TaxiRoute-taxiTime.comment: The taxi time for the taxi route.

Taxiway-designator.comment: The textual designator of the taxiway.

TaxiwayConfiguration-description.comment: Free text field used to describe a taxiway configuration.

TaxiwayConfiguration-designator.comment: A name identifying a taxiway configuration.

TaxiwayConfiguration-taxiwayConfiguratio.comment: Percentage of the time where this taxiway configuration is used rather than another one for the same airport.

TelephoneContact-facsimile.comment: The telephone number of a facsimile machine for the responsible organisation or individual.

TelephoneContact-voice.comment: The telephone number by which individuals can speak to the responsible organisation or individual.

TemporalEnabledEntity-endEntityLifetime.comment: End of life of the entity, indicating the date and time at which the entity ceases to exist

TemporalEnabledEntity-endValidity.comment: Date and time at which the data contained in the entity state ceases to be effective

TemporalEnabledEntity-lastRevision.comment: Date and time when the data was last revised.

TemporalEnabledEntity-source.comment: Name of entity or organisation that supplied data.

TemporalEnabledEntity-startEntityLifetim.comment: Start of life of the entity, indicating the date and time at which the entity starts to exist

TemporalEnabledEntity-startValidity.comment: Date and time at which the data contained in the entity state starts to be effective

Terminal-description.comment: Free text field used to describe a terminal.

Terminal-numberOfArrivalPassportDesks.comment: Number of arrival passport desks available at the terminal.

Terminal-numberOfBagSecurityPoints.comment: Number of bag security points available at the terminal.

Terminal-numberOfCheckInDesks.comment: Number of check-in desks available at the terminal.

Terminal-numberOfCustomChannels.comment: Number of custom channels at the terminal.

Terminal-numberOfDeparturePassportDesks.comment: Number of departure passport desks available at the terminal.

Terminal-numberOfGateRooms.comment: Number of gate rooms available at the terminal.

Terminal-numberOfLuggageReclaimDevices.comment: Number of luggage reclaim devices available at the terminal.

Terminal-numberOfPassengerLevels.comment: Number of levels for passengers at the terminal.

ThreeDimensionalCurveType-horizontalConf.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

ThreeDimensionalCurveType-verticalConfid.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

ThreeDimensionalPointType-horizontalConf.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

ThreeDimensionalPointType-verticalConfid.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

ThreeDimensionalSurfaceType-horizontalCo.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

ThreeDimensionalSurfaceType-verticalConf.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

TimeRangeType-earlier.comment: The lower limit of the time range.

TimeRangeType-later.comment: The upper limit of the time range.

TimeToEntryBoundary-timeToEntry.comment: The time to the airspace entry boundary.

TimeToPointBoundary-timeToPoint.comment: The time to the flyover boundary.

Timesheet-endDate.comment: The end date of the validity of the timesheet.

Timesheet-endTime.comment: The time of the day when the period described in the timesheet ends.

Timesheet-endTimeRelativeEvent.comment: The number of minutes before or after the end event when the period described in the timesheet ends.

Timesheet-startDate.comment: The start date of the validity of the timesheet.

Timesheet-startTime.comment: The time of the day when the period described in the timesheet starts.

Timesheet-startTimeRelativeEvent.comment: The number of minutes before or after the start event when the period described in the timesheet starts.

TouchDownLiftOff-designator.comment: The designator of the touch down and lift-off area.

TouchDownLiftOff-slope.comment: The slope (rate of upward inclination of the surface from the horizontal) of the surface of a touch down and lift-off area.

TrackDirectionChange-assignedTrackDirect.comment: The track direction that the flight is requested to follow.

TrackDirectionChange-trackDirection.comment: The new track direction when the track change is completed.

TrafficCount-countPeriodDuration.comment: The duration during which the flights are counted.

TrafficCount-countValue.comment: The number of flights being counted.

TrafficSeparationService-dataLinkChannel.comment: The channel on which the data-link takes place, if applicable.

TrafficVolume-designator.comment: Designator of the traffic volume as defined by the Network Manager.

TrafficVolumeSet-designator.comment: Designator of the traffic volume set as defined by the Network Manager.

TrafficVolumeSet-name.comment: Textual description of the traffic volumes which compose the set.

Trajectory-rejectReason.comment: The reason under which the Trajectory request is rejected.

Trajectory-requestReference.comment: The reference of the clearance request for a 4D trajectory across an ATSU AoR.

TrajectoryConstraint-reasonForRejection.comment: The FDMP's reason for rejecting the trajectory constraint.

TrajectoryConstraint-timeAfterReference.comment: Duration to be added to the time at which the reference is reached for the determination of the application point of the constraint.

TrajectoryElement-cruisingLevel.comment: The planned cruising level for the first or the whole portion of the route to be flown.

TrajectoryElement-specialRequirements.comment: Applicable special requirements to this trajectory element. This is an indicator that the flight is expected to be operating in accordance with regulations issued by the relevant State for aircraft operating as State aircraft, as per Article 3 of the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Doc 7300) and for aircraft operating in accordance with State regulations for non-standard flying activities, normally through the use of reserved airspace.

TrajectoryPoint-accumulatedEstimatedElap.comment: The estimated time required from take-off to that trajectory point.

TrajectoryPoint-estimatedElapsedTimeFrom.comment: Time elapsed since a point of reference.

TrajectorySegment-auxiliaryPowerUnitFuel.comment: The amount of fuel burn of the auxiliary power unit usage during flight segment.
