TrajectorySegment-duration.comment: Duration of the Trajectory Segment, derived from the eventTime and the eventEndTime.

TrajectorySegment-estimatedElapsedTime.comment: The estimated time required to proceed from one significant point to another.

TrajectorySegment-fuelBurn.comment: The fuelBurn for the FlightSegment, expressed in kg.

TrajectorySegment-fuelBurnRate.comment: Average Fuel burn rate for the leg. Derived from the deltaFuelBurn for the WayPoints delimiting the FlightSegment.

TrajectorySegment-mainEnginesFuelBurn.comment: The amount of fuel burn of the main engines during the flight segment.

TrajectorySegment-rateOfClimbDescent.comment: Average rate of climb and descent for the leg (ft per minute), derived from rateOfAltitudeChange of the two Waypoints delimiting the FlightSegment.

TransferData-assignedFlightLevel.comment: Flight level assigned during transfer phase.

TransferData-supplementaryFlightLevel.comment: Supplementary flight level assigned during transfer phase.

Turbulence-edr.comment: Eddy dissipation rate, characterization of atmospheric turbulence.

TwoDimensionalCurveType-horizontalConfid.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

TwoDimensionalPointType-horizontalConfid.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

TwoDimensionalSurfaceType-horizontalConf.comment: A statistical measure of the estimated confidence with which the data captured met its required accuracy. A required confidence level of 90% indicates that 90% of the measured point(s) should meet their respective accuracy requirements.

Unit-designator.comment: A distinguishing label, term, abbreviation or acronym used to identify the Unit.

Unit-locationIndicatorICAO.comment: A four-letter code group formulated in accordance with rules prescribed by ICAO and assigned to the ATS unit.

Unit-name.comment: The full textual name of a unit, established according to the rules specified by International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO), and specifically in the official language of the country, transposed into the Latin Alphabet where necessary.

UsageCondition-priorPermission.comment: An indication that a prior permission is required before using the aerodrome movement area.

VOR-declination.comment: The angular difference between True North and the station declination.

ValAccelerationType-estimatedAccuracy.comment: Estimated accuracy (i.e. standard deviation) of the calculated acceleration in Cartesian co-ordinates

ValAltitudeType-accuracy.comment: Estimated accuracy (standard deviation) of the measured altitude.

ValHexType-pattern.comment: A regular expression constraining the datatype

ValSpeedType-estimatedAccuracy.comment: Estimated accuracy of the velocity (Cartesian Coordinates).

ValTemperatureType-precision.comment: The precision of the unit. For degrees Celsius, it will be 1.

VerticalStructure-name.comment: The name of the vertical structure.

VerticalStructurePart-designator.comment: A distinguishing label by which the vertical structure part is identified locally.

VisualGlideSlopeIndicator-numberBox.comment: The number of units that compose the visual glide slope indicator system.

VisualGlideSlopeIndicator-slopeAngle.comment: A descent angle determined by a visual glide slope indicator system for visual vertical guidance during the final approach of an aircraft.

WeatherCondition-analysisTime.comment: The time at which the forecast or observation process starts.

WeatherCondition-confidence.comment: Quality of trusting for a forecast expressed as a percentage.

WeatherCondition-probability.comment: Relative likelihood of a forecast expressed as a percentage.

WhatIfFlight-rejectReason.comment: The reason for its rejection of an alternative flight.

Wind-extremeClockwiseWindDirection.comment: The extreme clockwise direction from which the wind is blowing, inclusive.

Wind-extremeCounterClockwiseWindDirectio.comment: The extreme counter-clockwise direction from which the wind is blowing, inclusive.

Wind-windDirection.comment: Direction from which wind is blowing.

WorkArea-plannedOperational.comment: Date when the activities in the construction area are expected to be operational.

ACARS_DATA_LINK.comment: Controller Pilot Data Link Communications FANS 1A / ACARS

A_HFDL.comment: Controller Pilot Data Link Communications FANS 1/A HFDL

A_SATCOM_INMARSAT.comment: Controller Pilot Data Link Communications FANS 1/A SATCOM (INMARSAT)

A_SATCOM_IRIDIUM.comment: Controller Pilot Data Link Communications FANS 1/A SATCOM (Iridium)

A_SATCOM_MTSAT.comment: Controller Pilot Data Link Communications FANS 1/A SATCOM (MTSAT)

A_VDL_MODE_2.comment: Controller Pilot Data Link Communications FANS_1/A_VDL_Mode_2

A_VDL_MODE_4.comment: Controller Pilot Data Link Communications FANS 1/A VDL MODE 4 capability

A_VDL_MODE_A.comment: Controller Pilot Data Link Communications FANS 1/A VDL Mode A

CodeACASCapabilityType-AIRCRAFT_IDENTIFI.comment: Capability of the airborne collision avoidance system to identify aircraft.

CodeACDMIrregularityType-CDM01.comment: No Airport Slot Available, or Slot already correlated

CodeAMANHorizonType-ACTIVE_ADVISORY.comment: The Arrival Management horizon at which advisories for AMAN sequence implementation presented to the air traffic controller are reliable and useful (i.e. stable)

CodeAMANHorizonType-ELIGIBILITY.comment: The boundary of the airspace within which Arrival Management receives flight progress information for every aircraft bound for the arrival managed airport.

CodeAMANHorizonType-FROZEN.comment: The horizon within which no automatic swapping of flights in the sequence, and no update of landing time will occur.

CodeAMANHorizonType-INITIAL_METERING.comment: The horizon where aircraft are given a target time for the Initial Metering Point

CodeAMANHorizonType-METERING.comment: The horizon where aircraft are given a target time for the Metering Point

CodeAMANStatusType-CTA_ISSUED.comment: A status code indicating that the controller has communicated a CTA constraint.

CodeAMANStatusType-DISABLED.comment: A status code indicating that AMAN sequencing is disabled.

CodeAMANStatusType-ENABLED.comment: A status code indicating that AMAN sequencing is enabled.

CodeAMANStatusType-TIME_FROZEN.comment: A status code indicating that the AMAN will not further change the times calculated for the flight in question.

CodeAMANStatusType-TTA_ISSUED.comment: A status code indicating that the controller has issued a target time to the flight, typically resulting in the communication of an advisory.

CodeATFMHotspotStatusType-ACCEPTABLE.comment: After analysis it appeared that the problem was not a real problem and does not require action to be solved. Note that if a Hotspot is really no longer required it is simply removed completely. The ACCEPTABLE state is solely intended to indicate that a Hotspot has been accepted as a problem that can be tolerated (e.g. no resolution action such as a STAM needs to be applied).

CodeATFMHotspotStatusType-ACTIVE.comment: The problem is confirmed and must be solved (e.g. by a STAM).

CodeATFMHotspotStatusType-DRAFT.comment: A potential problem (peak) has been identified and it is still needed to verify if it is a real problem or not.

CodeATFMHotspotStatusType-SOLVED.comment: The problem has been solved (e.g. by a STAM).

CodeATFMMeasureStatusType-ACCEPTED.comment: The ATFM measure proposal has been accepted by NMOC.

CodeATFMMeasureStatusType-ACTIVATING.comment: The ATFM measure is being activated.

CodeATFMMeasureStatusType-APPLIED.comment: The ATFM Measure is activated and the subsequent flight recalculation is finished.

CodeATFMMeasureStatusType-APPLYING.comment: The ATFM measure is activated but the subsequent flight recalculation is not finished yet.

CodeATFMMeasureStatusType-CANCELLED.comment: The ATFM measure is cancelled and the subsequent flight recalculation is finished.

CodeATFMMeasureStatusType-CANCELLING.comment: The ATFM measure is cancelled but the subsequent flight recalculation is not finished yet.

CodeATFMMeasureStatusType-REJECTED.comment: The ATFM measure proposal has been rejected.

CodeATFMMeasureStatusType-WAITING.comment: The ATFM measure proposal has not been processed yet.

CodeATFMMeasureType-AIRBORNE_HORIZONTAL_.comment: A tactical ATFM measure where the aircraft is rerouted while airborne.

CodeATFMMeasureType-AIRBORNE_LEVEL_CAP.comment: A tactical ATFM measure applicable to airborne flight(s) which limits the flight level at which an aircraft can fly.

CodeATFMMeasureType-GROUND_DELAY.comment: A strategic, pre-tactical, or tactical ATFM measure where aircraft are held on the ground in order to manage capacity and demand in a specific volume of airspace or at a specific airport.

CodeATFMMeasureType-GROUND_LEVEL_CAP.comment: A tactical ATFM measure applicable to not yet airborne flight(s) which limits the flight level at which an aircraft can fly.

CodeATFMMeasureType-MILES_MINUTES_IN_TRA.comment: A tactical ATFM measure expressed as the number of minutes required between successive aircraft or a tactical ATFM measure expressed as the number of miles required between aircraft (in addition to the minimum longitudinal requirements) to meet a specific criterion which may be separation, airport, fix, altitude, sector or route specific.

CodeATFMMeasureType-MINIMUM_DEPARTURE_IN.comment: A tactical ATFM measure carried out when ATC sets a departure flow rate of, for example, 3 minutes between successive departures.

CodeATFMMeasureType-TAKE_OFF_NOT_AFTER.comment: A tactical ATFM measure where the aircraft shall take-off not after the required time.

CodeATFMMeasureType-TAKE_OFF_NOT_BEFORE.comment: A tactical ATFM measure where the aircraft shall take-off not before the required time.

CodeATFMMeasureType-TERMINAL_PROCEDURE_C.comment: A tactical ATFM measure which requires the aircraft to use a different terminal procedure.

CodeAerialRefuellingType-ANCHOR.comment: Aerial Refuelling Track of type ANCHOR, with the shape of a race track.

CodeAerialRefuellingType-BOTH.comment: Aerial Refuelling Track with the shape of both TRACK and ANCHOR.

CodeAerialRefuellingType-TRACK.comment: Aerial Refuelling Track of type TRACK, which is linear.

CodeAerodromeCollocationType-FULL.comment: Full collocation, there is only one aerodrome.

CodeAerodromeCollocationType-PARTIAL.comment: Partial collocation, the RWYs of the 1st aerodrome are available to the traffic on the 2nd aerodrome.

CodeAerodromeCollocationType-RUNWAY.comment: The two aerodromes share all their RWYs and TWYs, but not their aprons.

CodeAerodromeCollocationType-SEPARATED.comment: Separated. Even if it is physically possible for an aircraft to taxi between the two aerodrome's manoeuvring areas, this is not operationally allowed.

CodeAerodromeCollocationType-UNILATERAL.comment: Unilateral co-location, the RWYs, the TWYs and the aprons of the 1st aerodrome are available to traffic on the 2nd aerodrome.

CodeAerodromeSignApplicabilityType-BOTH.comment: Sign applies to both aircraft and surface vehicles.

CodeAerodromeSignApplicabilityType-VEHIC.comment: Sign applies to surface vehicles only.

CodeAerodromeSurfaceRoutingNetworkEdgeDi.comment: One-way from end- to start point of the line.
One-way from start- to end point of the line.

CodeAerodromeSurfaceRoutingNetworkEdgeGe.comment: Defined without using existing line data.
Partially derived from existing data and partially abstracted, for example in the cases where gaps exist.

CodeAerodromeSurfaceRoutingNetworkEdgeTy.comment: Edge connecting taxiway and parking entry/exit point.
Edge connecting stand and parking entry/exit.

CodeAerodromeSurfaceRoutingNetworkNodeTy.comment: Node joining an apron area to a taxiway.
Node where a deicing operation may be performed.
Node joining a parking area to a taxiway.
Node where a runway and taxiway meet.
Node where a runway exit line and runway intersection meet.
Node where a stand is located.
Node on a taxiway abeam to a parking or apron entry/exit node.

CodeAerodromeSystemType-ILCMS.comment: Individual Lamp Control and Monitoring Systems (Follow-the-Green)

CodeAerodromeSystemType-SMGCS.comment: Surface Movement Guidance and Control System

CodeAerodromeTrafficType-GLOBAL.comment: Arrival and departure traffic at the aerodrome.

CodeAirTrafficServiceType-ACS.comment: En-route area control service (same as ARTCC service in US)

CodeAirTrafficServiceType-AERODROME_CONT.comment: Air traffic control service for aerodrome traffic.

CodeAirTrafficServiceType-AIR_TRAFFIC_AD.comment: A service provided within advisory airspace to ensure separation, in so far as practical, between aircraft which are operating on IFR flight plans.

CodeAirTrafficServiceType-APPROACH_CONTR.comment: Approach area control service (includes departure and arrival).

CodeAirTrafficType-DEMAND.comment: The number of aircraft requesting to use the ATM system in a given time period.

CodeAirTrafficType-REGULATED_DEMAND.comment: The air traffic taking according to any regulations that have been implemented.

CodeAirTrafficType-TRAFFIC_LOAD.comment: The air traffic according to the best information available.

CodeAircraftAirframeEquipmentType-AIRFRA.comment: The body of an aircraft as distinct from its engine.

CodeAircraftAirframeEquipmentType-AIR_BR.comment: A movable flap or other device on an aircraft to reduce its speed.

CodeAircraftAirframeEquipmentType-HIGH_L.comment: Movable surfaces or, in some cases, stationary components that are designed to increase lift during some phases or conditions of flight.

CodeAircraftAttitudeType-NONE.comment: The attitude of the flight is unknown.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType-AIRBOR.comment: An ACAS which provides information as an aid to "see and avoid" action but does not include the capability for generating resolution advisories (RAs).
An ACAS which provides vertical resolution advisories (RAs) in addition to traffic advisories (TAs).
An aircraft system that enables the flight crew to maintain separation of their aircraft from one or more aircraft, and provides flight information concerning surrounding traffic.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType-AUTOMA.comment: An electronic aid to navigation that identifies the relative bearing of an aircraft from a radio beacon transmitting in the MF or LF bandwidth, such as an NDB or commercial radio broadcast station.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType-COCKPI.comment: A generic avionics device on the flight deck that is capable of displaying the position information of nearby aircraft on the ground.

A generic avionics device on the flight deck that is capable of displaying the position information of nearby aircraft. It may also include ground reference points and navigation information to increase the AIRSAW.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType-ENHANC.comment: Aircraft equipment incorporating information from aircraft based sensors to provide vision in limited visibility environments.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType-GROUND.comment: A system which provides automatically a timely and distinctive warning to the flight crew when the aeroplane is in potentially hazardous proximity to the earth's surface.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType-INERTI.comment: An aircraft avionics equipment providing the position and altitude of the aircraft by measuring the accelerations and rotations applied to the system's inertial frame.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType-SURFAC.comment: Aircraft equipment depicting a moving map for an airport.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType-SYNTHE.comment: Aircraft equipment fusing three-dimensional data into intuitive displays that provide situational awareness to flight crews.

CodeAircraftAvionicsEquipmentType-TRAFFI.comment: A specific implementation of ACAS I.
A specific implementation of the ACAS II concept.

CodeAircraftCapabilityType-AIR_REFERENCE.comment: The capability of aircraft to generate Air-Referenced Velocity Reports.

CodeAircraftCapabilityType-LOW_VISIBILIT.comment: The capability of aircraft to enable low visibility operations.

CodeAircraftCapabilityType-RVSM_CAPABILI.comment: The capability of aircraft to enable Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum operations.

CodeAircraftCapabilityType-SURFACE_MOVIN.comment: The capability of aircraft to display its position on the airport surface to the pilots.

CodeAircraftCapabilityType-TARGET_STATE_.comment: The capability of aircraft to generate target state reports.

CodeAircraftClassificationType-CLEARANCE.comment: The minimum clearance with building can be used as classification criteria by defining ranges of values.

CodeAircraftClassificationType-ENGINE_NU.comment: The engine number can be used as classification criteria by defining ranges of values.

CodeAircraftClassificationType-ENGINE_TY.comment: The engine type can be used as classification criteria by defining lists of values.

CodeAircraftClassificationType-MINIMUM_A.comment: The minimum approach speed can be used as classification criteria by defining ranges of values.

CodeAircraftClassificationType-MTOW.comment: The maximum take-off weight can be used as classification criteria by defining ranges of values.

CodeAircraftClassificationType-OUTER_GEA.comment: The outer main gear wheel span can be used as classification criteria by defining ranges of values.

CodeAircraftClassificationType-WING_SPAN.comment: The maximum wing span can be used as classification criteria by defining ranges of values.

CodeAircraftEngineNumberType-2C.comment: Two coupled engines driving one propeller.

CodeAircraftEquipmentType-EMERGENCY_LOCA.comment: A generic term describing equipment which broadcast distinctive signals on designated frequencies and, depending on application, may be automatically activated by impact or be manually activated. An ELT may be any of the following: Automatic fixed ELT (ELT(AF)). An automatically activated ELT which is permanently attached to an aircraft. Automatic portable ELT (ELT(AP)). An automatically activated ELT which is rigidly attached to an aircraft but readily removable from the aircraft. Automatic deployable ELT (ELT(AD)). An ELT which is rigidly attached to an aircraft and which is automatically deployed and activated by impact, and, in some cases, also by hydrostatic sensors. Manual deployment is also provided. Survival ELT (ELT(S)). An ELT which is removable from an aircraft, stowed so as to facilitate its ready use in an emergency, and manually activated by survivors.

CodeAircraftFlightStatusType-GOA.comment: Go-around - Flight has initiated a go around.

CodeAircraftFlightStatusType-IDH.comment: Indefinite Holding - Flight in indefinite holding, unable to continue approach.

CodeAircraftFlightStatusType-TMA.comment: Within TMA Boundary - The aircraft has entered the local TMA

CodeAircraftLandingCategoryType-A.comment: Category A: - less than 169 km/h (91 kt) indicated air speed

CodeAircraftLandingCategoryType-B.comment: Category B: - 169 km/h (91 kt) or more but less than 224 km/h (121 kt) indicated air speed

CodeAircraftLandingCategoryType-C.comment: Category C: - 224 km/h (121 kt) or more but less than 261 km/h (141 kt) indicated air speed

CodeAircraftLandingCategoryType-D.comment: Category D: - 261 km/h (141 kt) or more but less than 307 km/h (166 kt) indicated air speed

CodeAircraftLandingCategoryType-E.comment: Category E: - 307 km/h (166 kt) or more but less than 391 km/h (211 kt) indicated air speed

CodeAircraftLandingCategoryType-H.comment: Category H: - helicopter (the stall speed method of calculating aircraft category does not apply)

CodeAircraftOperatorType-AIR_CARRIER.comment: An air transport undertaking holding a valid operating licence or equivalent at the latest on 31 January for the following summer season or on 31 August for the following winter season. For the purpose of Articles 4, 8, 8a and 10, the definition of air carrier shall also include business aviation operators, when they operate according to a schedule; for the purposes of Articles 7 and 14; the definition of air carrier shall also include all civil aircraft operators.

CodeAircraftOperatorType-AIR_TAXI.comment: An operator providing air taxi service.

CodeAircraftOperatorType-FREIGHT_CARGO_C.comment: An operator providing a freight/cargo air service.

CodeAircraftOperatorType-GENERAL_AVIATIO.comment: An aircraft operator engaged in a general aviation operation.

CodeAircraftSurvivalEquipmentType-LIFE_J.comment: A sleeveless buoyant or inflatable jacket for keeping a person afloat in water.

CodeAircraftType-AEROPLANE.comment: A power-driven heavier-than-air aircraft, deriving its lift in flight chiefly from aerodynamic reactions on surfaces which remain fixed under given conditions of flight.

CodeAircraftType-GLIDER.comment: A non-power-driven heavier-than-air aircraft, deriving its lift in flight chiefly from aerodynamic reactions on surfaces which remain fixed under given conditions of flight.

CodeAircraftType-GYROPLANE.comment: A heavier-than-air aircraft supported in flight by the reactions of the air on one or more rotors which rotate freely on substantially vertical axes.

CodeAircraftType-HELICOPTER.comment: A heavier-than-air aircraft supported in flight chiefly by the reactions of the air on one or more power-driven rotors on substantially vertical axes.

CodeAircraftType-ORNITHOPTER.comment: A heavier-than-air aircraft supported in flight chiefly by the reactions of the air on planes to which a flapping motion is imparted.

CodeAircraftType-POWERED_LIFT.comment: A heavier-than-air aircraft capable of vertical take-off, vertical landing, and low-speed flight, which depends principally on engine-driven lift devices or engine thrust for the lift during these flight regimes and on non-rotating aerofoil(s) for lift during horizontal flight.

CodeAircraftType-ROTORCRAFT.comment: A power-driven heavier-than-air aircraft supported in flight by the reactions of the air on one or more rotors.

CodeAircraftType-SELF_SUSTAINING_POWERED.comment: A powered aeroplane with available engine power which allows it to maintain level flight but not to take off under its own power.

CodeAircraftType-UNMANNED_AERIAL_VEHICLE.comment: An unmanned aerial vehicle is a pilotless aircraft, in the sense of Article 8 of the Convention on International Civil Aviation, which is flown without a pilot-in-command on-board and is either remotely and fully controlled from another place (ground, another aircraft, space) or programmed and fully autonomous.

CodeAircraftType-UNMANNED_FREE_BALLOON.comment: A non-power-driven, unmanned, lighter-than-air aircraft in free flight.

CodeAircraftWingspanClassType-A.comment: Up to but not including 49 ft (15 m)

CodeAircraftWingspanClassType-B.comment: 49 ft (15 m) up to but not including 79 ft (24 m)

CodeAircraftWingspanClassType-C.comment: 79 ft (24 m) up to but not including 118 ft (36 m)

CodeAircraftWingspanClassType-D.comment: 118 ft (36 m) up to but not including 171 ft (52 m)

CodeAircraftWingspanClassType-E.comment: 171 ft (52 m) up to but not including 214 ft (65 m)

CodeAircraftWingspanClassType-F.comment: 214 ft (65 m) up to but not including 262 ft (80 m)

CodeAirportMovementType-ARR.comment: An arrival at an airport, also called landing.

CodeAirportMovementType-MVT.comment: Any flight movement at an airport (arrival or departure).

CodeAirportWarningType-CALIBRATION.comment: Presence of people or equipment due to calibration work for ground facilities.

CodeAirportWarningType-GRASS_CUTTING.comment: Presence of people or equipment due to grass cutting work in progress.

CodeAirportWarningType-INSPECTION.comment: Presence of people or equipment due to ground facilities inspection work in progress.

CodeAirportWarningType-PARKED_AIRCRAFT.comment: Parked or Disabled Aircraft located on the surface.

CodeAirportWarningType-RUBBER_REMOVAL.comment: Removal of rubber deposits from runways.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-ACCIDENT.comment: Airspace needing a protective status due to an investigation of a flight catastrophe. Description: A type of protection.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-AD_TFC.comment: All traffic on the manoeuvring area of an aerodrome and all aircraft flying in the vicinity of an aerodrome.(Annex11). Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-AERIAL_WORK.comment: Operations in which an aircraft is used for specialized services. Description: A type of special air traffic. Services such as agriculture, construction, photography, surveying, observation and patrol, search and rescue, aerial advertisement, etc. are examples.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-AEROBATICS.comment: The usage of unusual or artful flying manoeuvres for recreation, competition, or entertainment. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-AIRSHOW.comment: A show at which aircraft are on view and featuring aerial displays. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-AIR_DROP.comment: The dropping of troops, supplies, bombs, etc., from an aircraft. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-AIR_GUN.comment: The delivery of air to air or air to ground weapons for the destruction of a target. Description: A type of military activity (usually).

CodeAirspaceActivityType-ANTI_HAIL.comment: The use of small rockets to protect crops by seeding clouds with small particles that prevent hailstorms from forming. Description: A type of hazard.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-ARTILLERY.comment: The discharge of a projectile into the air for the destruction of a target. Description: A type of military activity (usually).

CodeAirspaceActivityType-ATS.comment: Custom specific flight information service, alerting service, air traffic advisory service, air traffic control service, area control service, approach control service, or airport control service is provided. Description: A type of procedure/service. This could be a service in the air or on the ground.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-BALLOON.comment: Flight activity involving a bag called the envelope that is capable of containing heated air, with a gondola or basket suspended beneath. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-BIRD_MIGRATION.comment: A high number of bird species as they fly instinctual routes based on breeding or diverse environmental urges. Description: A type of hazard. For Example: Large scale movements of migrating birds occur during various months in the European-Mediterranean and UK areas. There are also large concentrations of nesting, breeding, and wintering birds, often numbering in the millions.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-BLASTING.comment: Controlled use of explosives to excavate or remove rock. Description: A type of hazard.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-CHEMICAL.comment: A facility utilizing a chemical process for manufacturing. Description: A type of industrial hazard.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-CROP_DUSTING.comment: Spraying crops with fertilizers, pesticides, and fungicides from an agricultural aircraft. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-EXERCISE.comment: Intercepting and destroying of hostile aircraft or conducting similar training activities. Description: A type of military activity (usually).

CodeAirspaceActivityType-FAUNA.comment: The animals or animal life of a given area, habitat, or epoch which is easily and dangerously aroused by excessive aerial noise such as from an aircraft. Description: A type of protection. Examples include mink or turkey farms and zoos.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-FIREWORK.comment: Launching of pyrotechnic devices. Description: A type of hazard. .

CodeAirspaceActivityType-FIRE_FIGHTING.comment: Intense fire fighting activity involving chemical agents being laid down from fire fighting aircraft. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-GAS.comment: Pumping natural gas from the ground or converting gasoline into vapour. Description: A type of industrial hazard.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-GLIDING.comment: Flying a non-power-driven heavier-than-air aircraft. Description: A type of special air traffic. (ICAO derived) A glider derives its lift in flight chiefly from aerodynamic reactions on surfaces which remain fixed under given conditions of flight.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-HANGGLIDING.comment: Recreational and competitive flying sport using a small glider from which the operator is suspended in a frame and which is controlled by movements of the body. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-HELI_TFC.comment: Helicopter or gyrocopter operations. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-HI_LIGHT.comment: Non-navigational lights with high visibility potential. Description: A type of hazard.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-HI_RADIO.comment: Electromagnetic fields produced by high intensity radio transmission. Description: A type of hazard.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-JET_CLIMBING.comment: Climb-out of jet aircraft via predefined and common tracks. Description: A type of military activity (usually).

CodeAirspaceActivityType-LASER.comment: The emission of photons in a coherent beam by an optical source. Description: A type of hazard. Laser stands for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation. An example is a laser light show.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-MILOPS.comment: The execution of operations by the military. Description: A type of military activity (usually).

CodeAirspaceActivityType-MISSILES.comment: The launch, transit, and targeting of guided missiles. Description: A type of military activity (usually). (NATO) A guided missile is an unmanned self-propelled vehicle whose trajectory or course, while in flight, is controlled.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-NATURE.comment: Wildlife, flora, fauna or features of geological or other special interest which is reserved and managed for conservation. Description: A type of protection. This is given a protective status. This could provide special opportunities for study or research. For example, a national park. .

CodeAirspaceActivityType-NAVAL_EXERCISE.comment: Naval forces (for example: vessels or aircraft) conduct firing and/or munitions exercises. Description: Distinguished from areas where Naval forces conduct general operations and manoeuvres.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-NO_NOISE.comment: Airspace in which special procedures or other precautionary measures are established for reducing noise. Description: A type of protection.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-NUCLEAR.comment: An installation which provides power, derived from fission or fusion of atomic nuclei. Description: A type of industrial hazard.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-OIL.comment: An area in which oil occurs in quantities worthy of exploitation. Description: A type of industrial hazard.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-PARACHUTE.comment: Exiting a flying aircraft by an individual using a parachute. Description: A type of special air traffic. A parachute is a soft fabric device used to slow the motion through the atmosphere by generating drag.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-PARAGLIDER.comment: Recreational and competitive flying sport using a free-flying, foot launched aircraft. Description: A type of special air traffic. When paragliding, the pilot sits in a harness suspended below a fabric wing, whose shape is formed by the pressure of air entering vents in the front of the wing. It is known in some countries as parapenting.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-POPULATION.comment: An area with a high concentration of inhabitants. Description: A type of protection.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-PROCEDURE.comment: Special procedures established for use by operational personnel in execution of their flight. Description: A type of procedure/service. An overhead approach is an example of a special procedure.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-RADIOSONDE.comment: The lifting of devices through the atmosphere, which are tied to a helium or hydrogen filled balloon. Description: A type of special air traffic. Radio probe and meteorological balloons are examples.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-REFINERY.comment: A facility where petroleum and/or petroleum products are refined. Description: A type of industrial hazard.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-REFUEL.comment: Transfer of fuel between aircraft in the air. Description: A type of military activity (usually).

CodeAirspaceActivityType-SHOOTING.comment: The discharge of a gun or bow to propel arrows, bullets, etc swiftly or violently direct and sharply in specified directions. Description: A type of military activity (usually). This could be a shooting range or hunting area.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-SPACE_FLIGHT.comment: Vertical launch for space flight operations. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-SPORT.comment: The competition or practice by an individual or a group to achieve the best aerial performance. Description: A type of special air traffic. This could be an air race or aerobatic training or competition.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-TECHNICAL.comment: Generic technical activity affecting air traffic. Description: A type of industrial hazard. .

CodeAirspaceActivityType-TOWING.comment: Drawing or pulling through the air a target for aerial shooting practice. Description: A type of military activity (usually).

CodeAirspaceActivityType-TRAINING.comment: Flights conducted for the purpose of training. Description: A type of special air traffic.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-UAV.comment: The operation of a powered, aerial vehicle that does not carry a human operator. Description: A type of special air traffic. (NATO derived) An Unmanned Aerial Vehicle uses aerodynamic forces to provide vehicle lift, can fly autonomously or be piloted remotely, can be expendable or recoverable, and can carry a lethal or non-lethal payload.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-VIP.comment: The presence of an individual of renowned status and considered as a very important person. Description: A type of protection.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-VIP_PRES.comment: The presence of an individual with status of head of state. Description: A type of protection.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-VIP_VICE.comment: The presence of an individual with status of Vice-Head of State. Description: A type of protection.

CodeAirspaceActivityType-WATER_BLASTING.comment: The action or an act of forcing out or emitting something suddenly underwater. Description: A type of hazard. Usually involving violence and noise.

CodeAirspaceAggregationType-BASE.comment: 'Parent' airspace is the basis for subsequent operations.

CodeAirspaceAggregationType-INTERSECTION.comment: 'Parent' airspace is second operand in intersection operation.

CodeAirspaceAggregationType-SUBTRACTION.comment: 'Parent' airspace is second operand in subtraction operation.

CodeAirspaceAggregationType-UNION.comment: 'Parent' airspace is second operand in a union operation.

CodeAirspaceClassificationType-A.comment: Airspace Classification whereby IFR flights only are permitted, all flights are provided with air traffic control service and are separated from each other.

CodeAirspaceClassificationType-B.comment: Airspace Classification whereby IFR and VFR flights are permitted, all flights are provided with air traffic control service and are separated from each other.

CodeAirspaceClassificationType-C.comment: Airspace Classification whereby IFR and VFR flights are permitted, all flights are provided with air traffic control service and IFR flights are separated from other IFR flights and from VFR flights. VFR flights are separated from IFR flights and receive traffic information in respect of other VFR flights.

CodeAirspaceClassificationType-D.comment: Airspace Classification whereby IFR and VFR flights are permitted and all flights are provided with air traffic control service, IFR flights are separated from other IFR flights and receive traffic information in respect of VFR flights, VFR flights receive traffic information in respect of all other flights.

CodeAirspaceClassificationType-E.comment: Airspace Classification whereby IFR and VFR flights are permitted, IFR flights are provided with air traffic control service and are separated from other IFR flights. All flights receive traffic information as far as is practical. Class E shall not be used for control zones.

CodeAirspaceClassificationType-F.comment: Airspace Classification whereby IFR and VFR flights are permitted, all participating IFR flights receive an air traffic advisory service and all flights receive flight information service if requested.

CodeAirspaceClassificationType-G.comment: Airspace Classification whereby IFR and VFR flights are permitted and receive flight information service if requested.

CodeAirspaceDependencyType-FULL_GEOMETRY.comment: The overall geometry of the Airspace is used.

CodeAirspaceDependencyType-HORIZONTAL_PR.comment: The horizontal projection of the Airspace is inherited.

CodeAirspacePointPositionType-BORDER.comment: Situated on the border of the airspace.

CodeAirspaceReservationImpactType-NEARBY.comment: The route segment is located in the vicinity of the Airspace and it is available only when the Airspace is not active (because of upstream/downstream segments that are located within the airspace).

CodeAirspaceReservationImpactType-NOT_AF.comment: Even if geographically located within the horizontal border of the Airspace, the route segment is not affected by the reservation of the Airspace.

CodeAirspaceReservationImpactType-OFFLOA.comment: The route segment recuperates the traffic affected by the activation of the airspace.

CodeAirspaceReservationImpactType-WITHIN.comment: The route segment is located within the Airspace and it is available only when the Airspace is not reserved.

CodeAirspaceReservationPhaseType-ACCEPTE.comment: The request is accepted by military approved authority. De-conflicting among military users is done. It is the baseline for the civil-military negotiation process.

CodeAirspaceReservationPhaseType-CONFIRM.comment: The request for reservation has been acknowledged by the responsible military unit, but the airspace is not yet allocated to the requestor.

CodeAirspaceReservationPhaseType-EARMARK.comment: A booking request that was selected by the AMC (after negotiation and taking into consideration the priorities and level 1 agreements), will change into "Earmarked"-status. An Earmarked request will normally have the airspace, however, any new requests that are introduced may have a higher priority and may degrade a previously Earmarked request to "In Queue". Only one function can Earmark.

CodeAirspaceReservationPhaseType-INITIAL.comment: The initial step, when the military or civil users have requested the airspace reservation.

CodeAirspaceReservationPhaseType-IN_QUEU.comment: Another request was selected as draft allocation, and unless that other request is cancelled, this in-queue request will not be granted. The conflict of the request should be maintained but resolution postponed.

CodeAirspaceReservationPhaseType-PRE_ACT.comment: A specific time prior activation (15'), when specific actions need to be taken with regard to that airspace usage.

CodeAirspaceReservationPhaseType-REFEREN.comment: When the consolidation period is entered (based on a fixed point in time OR on a time period before the requested activation time), the Allocated or Approved (not published in the AUP/UUP)reservations become “Reference Allocated” and further updates to them are unlikely to happen.

CodeAirspaceType-A.comment: Airspace which may contain a high volume of pilot training activities or unusual type of aerial activity, neither of which is hazardous to aircraft.

CodeAirspaceType-ADIZ.comment: Special designated airspace of defined dimensions within which aircraft are required to comply with special identification and/or reporting procedures additional to those related to the provision of air traffic services (ATS).

CodeAirspaceType-ADV.comment: A designated area within a flight information region where air traffic advisory service is available.

CodeAirspaceType-AMA.comment: Minimum altitude area. The lowest altitude to be used under instrument meteorological conditions (IMC) which will provide a minimum vertical clearance of 300 m (1 000 ft) or in designated mountainous terrain 600 m (2 000 ft) above all obstacles located in the area specified.

CodeAirspaceType-AREA_OF_INTEREST.comment: The volume of airspace that is of interest to a particular FDPS i.e. in which it needs to be aware of all flight activity.

CodeAirspaceType-AREA_OF_RESPONSIBILITY.comment: The volume of airspace for which the FDPS is responsible i.e. in which the flights are under air traffic control of one of the ATSUs supported by the FDPS.

CodeAirspaceType-ASR.comment: Airspace of defined dimensions within which standardized altimeter setting procedures apply.

CodeAirspaceType-ATZ.comment: An airspace of defined dimensions established around an aerodrome for the protection of aerodrome traffic.

CodeAirspaceType-ATZ_P.comment: Part of an airport traffic zone

CodeAirspaceType-AWY.comment: A control area or portion thereof established in the form of a corridor.

CodeAirspaceType-CBA.comment: Airspace of defined dimensions, above the land areas or territorial waters of more than one state.

CodeAirspaceType-CTA.comment: A controlled airspace extending upwards from a specified limit above the earth.

CodeAirspaceType-CTR.comment: A controlled airspace extending upwards from the surface of the earth to a specified upper limit.

CodeAirspaceType-D.comment: An airspace of defined dimensions within which activities dangerous to the flight of aircraft may exist at specified times.

CodeAirspaceType-D_OTHER.comment: Activities of dangerous nature (other than a danger area).

CodeAirspaceType-ENROUTE.comment: An airspace associated with the en-route flight phase.

CodeAirspaceType-FIR.comment: An airspace of defined dimensions within which flight information service and alerting service are provided.

CodeAirspaceType-GREAT_CIRCLE_DISTANCE.comment: An airspace, of relevance for fuel efficiency assessments, representing the great circle path of flights within the en-route flight phase.

CodeAirspaceType-LTO.comment: An airspace of relevance to emission impact assessments during the landing and take-off flight phases.

CodeAirspaceType-MTR.comment: A control area or portion thereof, established in the form of a corridor around a military training route in order to protect it from other traffic.

CodeAirspaceType-NAS_P.comment: A part of a national airspace system

CodeAirspaceType-NO_FIR.comment: Airspace for which not even a FIR is defined.

CodeAirspaceType-OCA.comment: Oceanic control area. A Control Area extending upwards in the upper airspace.

CodeAirspaceType-P.comment: An airspace of defined dimensions, above the land areas or territorial waters of a State, within which the flight of aircraft is prohibited.

CodeAirspaceType-PART.comment: Part of an airspace (used in airspace aggregation).

CodeAirspaceType-PROTECTED.comment: Airspace protected from specific air traffic.

CodeAirspaceType-R.comment: An airspace of defined dimensions, above the land areas or territorial waters of a State, within which the flight of aircraft is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

CodeAirspaceType-RCA.comment: Portion of airspace of defined dimensions within which general aviation traffic is permitted "off-route" without requiring general aviation traffic controllers to initiate co-ordination with OAT controllers.

CodeAirspaceType-SECTOR.comment: A subdivision of a designated control area within which responsibility is assigned to one controller or to a small group of controllers.

CodeAirspaceType-TMA.comment: A control area normally established at the confluence of ATS routes in the vicinity of one or more major aerodromes.

CodeAirspaceType-TRA.comment: A defined volume of airspace normally under the jurisdiction of one aviation authority and temporarily reserved, by common agreement, for the specific use by another aviation authority and through which other traffic may be allowed to transit, under ATC clearance.

CodeAirspaceType-TSA.comment: A defined volume of airspace normally under the jurisdiction of one aviation authority and temporarily segregated, by common agreement, for the exclusive use by another aviation authority and through which other traffic will not be allowed to transit.

CodeAirspaceType-UADV.comment: Upper Advisory Area. An area of defined dimensions in upper airspace within which air traffic advisory service is available.

CodeAirspaceType-UIR.comment: An upper airspace of defined dimensions within which flight information service and alerting service are provided.

CodeAirspaceType-UTA.comment: Upper control area. A Control Area extending upwards in the upper airspace.

CodeAirspaceType-W.comment: A non-regulatory airspace of defined dimensions designated over international waters that contains activity which may be hazardous to aircraft not participating in the activity. The purpose of such warning areas is to warn non participating pilots of the potential danger.

CodeAlertSeverityLevelType-ALERT.comment: A state of careful watching and readiness, especially for danger, due to the recent or imminent occurrence of an event.

CodeAlertSeverityLevelType-WARNING.comment: A state of careful watching and readiness, especially for danger or opportunity, due to the increasing likelihood of an event which could cause a low to moderate degradation in performance, safety or security.

CodeAlertTriggerType-AUTOMATIC.comment: Indication that the an alert or warning condition has been raised by an automated system.

CodeAlertTriggerType-MANUAL.comment: Indication that the alert or warning condition has been raised manually by a human operator.

CodeAlternativeFlightResponseKindType-AC.comment: An alternative flight is accepted by the downstream ATSUs.

CodeAlternativeFlightResponseKindType-DE.comment: A data owner has answered to the request with "detached".

CodeAlternativeFlightResponseKindType-PE.comment: A response has not still been received.

CodeAlternativeFlightResponseKindType-RE.comment: An alternative flight is rejected by the downstream ATSUs.

CodeAlternativeFlightStateType-ACCEPTANC.comment: This is the default state when a what-if flight is created or updated and needs the acceptance from a downstream unit.

CodeAlternativeFlightStateType-ACCEPTED.comment: The what-if creation or updates has been accepted by a downstream unit.

CodeAlternativeFlightStateType-DELETED.comment: This is the final state of the alternative flight if it has been removed

CodeAlternativeFlightStateType-NO_ACCEPT.comment: An alternative flight (what-if flight) has been created or it has been updated. No acceptance from a downstream unit is necessary (e.g. because there is no change in the entry conditions of its unit).

CodeAlternativeFlightStateType-REJECTED.comment: The what-if creation or updates has been rejected by a downstream unit.

CodeAltitudeAdjustmentType-AAO.comment: Adverse Assumption Obstruction. Designates adjustment to a terrain value to account for natural vegetation growth, uncharted cell phone towers, buildings, and other man-made obstructions.

CodeAltitudeAdjustmentType-GS.comment: Glideslope - adjustment to set altitude at glideslope intercept

CodeAltitudeAdjustmentType-HAA.comment: Minimum required HAA (height above airport) calculated, round to a reportable value, and applied for charted

CodeAltitudeAdjustmentType-MA.comment: Missed approach due to obstacle penetration of missed approach slope (segment assessment area)

CodeAltitudeAdjustmentType-SA.comment: Secondary area (also X/y surfaces, transition areas)

CodeAltitudeAdjustmentType-VA.comment: Vegetation Allowance. Designates an adjustment to a terrain value to account for natural vegetation growth.

CodeAltitudeReportingCapabilityType-100_.comment: The target is capable of reporting the altitude in 100 FT increments

CodeAltitudeReportingCapabilityType-25_F.comment: The target is capable of reporting the altitude in 25 FT increments

CodeAltitudeUseType-ABOVE_LOWER.comment: At or above the lower altitude.

CodeAltitudeUseType-AS_ASSIGNED.comment: To be assigned at the time of operations (for example, by ATC)

CodeAltitudeUseType-BELOW_UPPER.comment: At or below the higher altitude.

CodeAltitudeUseType-BETWEEN.comment: Between the lower and the upper altitude.

CodeApproachEquipmentAdditionalType-DUAL.comment: DME and dual ADF required for LOC approach

CodeApproachEquipmentAdditionalType-SPEC.comment: al aircraft and aircrew certification required

CodeApproachLightingICAOType-CAT1.comment: Precision approach category I lighting system

CodeApproachLightingICAOType-CAT23.comment: Precision approach category II and III lighting system

CodeApproachLightingICAOType-CIRCLING.comment: Circling guidance lighting system (ICAO Annex 14, Vol 1, 5.3.6)

CodeApproachLightingICAOType-NONE.comment: Does not classify as an ICAO type

CodeApproachLightingICAOType-SIMPLE.comment: Simple approach lighting system (ICAO Annex 14, Vol 1, 5.3.4.2)

CodeApproachLightingSystemType-AFOVRN.comment: US Air Force Overrun 1000 Foot Standard Approach Lighting System

CodeApproachLightingSystemType-ALSF_1.comment: Approach Lighting System with Sequenced Flashing Lights configuration 1

CodeApproachLightingSystemType-ALSF_2.comment: Approach Lighting System with Sequence Flashing Lights configuration 2

CodeApproachLightingSystemType-CALVERT_I.comment: ICAO-compliant configuration 1 High Intensity Approach Lighting System (HIALS)
ICAO-compliant configuration 2 High Intensity Approach Lighting System (HIALS)

CodeApproachLightingSystemType-MALSF.comment: Medium Intensity Approach Lighting System with Sequenced Flashers

CodeApproachLightingSystemType-MALSR.comment: Medium Approach Light System with Runway Alignment Indicator Lights

CodeApproachLightingSystemType-SSALF.comment: Simplified Short Approach Lighting System with Sequenced Flashing Lights

CodeApproachLightingSystemType-SSALR.comment: Simplified Short Approach Lighting System with Runway Alignment Indicator Lights

CodeApproachPrefixType-CONVERGING.comment: Parallel or joining operation with parallel or joining ILS courses

CodeApproachPrefixType-HI.comment: Approach procedures with segments such as a high altitude teardrop penetration that are within the high airspace stratum, requested by Military. Normally C, D and E Minimums only.

CodeApproachType-DME_DME.comment: Distance Measuring Equipment with Distance Measuring Equipment.

CodeApproachType-ILS_DME.comment: Instrument landing system with Direction measuring equipment

CodeApproachType-ILS_PRM.comment: Instrument landing system using a Precision runway monitor

CodeApproachType-LDA_DME.comment: Localizer Type Directional Aid with Distance Measuring Equipment.

CodeApproachType-LOC_DME_BC.comment: Localizer with Distance Measuring Equipment back course

CodeApproachType-MLS_DME.comment: Microwave Landing System with Distance Measuring Equipment.

CodeApproachType-NDB_DME.comment: Non-Directional Beacon with Distance Measuring Equipment.

CodeApproachType-VORTAC.comment: VHF Omni directional Radio with UHF Tactical Air Navigation beacon

CodeApproachType-VOR_DME.comment: VHF Omni directional Radio with Distance Measuring Equipment.

CodeApronElementType-CARGO_LOADING_AREA.comment: Cargo Loading Area used for loading and unloading cargo.

CodeApronElementType-HARDSTAND.comment: Area for parking a single aircraft more temporary than a parking area.

CodeApronElementType-PASSENGER_LOADING_A.comment: Passenger loading area used for loading/unloading of passengers.

CodeApronElementType-RAMP.comment: Access pavement between maintenance hangers opening to the apron and the apron edge.

CodeApronElementType-TAXILANE.comment: Area where plane is still under terminal control (airline dispatched) as opposed to tower control.

CodeApronElementType-TURNAROUND.comment: Area for aircraft to turn around.

CodeApronServiceType-APRON.comment: Apron management service available at an apron area.

CodeApronServiceType-MARSHAL.comment: Marshal management service available at an apron area.

CodeArrestingGearEnergyAbsorbType-BARRIE.comment: Safe-land Barrier pneumatic disc brake. Used only with a net engagement device. May be designated as 'DJ'.

CodeArrestingGearEnergyAbsorbType-CHAIN_.comment: CHAG chain brake. May be used with any type of engagement device. May be designated as 'BS'.

CodeCTAStatusType-CTA_ALLOCATED.comment: A status code indicating that the system has generated a CTA for the flight.

CodeCTAStatusType-CTA_PROPOSED.comment: A status code indicating that the i4d process had been initiated.

CodeCTAStatusType-CTA_SUITABLE.comment: A status code indicating that the flight deck has agreed to the proposed CTA/CTO.

CodeCTAStatusType-CTA_UNSUCCESSFUL.comment: A status code indicating that the CTA process has failed, i.e. no CTA constraint could be established.

CodeCTAStatusType-I4D_ELIGIBLE.comment: A status code indicating that the flight is eligible for i4D operations (this requires not only equipment but also certain flight conditions to be met).

CodeCTAStatusType-I4D_EQUIPPED.comment: A status code indicating that the CTA process has proceed to the stage that the aircraft executing the flight is suitably equipped to be subjected to i4D procedures (1st precondition of i4D operations).

CodeCTAStatusType-I4D_LOGGED_ON.comment: A status code indicating that the flight in question is logged on to air/ground communications with the i4D enabled equipment (2nd precondition of i4D operations).

CodeCTAStatusType-I4D_NOT_ELIGIBLE.comment: A status code indicating that the flight cannot be handled using i4D.

CodeCapacityType-AERODROME_RUNWAY_INFRAS.comment: Number of arrivals per hour which can be accommodated by the entire runway infrastructure at the airport.
Number of departures per hour which can be accommodated by the entire runway infrastructure at the airport.
Total movements per hour which can be accommodated by the entire runway infrastructure at the airport.

CodeCapacityType-AIRPORT_CAPACITY.comment: The number of arrivals, departures and total aircraft movements, taking into account the composite effect of airside taxiway and landside constraints.

CodeCapacityType-DEFAULT_CAPACITY.comment: The default capacity value is given for one hour not specifying a period. It applies when there is no permanent or temporary values defined for a particular period.

CodeCapacityType-PERMANENT_CAPACITY.comment: The permanent hourly capacity values for the period of the week within which it is applicable.

CodeCapacityType-RUNWAY_CAPACITY.comment: The number of aircraft movements which aeronautical authorities determine can safely be operated, usually stated as the total number of landings and take-offs per hour, taking into account such factors as the physical characteristics of the runways and the surrounding area, altitude, the types of aircraft involved (larger aircraft may mandate greater separation) and air traffic control (approach and aerodrome control) capabilities.

CodeCapacityType-RUNWAY_DIRECTION_ARRIVA.comment: Number of arrivals per hour which can be accommodated by the runway.

CodeCapacityType-RUNWAY_DIRECTION_DEPART.comment: Number of departures per hour which can be accommodated by the runway.

CodeCapacityType-TEMPORARY_CAPACITY.comment: The temporary hourly capacity values for the period of the week within which it is applicable. Temporary overrides Permanent and Default Capacity.

CodeCapacityType-TERMINAL_CAPACITY.comment: The number of passengers and tonnes of cargo per hour which can be processed in a terminal building (sometimes referred to as passenger throughput or cargo throughput).

CodeChangeIndicatorType-BECMG.comment: A code used to describe changes where the meteorological conditions are expected to reach or pass through specified threshold values at a regular or irregular rate and at an unspecified time during the time period.

CodeChangeIndicatorType-NOSIG.comment: No significant changes are forecast with respect to the current meteorological conditions.

CodeChangeIndicatorType-TEMPO.comment: A code used to describe expected frequent or infrequent temporary fluctuations in the meteorological conditions which reach or pass specified threshold values and last for a period of less than one hour in each instance and, in the aggregate, cover less than one-half of the forecast period during which the fluctuations are expected to occur.

CodeCivilMilitaryCrossingStatusType-ACCE.comment: The crossing conditions (either first request or subsequent request or alternatively proposed) are accepted by the other unit.

CodeCivilMilitaryCrossingStatusType-COUN.comment: The other unit counter-proposes alternative crossing conditions in reply to the first crossing request (before any conditions have ever been agreed between the two units).

CodeCivilMilitaryCrossingStatusType-NOTI.comment: The crossing is notified to the downstream unit.

CodeCivilMilitaryCrossingStatusType-NO_C.comment: The crossing is not yet notified to the downstream unit.

CodeCivilMilitaryCrossingStatusType-REJE.comment: The crossing conditions are rejected by the other unit.

CodeCivilMilitaryCrossingStatusType-REQU.comment: The crossing is requested formally to the downstream unit (first request).

CodeCivilMilitaryCrossingStatusType-REVI.comment: A unit requested some changes to previously agreed crossing conditions. These new conditions have still to be agreed.

The other unit counter-proposed alternative crossing conditions in response to a request to change the previously agreed conditions ("revised"), instead of accepting or rejecting the conditions proposed to it.

CodeClassB2TransmitPowerCapabilityType-G.comment: Capability of class B2 equipment to transmit power greater than or equal to 70 watts.

CodeClassB2TransmitPowerCapabilityType-L.comment: Capability of class B2 equipment to transmit power smaller than 70 watts.

CodeCloudType-ALTOCUMULUS.comment: White or grey, or both white and grey, patch, sheet or layer of cloud, generally with shading, composed of laminae, rounded masses, rolls, etc., which are sometimes partly fibrous or diffuse and which may or may not be merged; most of the regularly arranged small elements usually have an apparent width of between one and five degrees.

CodeCloudType-ALTOSTRATUS.comment: Greyish or bluish cloud sheet or layer of striated, fibrous or uniform appearance, totally or partly covering the sky, and having parts thin enough to reveal the Sun at least vaguely, as through ground glass. Altostratus does not show halo phenomena.

CodeCloudType-CIRROCUMULUS.comment: Thin, white patch, sheet or layer of cloud without shading, composed of very small elements in the form of grains, ripples, etc., merged or separated, and more or less regularly arranged; most of the elements have an apparent width of less than one degree.

CodeCloudType-CIRROSTRATUS.comment: Transparent, whitish cloud veil of fibrous (hair-like) or smooth appearance, totally or partially covering the sky, and generally producing halo phenomena.

CodeCloudType-CIRRUS.comment: Detached clouds in the form of white, delicate filaments or white or mostly white patches or narrow bands. These clouds have a fibrous (hair-like) appearance, or a silky sheen, or both.

CodeCloudType-CUMULONIMBUS.comment: Dense and heavy cloud with a considerable mountain- or tower-shaped vertical extension. These clouds, the base of which is quite dark, may give rise to thunderstorms and generally heavy precipitation in the form of rain, snow, fine or large hail, sometimes accompanied by strong wind gusts.

CodeCloudType-CUMULUS.comment: Detached cloud, generally dense and with sharp outlines, developing vertically in the form of rising mounds, domes or towers, of which the bulging upper part is often like a cauliflower. The sunlit parts are mostly brilliant white and the base is relatively dark and nearly horizontal. Sometimes Cumulus clouds are ragged.

CodeCloudType-NIMBOSTRATUS.comment: Grey cloud layer, often dark, the appearance of which is rendered diffuse by more or less continuously falling rain or snow, which in most cases reaches the ground. It is thick enough throughout to blot out the Sun. Low, ragged clouds frequently occur below the layer, with which they may or may not merge.

CodeCloudType-STRATOCUMULUS.comment: Banks or a layer of grey or whitish clouds generally caught on mountaintops. The base may be fuzzy or smooth and generally horizontal.

CodeCloudType-STRATUS.comment: Generally grey cloud layer with a fairly uniform base, which may give drizzle, ice prisms or snow grains. When the Sun is visible through the cloud, its outline is clearly discernible; Stratus does not produce halo phenomena except, possibly, at very low temperatures; sometimes it appears in the form of ragged patches.

CodeCloudType-TOWERING_CUMULUS.comment: A descriptive term, used mostly in weather observing, for cumulus congestus (Cu con).

CodeContaminationType-COMPACTED_OR_ROLLE.comment: Snow which has been compressed into a solid mass that resists further compression and will hold together or break up into lumps if picked up; specific gravity: 0.5 and over.

CodeContaminationType-DRY_SNOW.comment: Snow which can be blown if loose or, if compacted by hand, will fall apart again upon release; specific gravity: up to but not including 0.35.

CodeContaminationType-RIME_OR_FROST_COVE.comment: Rime or Frost covered (depth less than 1 mm)

CodeContaminationType-SLUSH.comment: Water-saturated snow which with a heel-and-toe slap down motion against the ground will be displaced with a splatter; specific gravity: 0.5 up to 0.8. Note.- Combinations of ice, snow and/or standing water may, especially when rain, rain and snow, or snow is falling, produce substances with specific gravities in excess of 0.8. These substances, due to their high water/ice content, will have a transparent rather than a cloudy appearance and, at the higher specific gravities, will be readily distinguishable from slush.

CodeContaminationType-WET_SNOW.comment: Snow which, if compacted by hand, will stick together and tend to or form a snowball; specific gravity: 0.35 up to but not including 0.5.

CodeCourseQualityILSType-T.comment: Usable up to a point 4m (12ft) above the runway centre line and 900m (3000ft) from the threshold in the direction of the localizer.

CodeDeclaredDistanceType-LDAH.comment: The length of the FATO plus any additional area declared available and suitable for helicopters to complete the landing manoeuvre from a defined height.

CodeDeclaredDistanceType-RTODAH.comment: The length of the FATO declared available and suitable for helicopters operated in performance class 1 to complete a rejected take-off.

CodeDeclaredDistanceType-TODA.comment: The length of the take-off run available plus the length of the clearway, if provided.

CodeDeclaredDistanceType-TODAH.comment: The length of the FATO plus the length of helicopter clearway (if provided) declared available and suitable for helicopters to complete the take-off.

CodeDeclaredDistanceType-TORA.comment: The length of runway declared available and suitable for the ground run of an aeroplane taking off.

CodeDeicingStatusType-CLEARED_TO_DEICING.comment: This value corresponds to the aircraft being cleared to undergo a de-icing procedure.

CodeDeicingStatusType-COMPLETED.comment: This value corresponds to the aircraft having terminated its de-icing procedure.

CodeDeicingStatusType-DEICING_REQUESTED.comment: This value corresponds to the de-icing procedure being requested for a given aircraft.

CodeDeicingStatusType-IN_POSITION.comment: The aircraft is in position waiting for the de-icing procedure to be started.

CodeDeicingStatusType-NO_DEICING.comment: This value corresponds to the default value, when the aircraft does not need to undergo a de-icing procedure.

CodeDeicingStatusType-STARTED.comment: The de-icing procedure has been started and is on going.

CodeDepartureClearanceStatusType-APPROVE.comment: The departure clearance being is approved (sending of the CRP message).

CodeDepartureClearanceStatusType-EXPIRED.comment: The delivered clearance is obsolete and is therefore no longer valid.

CodeDepartureClearanceStatusType-NOT_YET.comment: The departure clearance is not yet requested.

CodeDepartureClearanceStatusType-REQUEST.comment: The departure clearance is requested (sending of the CRQ message).

CodeDepartureSuspensionStatusType-NOT_SU.comment: The departure is not suspended, any previous departure suspension has been lifted.

CodeDepartureSuspensionStatusType-SUSPEN.comment: A departure suspension is in effect.

CodeEmergencyPhaseType-ALERFA.comment: The code word used to designate an alert phase.

CodeEmergencyPhaseType-DETRESFA.comment: The code word used to designate a distress phase.

CodeEmergencyPhaseType-INCERFA.comment: The code word used to designate an uncertainty phase.

CodeEmergencyStatusType-CANCELLED.comment: Indication that the emergency has been cancelled.

CodeEngineOperationModeType-CLIMB_OUT.comment: Engine operating in climb out mode.

CodeEquipmentOperationalType-NOT_OPERATI.comment: The related equipment is not operational

CodeEquipmentOperationalType-UNKNOWN.comment: The status of the related equipment is unknown

CodeEquipmentStatusType-EQUIPPED.comment: The aircraft is equipped with the aircraft equipment specified.

CodeEquipmentStatusType-NOT_EQUIPPED.comment: The aircraft is not equipped with the aircraft equipment specified.

CodeEquipmentStatusType-UNKNOWN.comment: The status of the equipment specified is unknown for the aircraft.

CodeFFICEStatusType-AGREED_4D_TRAJECTORY.comment: The current 4D trajectory that is agreed between the airspace user and the ASP after collaboration, or imposition of pre-collaborated rules.

CodeFFICEStatusType-NEGOTIATING_4D_TRAJE.comment: A 4D trajectory proposed by airspace user or ASP as a potential agreed 4D trajectory.

CodeFiledFlightRulesType-IFR.comment: The entire flight is intended to be operated under the IFR.

CodeFiledFlightRulesType-IFR_FIRST.comment: The flight will initially be operated under the IFR, followed by one or more subsequent changes of flight rules.

CodeFiledFlightRulesType-VFR.comment: The entire flight is intended to be operated under the VFR.

CodeFiledFlightRulesType-VFR_FIRST.comment: The flight will initially be operated under the VFR, followed by one or more subsequent changes of flight rules.

CodeFinalGuidanceType-ILS_DME.comment: Instrument landing system with Direction measuring equipment

CodeFinalGuidanceType-ILS_PRM.comment: Instrument landing system using a Precision runway monitor

CodeFinalGuidanceType-LDA_DME.comment: Localizer Type Directional Aid with Distance Measuring Equipment.

CodeFinalGuidanceType-LNAV.comment: Lateral navigation (LNAV) . The lateral navigation without positive vertical guidance. This type of navigation is associated with non precision approach procedures.

CodeFinalGuidanceType-LOC_DME_BC.comment: Localizer with Distance Measuring Equipment Back Course.

CodeFinalGuidanceType-LP.comment: A Localizer Performance (LP) approach is an RNAV non-vertically guided approach procedure evaluated using the lateral obstacle evaluation area dimensions of the precision localizer trapezoid, with adjustments specific to the WAAS. These procedures are published on RNAV GPS approaches as the LP minima line.

CodeFinalGuidanceType-LPV.comment: An LPV approach is classified as an APV procedure based on the lateral OCS dimensions of the precision approach trapezoid, with vertical guidance provided by the WAAS where the VAL is greater than 12 and less than or equal to 50 meters. These procedures are published on RNAV Global Positioning System (GPS) approach charts as the LPV minima line.

CodeFinalGuidanceType-MLS_DME.comment: Microwave Landing System with Distance Measuring Equipment.

CodeFinalGuidanceType-NDB_DME.comment: Non-Directional Beacon with Distance Measuring Equipment.

CodeFinalGuidanceType-VORTAC.comment: VHF Omni directional Radio with UHF Tactical Air Navigation beacon

CodeFinalGuidanceType-VOR_DME.comment: VHF Omni directional Radio with Distance Measuring Equipment.

CodeFireFightingType-A1.comment: A1 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 1..] [note: (ICAO, NATO) 0 up to but not including 9m over-all length and 2m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-A10.comment: A10 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 10.] [note: 76m up to but not including 91m over-all length and 8m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-A2.comment: A2 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 2..] [note: (ICAO, NATO) 9m up to but not including 12m over-all length and 2m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-A3.comment: A3 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 3..] [note: (ICAO, NATO) 12m up to but not including 18m over-all length and 3m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-A4.comment: A4 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 4..] [note: (ICAO, NATO) 18m up to but not including 24m over-all length and 4m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-A5.comment: A5 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 5..] [note: (ICAO, NATO) 24m up to but not including 28m over-all length and 4m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-A6.comment: A6 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 6..] [note: (ICAO, NATO) 28m up to but not including 39m over-all length and 5m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-A7.comment: A7 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 7..] [note: (ICAO, NATO) 39m up to but not including 49m over-all length and 5m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-A8.comment: A8 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 8..] [note: (ICAO, NATO) 49m up to but not including 61m over-all length and 7m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-A9.comment: A9 [(Aircraft) rescue and fire category 9..] [note: (ICAO, NATO) 61m up to but not including 76m over-all length and 7m maximum fuselage width. .]

CodeFireFightingType-H1.comment: H1 [(Helicopter) rescue and fire category 1..] [note: (ICAO) Up to but not including 15m in length. .]

CodeFireFightingType-H2.comment: H2 [(Helicopter) rescue and fire category 2..] [note: (ICAO) From 15m up to but not including 24m in length. .]

CodeFireFightingType-H3.comment: H3 [(Helicopter) rescue and fire category 3..] [note: (ICAO) From 24m up to but not including 35m in length. .]

CodeFlightCrewQualificationType-ENHANCED.comment: Enhanced flight vision system operations qualification

CodeFlightCrewQualificationType-HEAD_UP_.comment: Head-up guidance system for CAT III qualification
Head-up guidance system for CAT II qualification
Head-up guidance system for CAT I qualification

CodeFlightCrewQualificationType-PARALLEL.comment: Parallel runway paired approach operations qualification

CodeFlightCrewQualificationType-RNP_AR_A.comment: RNP AR APCH without RF qualification
RNP AR APCH with RF qualification

CodeFlightCrewQualificationType-SIMULTAN.comment: Simultaneous closely spaced parallel approach qualification

CodeFlightCrewQualificationType-SURFACE_.comment: Surface moving map display operations qualification

CodeFlightDataKindType-ALTERNATIVE.comment: The flight is a copy of a real flight (it is an alternative or what-if flight).

CodeFlightOriginType-HOME_BASED.comment: The flight is operated with an aircraft currently stationed at the airport in question.

CodeFlightPhaseType-AIRSPACE_OCCUPANCY_P.comment: The phase of flight during which the aircraft flies within a given airspace.

CodeFlightPhaseType-APPROACH_HOLDING_PHA.comment: The phase of flight in which a pre-determined ad-hoc manoeuvre during the approach keeps the aircraft within a specified airspace awaiting further instructions.

CodeFlightPhaseType-APPROACH_PHASE.comment: The phase of flight from the outer marker to the to the point of transition from nose-low to nose-high attitude immediately prior to the flare above the runway [ifr]; or [vfr] from 1500 feet (450 metres) above the runway end elevation or from the point of vfr pattern entry to the flare above the runway.

CodeFlightPhaseType-CHANGE_OF_CRUISE_LEV.comment: The phase of flight during which the aircraft climbs, or descends, from one cruising flight level or altitude to the next cruising flight level or altitude.

CodeFlightPhaseType-CRUISE_PHASE.comment: The phase of flight from the top of climb to cruise altitude, or flight level, to the start of the descent toward the destination aerodrome or landing site.

CodeFlightPhaseType-EMERGENCY_DESCENT_PH.comment: The phase of flight in which an intentionally rapid or premature descent, from a previously normal manoeuvre, is made in response to an in-flight emergency. the descent is controlled by the crew.

CodeFlightPhaseType-ENROUTE_HOLDING_PHAS.comment: The phase of flight, in which a pre-determined ad-hoc manoeuvre occurs, which keeps the aircraft within a specified airspace en-route awaiting further instructions.

CodeFlightPhaseType-ENROUTE_PHASE.comment: The phase of flight from the completion of initial climb at the departure aerodrome to the completion of controlled descent to the outer marker [ifr] or [vfr] to completion of the controlled descent to the vfr pattern or 1,500 feet [450 metres] above runway end elevation, whichever comes first.

CodeFlightPhaseType-FINAL_APPROACH_PHASE.comment: That part of an instrument approach procedure which commences at the specified final approach fix or point, or where such a fix or point is not specified, a) at the end of the last procedure turn, base turn or inbound turn of a racetrack procedure, if specified; or b) at the point of interception of the last track specified in the approach procedure; and ends at a point in the vicinity of an aerodrome from which: 1) a landing can be made; or 2) a missed approach procedure is initiated.

CodeFlightPhaseType-INITIAL_CLIMB_PHASE.comment: The phase of flight from 50 feet [15 metres] above runway end elevation to the first prescribed power reduction, or until reaching 1500 feet (450 metres).

CodeFlightPhaseType-INTERMEDIATE_APPROAC.comment: The phase of flight between the middle approach fix and the final approach fix; or between the end of a reversal procedure or dead-reckoning track procedure and the final approach fix.

CodeFlightPhaseType-LANDING_PHASE.comment: The phase of flight from the point of transition from nose-low to nose-up attitude, immediately before landing (flare), through touchdown and until aircraft exits landing runway or comes to a stop, whichever occurs first.

CodeFlightPhaseType-STANDING_IN_PHASE.comment: The phase of a flight starting from end of taxi in and ending when all activities related to the aircraft for the performed flight has been completed.

CodeFlightPhaseType-STANDING_OUT_PHASE.comment: The phase of a flight from the start of activities preparing the aircraft for a flight until the start of the taxi out.

CodeFlightPhaseType-STAY_PHASE.comment: A period of 'special activity' when the aircraft will 'stay' in the area defined for a given length of time.

CodeFlightPhaseType-TAKEOFF_PHASE.comment: The phase of flight from the application of take-off power until reaching the first prescribed power reduction, or until reaching the vfr pattern or 1,500 feet (450 metres) above runway end elevation, whichever comes first or the termination (abort) of the take-off.

CodeFlightPhaseType-TAXI_IN_PHASE.comment: Phase of flight from Landing until In-Block, that includes the Surface Movement associated to the arrival of a flight.

CodeFlightPhaseType-TAXI_OUT_PHASE.comment: Phase of flight from Off-Block until Take-Off, that includes the Surface Movement associated to the departure of a flight

CodeFlightPhaseType-UNCONTROLLED_DESCENT.comment: The phase of flight in which an uncontrolled descent from a previously normal manoeuvre occurs.

CodeFlightPhaseType-UNKNOWN_PHASE.comment: Phase of flight is not discernable from the information available

CodeFlightReadyStatusType-NOT_READY_FOR_.comment: The flight is not in Request For direct Improvement mode (RFI) state.

CodeFlightReadyStatusType-READY_FOR_IMPR.comment: The flight is in Request For direct Improvement mode (RFI) state.

CodeFlightReadyStatusType-READY_TO_DEPAR.comment: The flight is ready to depart (REA message received).

CodeFlightRestrictionType-ALLOWED.comment: Flights that comply with the condition are explicitly permitted to use the associated routings, even if other more general flight restrictions forbid the routings (for the same flight conditions).

CodeFlightRestrictionType-CLOSED.comment: Closed for cruising. [note: It is allowed to climb or descend through the levels associated with the restriction but it is not allowed to fly straight and level on the said levels, in any part of the route. .]

CodeFlightRulesType-IFR.comment: A set of rules governing the conduct of flight under instrument meteorological conditions.

CodeFlightRulesType-VFR.comment: A set of rules governing the conduct of flight under visual meteorological conditions.

CodeFlightStatusForCountType-ATC_ACTIVAT.comment: The flight is ATC activated in the NM system, after reception of an ATC message such as FSA.

CodeFlightStatusForCountType-IFPL.comment: The flight is created from a flight plan filed to IFPS.

CodeFlightStatusForCountType-PFD.comment: The flight is predicted and has not been suspended.

CodeFlightStatusForCountType-RPL.comment: The flight is created from a repetitive flight plan, is not suspended and no flight plan has been filed yet by the Airspace user or by IFPS.

CodeFlightStatusForCountType-TACT_ACTIVA.comment: The flight that has been TACT activated with no FSA message expected.
The flight that has been TACT activated with FSA message expected but not yet received.

CodeFlightType-ALL.comment: Both Operational and General Air Traffic.

CodeFlightType-GENERAL_AIR_TRAFFIC.comment: A flight conducted in accordance with the rules and procedures of ICAO.

CodeFlightType-GENERAL_AVIATION_CHARTER.comment: The flight is a general aviation charter

CodeFlightType-GENERAL_AVIATION_FRACTION.comment: The flight is a general aviation fractional

CodeFlightType-GENERAL_AVIATION_OPERATIO.comment: An aircraft operation other than a commercial air transport operation or an aerial work operation.

CodeFlightType-MILITARY_FLIGHT.comment: Operations of the armed forces other than those for remuneration which should be covered under public transport operations.

CodeFlightType-NON_SCHEDULED_REVENUE_OPE.comment: Charter flight or special flight performed for remuneration other than scheduled flight.

CodeFlightType-OPERATIONAL_AIR_TRAFFIC.comment: A flight which do not comply with the provisions stated for general air traffic and for which rules and procedures have been specified by appropriate national authorities.

CodeFlightType-POLICE_FLIGHT.comment: A flight carried out by the police.

CodeFlightType-SCHEDULED_AIR_SERVICE.comment: An air service open to use by the general public and operated according to a published timetable or with such a regular frequency that it constitutes an easily recognizable systematic series of flights which are open to direct booking by members of the public.
