CodeFlightType-UNMANNED_AIRCRAFT_SYSTEM.comment: The flight is unmanned aircraft system

CodeFlightType-UNMANNED_AIRCRAFT_SYSTEM_.comment: The flight is unmanned aircraft system military

CodeFlowCombinationRoleType-EXCLUDED.comment: Flights on EXCLUDED flows are not considered part of the traffic volume (so they are not taken into account in flight lists or counts or regulations on that traffic volume).

CodeFlowCombinationRoleType-EXEMPTED.comment: Flights on EXEMPTED flows are considered part of the traffic volume if there are no INCLUDED / INCLUDED_AND_EXEMPTED flows (so they are taken into account in flight lists or counts on that traffic volume). However, w.r.t. regulations and delay: the flights are exempted. This means only exceptional constraint regulations can impact the flight.

CodeFlowCombinationRoleType-INCLUDED.comment: Flights on INCLUDED flows are considered part of the traffic volume. If there are INCLUDED or INCLUDED_AND_EXEMPTED flows, then any flight that is not on an INCLUDED or INCLUDED_AND_EXEMPTED flow, is considered not part of the traffic volume.

CodeFlowCombinationRoleType-INCLUDED_EXE.comment: Flights on an INCLUDED_AND_EXEMPTED flow, are considered part of the traffic volume. However hey are also considered as an INCLUDED flow (w.r.t. other flights that are not on an INCLUDED flow) and as an EXEMPTED flow (w.r.t. regulations).

CodeFrictionEstimateType-UNRELIABLE.comment: The surface conditions or available friction measuring device do not permit a reliable surface friction measurement to be made.

CodeFuelType-F18.comment: F-18 [(NATO) aviation gasoline (low lead) - equivalent AVGAS 100LL.]

CodeFuelType-F34.comment: F-34 [(NATO) jet aviation fuel with FSII - equivalent JP-8.]

CodeFuelType-F35.comment: F-35 [(NATO) jet aviation fuel - equivalent JET A-1.]

CodeFuelType-F40.comment: F-40 [(NATO) jet aviation fuel with FSII - equivalent JP-4.]

CodeFuelType-F44.comment: F-44 [(NATO) jet aviation fuel with FSII - equivalent JP-5.]

CodeFuelType-JP8_HIGHER.comment: Jet JP-8 with higher thermal stability.

CodeFuelType-JPTS.comment: Jet JP fuel with higher thermal stability.

CodeGradeSeparationType-OVERPASS.comment: The current element is on a bridge above another element.

CodeGradeSeparationType-UNDERPASS.comment: The current element is in a tunnel below another element.

CodeGroundLightingType-AERONAUTICAL_BEAC.comment: An aeronautical ground light visible at all azimuths, either continuously or intermittently, to designate a particular point on the surface of the earth.

CodeGroundLightingType-AIRPORT_BEACON.comment: Aeronautical beacon used to indicate the location of an airport from the air.

CodeGroundLightingType-HAZARD_BEACON.comment: An aeronautical beacon used to designate a danger to air navigation.

CodeGroundLightingType-HELIPORT_BEACON.comment: Aeronautical beacon used to indicate the location of an heliport from the air.

CodeGroundLightingType-IDENTIFICATION_BE.comment: An aeronautical beacon emitting a coded signal by means of which a particular point of reference can be identified.

CodeGuidanceLineType-AIR_TAXILANE.comment: A virtual taxi line in the air, used by helicopters.

CodeGuidanceLineType-APRON.comment: Taxi line on the apron surface.

CodeGuidanceLineType-GATE_TAXILANE.comment: Taxi line on the apron surface, leading to a gate/stand.

CodeGuidanceLineType-RUNWAY.comment: Taxi line on a runway surface, leading between the runway and other airport surfaces.

CodeGuidanceLineType-TAXIWAY_GUIDANCE_LI.comment: Guidance line painted on a taxiway.

CodeHeadingType-RELATIVE_HEADING.comment: Heading is relative to the trajectory heading or track direction.

CodeHeightReferenceType-HAS.comment: Height above surface (for a point in space).

CodeHoldingSideType-LEFT.comment: Holding side is on the left

CodeHoldingSideType-RIGHT.comment: Holding side is on the right

CodeHoldingUseType-ARRIVAL.comment: Arrival holding. A holding pattern provided at any Initial Approach Fix (IAF) and should be aligned with the initial segment track.

CodeHoldingUseType-ATC.comment: A holding pattern defined specifically for ATC use.

CodeHoldingUseType-CLIMB.comment: A holding pattern used in conjunction with climb and hold instructions.

CodeHoldingUseType-MISSED_APPROACH.comment: Missed Approach Holding. A holding pattern provided at the end of the missed approach

CodeHoldingUseType-PT.comment: The holding pattern is used as a procedure turn. (Commonly referred to as Holding in Lieu of Procedure Turn.)

CodeIATACoordinationLevelType-LEVEL_1_AI.comment: An airport where the capacities of all infrastructure at the airport are generally adequate to meet the demands of users at all times. A Level 1 airport is often named “Non-Coordinated airport”.

CodeIATACoordinationLevelType-LEVEL_2_AI.comment: An airport where there is potential for congestion during some periods of the day, week, or season which can be resolved by schedule adjustments mutually agreed between the airlines and facilitator.

CodeIATACoordinationLevelType-LEVEL_3_AI.comment: An airport where it is necessary for all airlines and other aircraft operators to have a slot allocated by a coordinator in order to arrive or depart at the airport during the periods when slot allocation occurs. A Level 3 airport is often named

CodeIATACountryCodeType-MK.comment: Macedonia, the former Yugoslav Republic of

CodeIATASeasonType-SUMMER.comment: The summer season commencing on the last Sunday in March.

CodeIATASeasonType-WINTER.comment: The winter season commencing on the last Sunday in October.

CodeICAOCertificationType-CERTIFIED.comment: The airport has received ICAO certification for conformity to applicable safety regulatory requirements.

CodeICAOCertificationType-CERTIFIED_WITH.comment: The airport has received ICAO certification for conformity to applicable safety regulatory requirements, but with some exceptions not detailed here.

CodeICAOCertificationType-NOT_CERTIFIED.comment: The airport has not received ICAO certification for conformity to applicable safety regulatory requirements.

CodeICAONationalityLettersType-LW.comment: The former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia

CodeInstructionToAircraftType-LEAVE_STAN.comment: The aircraft is instructed to leave the stand until departure is no longer suspended. (In this case a further instruction has to be provided to the aircraft to indicate which place to go on the aerodrome after leaving stand)

CodeInstructionToAircraftType-STAY_ON_ST.comment: The aircraft is instructed to stay on the stand until the departure is no longer suspended.

CodeInstrumentApproachCategoryType-CATEG.comment: A precision instrument approach and landing with: a) a decision height lower than 30 m (100 ft) or no decision height; and b) a runway visual range not less than 200 m.
A precision instrument approach and landing with: a) a decision height lower than 15 m (50 ft) or no decision height; and b) a runway visual range less than 200 m but not less than 50 m.
A precision instrument approach and landing with no decision height and no runway visual range limitations.
A precision instrument approach and landing with a decision height lower than 60 m (200 ft), but not lower than 30 m (100 ft), and a runway visual range not less than 350 m.
A precision instrument approach and landing with a decision height not lower than 60 m (200 ft) and with either a visibility not less than 800 m or a runway visual range not less than 550 m.

CodeInstrumentApproachCategoryType-NON_P.comment: An instrument approach and landing which utilizes lateral guidance but does not utilize vertical guidance.

CodeInstrumentRunwayType-MLS_PRECISION_A.comment: Microwave landing system precision approach runway.

CodeInstrumentRunwayType-NON_INSTRUMENT_.comment: A runway intended for the operation of aircraft using visual approach procedures.

CodeInstrumentRunwayType-NON_PRECISION_A.comment: An instrument runway served by visual aids and a non-visual aid providing at least directional guidance adequate for a straight-in approach.

CodeInstrumentRunwayType-PRECISION_APPRO.comment: An instrument runway served by ILS and/or MLS and visual aids intended for operations with a decision height not lower than 60 m (200 ft) and either a visibility not less than 800 m or a runway visual range not less than 550 m.

An instrument runway served by ILS and/or MLS and visual aids intended for operations with a decision height lower than 60 m (200 ft) but not lower than 30 m (100 ft) and a runway visual range not less than 350 m.

An instrument runway served by ILS and/or MLS to and along the surface of the runway and intended for operations with a decision height lower than 30 m (100 ft), or no decision height and runway visual range not less than 200 m.

An instrument runway served by ILS and/or MLS to and along the surface of the runway and intended for operations with a decision height lower than 15 m (50 ft), or no decision height and runway visual range less than 200 m but not less than 50 m.
An instrument runway served by ILS and/or MLS to and along the surface of the runway and intended for operations with no decisions height and no runway visual range limitations.
ILS precision approach runway category III D

CodeInternationalFlightType-DOMESTIC_AIR.comment: An air service operated wholly within the territory of a State.

CodeInternationalFlightType-INTERNATIONA.comment: An air service that passes through the airspace over the territory of more than one State.

CodeInternationalFlightType-SCHENGEN_FLI.comment: A flight that crosses at least one country border inside the Schengen space. An international flight air service may be a Schengen flight.

CodeLAHSOMarkingType-FLIGHT_PATH.comment: A flight path is being protected

CodeLAHSOMarkingType-RUNWAY_AND_TAXIWAY.comment: A taxiway and a runway are being protected

CodeLevelSeriesType-EVEN_HALF.comment: Intermediate flight levels, above even levels (5, 25, 45, 65, ...)

CodeLevelSeriesType-ODD_HALF.comment: Intermediate flight levels, above odd levels (15, 35, 55, 75, ...)

CodeLevelTableDesignatorType-IFR_METRES_.comment: ICAO IFR in meters in areas with RVSM

CodeLevelTableDesignatorType-IFR_RVSM.comment: ICAO IFR in areas with RVSM

CodeLevelTableDesignatorType-VFR_METRES_.comment: ICAO VFR in meters in areas with RVSM.

CodeLevelTableDesignatorType-VFR_RVSM.comment: ICAO VFR in areas with RVSM.

CodeLifeJacketEquipmentType-F.comment: The life jackets are equipped with fluorescein.

CodeLifeJacketEquipmentType-L.comment: The life jackets are equipped with lights.

CodeLifeJacketEquipmentType-U.comment: Any life jacket radio is equipped with UHF on frequency 243.0 MHz.

CodeLifeJacketEquipmentType-V.comment: Any life jacket radio is equipped with VHF on frequency 121.5 MHz.

CodeLightBulbType-BOTH.comment: Combination of LED and Incandescent light bulbs.

CodeLightHoldingPositionType-SIGN.comment: Lighted sign on the side of the holding position.

CodeLightHoldingPositionType-STOP_BAR.comment: Stop-bar (on the surface of the taxiway).

CodeLightIntensityType-LIL_LIH.comment: Low intensity for night use; high intensity for day use, as determined by a photo-cell.

CodeLightIntensityType-PREDETERMINED.comment: A predetermined intensity step, in the approach lighting system that takes precedence for air-to-ground radio control over the runway lighting system which is set, based on expected visibility conditions.

CodeLightSourceType-FLOOD.comment: Flood light. The light source contains a large powerful lamp that produces a strong broad beam of artificial light and is used to illuminate the outside at night.

CodeLightSourceType-STROBE.comment: Strobe light. This indicates that the light source contains a high intensity flashing beam of light produced by charging a capacitor to a very high voltage then discharging it as a high-intensity flash of light in a tube.

CodeLightSystemActivationType-ON_OR_OFF.comment: System changes between "ON" and "OFF", depending on the previous state.

CodeLightingJARType-BALS.comment: Basic approach light facilities; comprise runway markings, less than 420 m of high/medium intensity approach lights (or any length of low intensity approach lights), runway edge lights, threshold lights and runway end lights.

CodeLightingJARType-FALS.comment: Full approach light facilities; comprise runway markings, 720 m or more of high/medium intensity approach lights, runway edge lights, threshold lights and runway end lights.

CodeLightingJARType-IALS.comment: Intermediate approach light facilities; comprise runway markings, 420 to 720 m of high/medium intensity approach lights, runway edge lights, threshold lights and runway end lights.

CodeLightingJARType-NALS.comment: None or insufficient approach light facilities; comprise runway markings, runway edge lights, threshold lights, runway end lights or no lights at all.

CodeLogicalOperatorType-AND.comment: The result is true only when all operands are true.

CodeLogicalOperatorType-AND_NOT.comment: 1st condition fulfilled AND 2nd condition NOT fulfilled.

CodeLogicalOperatorType-NOT.comment: The result is the opposite of the operands true/false state (it applies to a single operand).

CodeLogicalOperatorType-OR.comment: The result is true if any operand is true.

CodeLogicalOperatorType-SEQUENCE.comment: 1st condition is fulfilled BEFORE 2nd condition is fulfilled.

CodeMCDMCoordinationActorRoleType-IMPLEM.comment: The actor needs to implement the measure/action on a flight.

CodeMCDMCoordinationActorRoleType-INFO.comment: The actor is informed about the MCDM.

CodeMCDMCoordinationActorRoleType-INITIA.comment: The actor is the initiator of the measure/action on a flight.

CodeMCDMCoordinationActorRoleType-NOT_IN.comment: The actor is not involved in the measure/action on a flight.

CodeMCDMCoordinationActorRoleType-ROLE_I.comment: The role of this actor needs to be manually checked.

CodeMCDMCoordinationApprovalStatusType-A.comment: MCDM Coordination approval status is unknown.

CodeMCDMCoordinationLevelType-ACTION_ON_.comment: Coordination is done at the level of an action of a flight.

CodeMCDMCoordinationLevelType-MEASURE.comment: Coordination is done at the level of an AFTM measure.

CodeMCDMCoordinationStatusType-COORDINAT.comment: The MCDM coordination is being coordinated.

CodeMCDMCoordinationStatusType-IMPLEMENT.comment: The MCDM coordination is being implemented.

CodeMarkingPatternType-INTERMEDIATE.comment: ICAO intermediate holding position marking (single dashed line)

CodeMarkingPatternType-NON_MOVEMENT_AREA.comment: FAA non-movement area boundary marking (single-solid and single-dashed lines)

CodeMarkingPatternType-PATTERN_A.comment: Conventional runway holding position marking (two solid and two dashed lines)

CodeMilitaryOperationsType-CIVIL.comment: Only Civil Air traffic is concerned.

CodeMilitaryOperationsType-JOINT.comment: Both Civil and Military air traffic are concerned.

CodeMilitaryOperationsType-MILITARY.comment: Only Military Air traffic is concerned.

CodeMilitaryTrainingType-SR.comment: Slow Speed Low Altitude Training Route

CodeMinimaFinalApproachPathType-CIRCLING.comment: Final approach path is circling above the airport. [ICAO] Circling approach. An extension of an instrument approach procedure which provides for visual circling of the aerodrome prior to landing.

CodeMinimaFinalApproachPathType-SIDESTEP.comment: A sidestep manoeuvre is the visual alignment manoeuvre, required by a pilot executing an approach to one runway and cleared to land on a parallel runway.

CodeMinimaFinalApproachPathType-STRAIGHT.comment: Final approach path is straight in to a landing surface (S 9R). [FAAO 8260.3] A descent in an approved procedure where the navigation facility alignment is normally on the runway centreline, and glide slope (GS) information is provided.

CodeMinimumAltitudeType-DA.comment: A specified altitude in the precision approach or approach with vertical guidance at which a missed approach must be initiated if the required visual reference to continue the approach has not been established.

CodeMinimumAltitudeType-MDA.comment: A specified altitude in a non-precision approach or circling approach below which descent must not be made without the required visual reference.

CodeMinimumAltitudeType-OCA.comment: The lowest altitude above the elevation of the relevant runway threshold or the aerodrome elevation as applicable, used in establishing compliance with appropriate obstacle clearance criteria.

CodeMinimumHeightType-DH.comment: A specified height in the precision approach or approach with vertical guidance at which a missed approach must be initiated if the required visual reference to continue the approach has not been established.

CodeMinimumHeightType-MDH.comment: A specified height in a non-precision approach or circling approach below which descent must not be made without the required visual reference.

CodeMinimumHeightType-OCH.comment: The lowest height above the elevation of the relevant runway threshold or the aerodrome elevation as applicable, used in establishing compliance with appropriate obstacle clearance criteria.

CodeMissedApproachType-ALTERNATE.comment: A missed approach to be used when directed by ATC.

CodeMissedApproachType-ENGINEOUT.comment: Missed Approach to be used when Engine Out

CodeMissedApproachType-SECONDARY.comment: An alternate missed approach to be used instead of primary.

CodeMissedApproachType-TACAN.comment: A missed approach to be used when using TACAN guidance.

CodeMissedApproachType-TACANALT.comment: An alternate missed approach to be used instead of TACAN missed approach when directed by ATC.

CodeNDBUsageType-LOCATOR.comment: Locator - low powered NDB used as an aid for final approach.

CodeNasRoleType-ALONE.comment: The Country is not related to a Nas.

CodeNasRoleType-PARTNER.comment: The Country delegates its Nas responsibility to a responsible Country. It is a partner of this responsible Country.

CodeNasRoleType-RESPONSIBLE.comment: The Country is responsible for a Nas.

CodeNavaidPurposeType-TERMINAL.comment: Intended for usage in the terminal area, in particular for approach, landing and departure procedures

CodeNavaidServiceType-ILS_DME.comment: ILS with collocated DME. Collocation can be with the antenna or the loc.

CodeNavaidServiceType-NDB_MKR.comment: Non-Directional Radio Beacon and Marker Beacon

CodeNavigationCapabilityType-GBAS_AAST_A.comment: GBAS AAST and ranging source type VNAV capability.

CodeNitrogenSupplyType-LHNG.comment: Low and high pressure nitrogen servicing.

CodeNitrogenSupplyType-NG.comment: Indicates nitrogen servicing when type of servicing is unspecified.

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_10.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 10 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 10 Applicability: - “Propeller driven aeroplanes not exceeding 8616 kg – application for type certificate or derived version submitted on or after 17 november 1988.”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_11.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 11 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 11 Applicability: - “Helicopters not exceeding 3175 kg maximum certificated take off mass.”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_12.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 12 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 12 Applicability: - “Supersonic aeroplanes”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_13.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 13 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 13 Applicability: - “Tilt rotor aircraft”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_2.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 2 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 2 Applicability: “Subsonic jet aeroplanes - Application for type certificate submitted before 6 october 1977”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_3.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 3 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 3 Applicability: - “Subsonic jet aeroplanes – application for type certificate submitted on or after 6 october 1977 and before 1 january 2006” - “Propeller-driven aeroplanes over 5700 kg – application for type certificate submitted on or after 1 january 1985 and before 17 november 1988” - “Propeller-driven aeroplanes over 8616 kg – application for type certificate submitted on or after 6 october 1977 and before 1 january 2006”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_4.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 4 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 4 Applicability: - “Subsonic jet aeroplanes – application for type certificate submitted on or after 1 january 2006” - “Propeller-Driven Aeroplanes over 8618 kg – application Certificate submitted on or after 1 january 2006”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_5.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 5 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 5 Applicability: - “Propeller-Driven Aeroplanes over 5700 kg – application Certificate submitted before 1 january 1985”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_6.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 6 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 6 Applicability: - “Propeller-Driven Aeroplanes not exceeding 8616 kg – application Certificate submitted before 17 november 1988”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_7.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 7 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 7 Applicability: - “Propeller-Driven Short Take Off and Landing (STOL) Aeroplanes”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_8.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 8 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 8 Applicability: - “Helicopters”

CodeNoiseCertificationType-CHAPTER_9.comment: Aircraft noise certification chapter 9 Complete definition in ICAO Annex 16 Volume 1, Chapter 9 Applicability: - “Installed auxiliary power unites (APU) and associated aircraft/systems during ground operations”

CodeNonStandardReasonType-LATERAL_DEVIAT.comment: For lateral deviation of the current flight position.

CodeNonStandardReasonType-LATE_ACTIVATIO.comment: For late activation of the downstream responsibility.

CodeNonStandardReasonType-LATE_REVISION.comment: For late revision of coordination compared to upstream responsibility state.

CodeNonStandardReasonType-NON_STANDARD_E.comment: For equipment non standard with the offline rule of the transition.

CodeNonStandardReasonType-NON_STANDARD_S.comment: For SSR code non standard with the offline rule of the transition.

CodeNonStandardReasonType-NON_STANDARD_X.comment: For XFL non standard with the offline rule of the transition.

CodeNorthReferenceType-GRID.comment: The direction of the north-south lines of the Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) grid imposed on topographic maps by the United States and NATO.

CodeNotePurposeType-DESCRIPTION.comment: A summary of the entity or property characteristics in a human readable form.

CodeNotePurposeType-DISCLAIMER.comment: A denial or disavowal of legal claim with regard to the entity or property information.

CodeNotePurposeType-REMARK.comment: Additional information about the entity or property, to be considered by a human operator.

CodeNotePurposeType-WARNING.comment: A notice that announces a hazard in relation with the entity or property characteristics.

CodeObscurationType-DUST.comment: Earth or other solid matter in a minute and fine state of subdivision, so that the particles are small and light enough to be easily raised and carried in a cloud by the wind; any substance comminuted or pulverized; powder.

CodeObscurationType-FOG.comment: A suspension of very small, usually microscopic water droplets in the air, reducing visibility at the Earth's surface.

CodeObscurationType-HAZE.comment: Suspension in the atmosphere of extremely small, dry particles which are invisible to the naked eye but numerous enough to give the sky an opalescent appearance.

CodeObscurationType-MIST.comment: Suspension in the air of microscopic water droplets or wet hygroscopic particles which reduce the visibility at the Earth's surface.

CodeObscurationType-SAND.comment: A material consisting of comminuted fragments and water-worn particles of rocks (mainly silicious) finer than those of which gravel is composed.

CodeObscurationType-SMOKE.comment: Suspension in the atmosphere of small particles produced by combustion.

CodeObscurationType-SPRAY.comment: Ensemble of water droplets torn by the wind from the surface of an extensive body of water, generally from the wave crests, and carried up a short distance into the air.

CodeObscurationType-UNIDENTIFIED.comment: That has not been identified; of which the identity has not been established.

CodeObscurationType-VOLCANIC_ASH.comment: Extremely fine particles of pulverized rock, the composition of which, generally speaking, is comprised predominantly of silica (> 50 per cent), together with smaller amounts of the oxides of aluminium, iron, calcium and sodium.

CodeObstacleAreaType-AREA1.comment: The entire territory of a State.

CodeObstacleAreaType-AREA2.comment: Within the vicinity of an aerodrome.

CodeObstacleAreaType-AREA3.comment: The area bordering an aerodrome movement area that extends horizontally from the edge of a runway to 90 m from the runway centre line and 50m from the edge of all other parts of the aerodrome movement area.

CodeObstacleAreaType-AREA4.comment: The area extending 900 m prior to the runway threshold and 60 m each side of the extended runway centre line in the direction of the approach on a precision approach runway, Category II or III.

CodeObstacleAreaType-FAR77.comment: FAA Regulations Part 77 Obstacle Limitation Surfaces.

CodeObstacleAreaType-MANAGED.comment: A 'virtual' area containing the VerticalStructures included in the data collection exercise, which do not qualify yet as Obstacles in any specific Area

CodeObstacleAreaType-OLS.comment: Obstacle Limitation Surface. A surface that defines the limits to which objects may project into the airspace.

CodeObstructionIdSurfaceZoneType-APPROAC.comment: An inclined plane or combination of planes preceding the threshold.

CodeObstructionIdSurfaceZoneType-BALKED_.comment: An inclined plane located at a specified distance after the threshold, extending between the inner transitional surface.

CodeObstructionIdSurfaceZoneType-CONICAL.comment: A surface sloping upwards and outwards from the periphery of the inner horizontal surface.

CodeObstructionIdSurfaceZoneType-INNER_A.comment: A rectangular portion of the approach surface immediately preceding the threshold.

CodeObstructionIdSurfaceZoneType-INNER_H.comment: A surface located in a horizontal plane above an aerodrome and its environs.

CodeObstructionIdSurfaceZoneType-INNER_T.comment: A surface similar to the transitional surface but closer to the runway.

CodeObstructionIdSurfaceZoneType-TAKE_OF.comment: An inclined plane or other specified surface beyond the end of a runway or clearway.

CodeObstructionIdSurfaceZoneType-TRANSIT.comment: A complex surface along the side of the strip and part of the side of the approach surface, that slopes upwards and outwards to the inner horizontal surface.

CodeOperationAerodromeType-AIRSHOW.comment: Air show and aircraft display activities.

CodeOperationAerodromeType-TOUCH_AND_GO.comment: Aircraft landing followed by an immediate take-off, without deceleration.

CodeOperationManoeuvringAreaType-AIRSHOW.comment: Air show and aircraft display activities.

CodeOperationManoeuvringAreaType-CROSSIN.comment: Crossing an element of the aerodrome manoeuvring area, as opposed to taxiing along that element.

CodeOperationManoeuvringAreaType-TAXIING.comment: Aircraft taxiing along an element of the aerodrome movement area.

CodeOperationManoeuvringAreaType-TOUCH_A.comment: Aircraft landing followed by an immediate take-off, without deceleration.

CodeOrganisationHierarchyType-MEMBER.comment: Child ORG is a member of the parent ORG.

CodeOrganisationHierarchyType-OWNED_BY.comment: Indicates that the current organisation is hierarchically positioned immediately below the parent organisation.

CodeOrganisationHierarchyType-SUPERVISED.comment: Indicates that the current organisation is under the supervision of the parent organisation.

CodeOrganisationType-AERONAUTICAL_METEOR.comment: A station designated to make observations and meteorological reports for use in international air navigation.

CodeOrganisationType-COMMON_MARK_REGISTE.comment: The authority maintaining the non-national register or, where appropriate, the part thereof, in which aircraft of an international operating agency are registered.

CodeOrganisationType-EUROPEAN_NETWORK_MA.comment: The Network Manager acts as catalyst and facilitator for an efficient overall network management by all ATM stakeholders. The Network Manager role will be enabling, facilitating and promoting the Network Operations Plan, providing a framework to allow Local/Sub-regional Network Manager and Airspace Users actors to share information (Network View), to coordinate (CDM) and to prepare scenarios to be used at network level when necessary.

CodeOrganisationType-GROUP_OF_AIR_CARRIE.comment: Two or more air carriers which together perform joint operations, franchise operations or code sharing for the purpose of operating a specific air service.

CodeOrganisationType-NATIONAL_REGISTERIN.comment: The authority maintaining the national register or, where appropriate, the part thereof, in which aircraft are registered.

CodeOxygenSupplyType-LHOX.comment: Low and high pressure oxygen servicing.

CodeOxygenSupplyType-OX.comment: Indicates oxygen servicing when type of servicing is unspecified.

CodePARType-FPN16.comment: Made by Raytheon. Range 15 miles. QKH1811 coaxial Magnetron. Similar to CPN-4 and MPN-11.

CodePARType-FPN62.comment: Made by Raytheon. Range 15 miles. QKH1811 coaxial Magnetron. Known as Normal PAR.. The version produced for Britain is called Falconner. Replaced CPN-4 and FPN-16.

CodePARType-GPN22.comment: Made by Raytheon. Derived from TPN-25. HIPAR = High Performance Precision Approach Radar. 20 mile range on 1 metre target. Can track 6 targets at once.

CodePARType-GPN25.comment: Made by Raytheon. Fixed base version of TPN-25. Part of TPN-19 Air Traffic Control System.

CodePARType-MPN14K.comment: Made by ITT Gillfilan. Mobile ATC radar for military use. Comprises two Radars, a PAR with 2 x 80Kw Transmitters in I/J Band, and an approach Surveillance Radar with dual 1Mw Transmitters in

CodePARType-TPN19.comment: Built by Raytheon. Described in some sources as launching control, having two Radars; Surveillance and PAR. TPN-24 and TPN-25.

CodePCNTyrePressureType-X.comment: Medium: Pressure limited to 1.5 MPa (217 psi).

CodePCNTyrePressureType-Y.comment: Low: Pressure limited to 1.00 MPa (145 psi).

CodePCNTyrePressureType-Z.comment: Very low: Pressure limited to 0.50 MPa (73 psi).

CodeParticularDayType-AFTER_HOLIDAY.comment: The day after a legal holiday.

CodeParticularDayType-AFTER_WORK_DAY.comment: The day after a working day.

CodeParticularDayType-BEFORE_HOLIDAY.comment: The day preceding a legal holiday.

CodeParticularDayType-BEFORE_WORK_DAY.comment: The day preceding a working day.

CodeParticularDayType-HOLIDAY.comment: Legal Holiday. The value does not include the weekly non-working days (for example, Saturday and Sunday in most European States).

CodeParticularDayType-WORK_DAY.comment: Working Day. This value indicates any day which is neither a Legal Holiday nor a weekly non-working day.

CodeParticularMatterType-P01.comment: Particles with a diameter less than 0.1 microns.

CodeParticularMatterType-PM10.comment: Particles with a diameter less than 10 microns.

CodeParticularMatterType-PM25.comment: Particles with a diameter of less than 2.5 microns.

CodePointUsageType-ABEAM_ELEVATION_POINT.comment: The point perpendicular to the Elevation Antenna on the Runway Centreline.

CodePointUsageType-ABEAM_GLIDESLOPE_POIN.comment: The point perpendicular to the Glideslope Antenna on the Runway Centreline.

CodePointUsageType-ABEAM_PAR_POINT.comment: The point perpendicular to the Precision Approach Radar (PAR) Antenna on the Runway Centreline.

CodePointUsageType-ABEAM_RER_POINT.comment: The point perpendicular to the Runway End Reflector (RER) on the Runway Centreline.

CodePointUsageType-ABEAM_TDR_POINT.comment: The point perpendicular to the Touchdown Reflector (TDR) on the Runway Centreline.

CodePointUsageType-AERIAL_REFUELLING_ANC.comment: Aerial Refuelling Anchor Pattern point (Anchors Only).

CodePointUsageType-AERODROME_REFERENCE_P.comment: The designated geographical location of an aerodrome.

CodePointUsageType-AIMING_POINT.comment: Aiming point for a TouchDownLiftOff zone.

CodePointUsageType-DISPLACED_THRESHOLD.comment: A threshold not located at the extremity of a runway.

CodePointUsageType-END_OF_RUNWAY_DIRECTI.comment: Physical end of a runway direction

CodePointUsageType-ENROUTE_SEGMENT_POINT.comment: A point associated with a defined En-route segment.

CodePointUsageType-FICTITIOUS_THRESHOLD_.comment: The FTP is a point over which the final approach segment path passes at a relative height specified by the reference datum height. It is defined by the WGS-84 latitude, longitude and ellipsoid height. The FTP replaces the LTP when the final approach course is not aligned with the runway extended centreline or when the threshold is displaced from the actual runway threshold. For non-aligned approaches the FTP lies on the intersection of the perpendicular from the FAS to the runway threshold. The FTP elevation is the same as the actual runway threshold elevation.

CodePointUsageType-FINAL_APPROACH_COURSE.comment: A waypoint located at the beginning of the Final Approach.

CodePointUsageType-FINAL_APPROACH_FIX.comment: That fix or point of an instrument approach procedure where the final approach segment commences.

CodePointUsageType-FINAL_ROLL_OUT_POINT.comment: Where a course change is required within the Final Approach Segment (FAS), the point that the aircraft rolls to a wings-level attitude aligned with the runway centreline extended is considered the FROP.FROP is used in an RNP-SAAAR procedure when a turn is required in the final between the FAF and the threshold.

CodePointUsageType-FLIGHT_PATH_ALIGNMENT.comment: A point in the same lateral plane as the LTP or FTP that is used to define the alignment of the final approach segment. For approaches aligned with the runway centreline, the FPAP is located at or beyond the opposite threshold of the runway. The delta length offset from the opposite threshold of the runway defines its location.

CodePointUsageType-FLY_BY_WAYPOINT.comment: A waypoint which requires turn anticipation to allow tangential interception of the next segment of a route or procedure.

CodePointUsageType-FLY_OVER_WAYPOINT.comment: A waypoint at which a turn is initiated in order to join the next segment of a route or procedure.

CodePointUsageType-FREE_FLIGHT_CATCH_POI.comment: A point indicating the end of free flight.

CodePointUsageType-FREE_FLIGHT_PITCH_POI.comment: A point indicating the start of free flight.

CodePointUsageType-HOLDING_FIX.comment: A geographical location that serves as a reference for a holding procedure.

CodePointUsageType-INERTIAL_NAVIGATION_S.comment: A point established to test the Inertial Navigation System in the aircraft.

CodePointUsageType-INITIAL_APPROACH_FIX.comment: A fix that marks the beginning of the initial segment and the end of the arrival segment, if applicable.

CodePointUsageType-INTERMEDIATE_FIX.comment: A fix that marks the end of an initial segment and the beginning of the intermediate segment.

CodePointUsageType-LAND_AND_HOLD_SHORT_O.comment: Point indicating Land And Hold Short Operation location

CodePointUsageType-MILITARY_ROUTE_ALTERN.comment: Alternate Entry Point of a military route.
Alternate Exit Point of a military route.

CodePointUsageType-MILITARY_ROUTE_ENTRY_.comment: Starting Point of a military route.

CodePointUsageType-MILITARY_ROUTE_EXIT_P.comment: Ending Point of a military route.

CodePointUsageType-MILITARY_ROUTE_TURNIN.comment: Turning Point of a military route.

CodePointUsageType-MISSED_APPROACH_HOLDI.comment: A fix used in RNAV applications that marks the end of the missed approach segment and the centre point for the missed approach holding.

CodePointUsageType-MISSED_APPROACH_POINT.comment: That point in an instrument approach procedure at or before which the prescribed missed approach procedure must be initiated in order to ensure that the minimum obstacle clearance is not infringed.

CodePointUsageType-REPORTING_POINT.comment: A specified (named) geographical location in relation to which the position of an aircraft can be reported.

CodePointUsageType-RUNWAY_CENTRELINE_POI.comment: An operationally significant position on the centre line of a runway direction.

CodePointUsageType-RUNWAY_MID_POINT.comment: The mid point of the runway

CodePointUsageType-SEGMENT_POINT.comment: A point associated with a defined segment.

CodePointUsageType-START_OF_RUNWAY_DIREC.comment: Physical start of a runway direction.

CodePointUsageType-STEP_DOWN_FIX.comment: A fix that is located on the final approach segment between the final approach fix and the missed approach point.

CodePointUsageType-TERMINAL_SEGMENT_POIN.comment: A point associated with a defined segment leg.

CodePointUsageType-THRESHOLD.comment: The beginning of that portion of the runway usable for landing.

CodePointUsageType-TOUCHDOWN_ZONE.comment: The portion of a runway, beyond the threshold, where it is intended landing aeroplanes first contact the runway.

CodePointUsageType-TOUCH_DOWN_LIFT_OFF_C.comment: The point at the centre of the TLOF.

CodePointUsageType-TRANSFER_OF_CONTROL_P.comment: A defined point located along the flight path of an aircraft, at which the responsibility for providing air traffic control service to the aircraft is transferred from one control unit or control position to the next.

CodePointUsageType-VISUAL_DESCENT_POINT.comment: A defined point on the final approach course of a non precision straight-in approach procedure from which normal descent from the MDA to the runway touchdown point may be commenced, provided visual reference required by 14 CFR Section 91.175(c)(3) is established.

CodePointUsageType-VOR_CHECK_POINT.comment: A point established in support of VOR tests for determining the accuracy of a VOR receiver on the ground or airborne.

CodePointUsageType-WAYPOINT.comment: A specified geographical location used to define an area navigation route or the flight path of an aircraft employing area navigation.

CodePositionMarkingType-APRON_EXIT_POINT.comment: Apron exit point, apron entrance point

CodePositionMarkingType-POSITION_MARKING.comment: Generic position marking, low visibility hold point, geographic hold position marking, checkpoint

CodePositionMarkingType-TAXI_HOLD_POINT.comment: Holding position, taxi hold spot, hold spot, hold circle, aircraft hold point

CodePrecipitationType-DRIZZLE.comment: Fairly uniform precipitation in very fine drops of water (diameter less than 0.5 mm) very close to one another, falling from a cloud.

CodePrecipitationType-HAIL.comment: Precipitation of either transparent, or partly or completely opaque particles of ice (hailstones), usually spheroidal, conical or irregular in form and of diameter very generally between 5 and 50 millimetres, which falls from a cloud either separately or agglomerated into irregular lumps.

CodePrecipitationType-ICE_CRYSTALS.comment: Any one of a number of macroscopic crystalline forms of ice including hexagonal columns and platelets, dendritic crystals, ice needles and their combinations.

CodePrecipitationType-ICE_PELLETS.comment: Precipitation of transparent particles of ice which are spherical or irregular, rarely conical, and which have a diameter of 5 mm or less.

CodePrecipitationType-RAIN.comment: Precipitation of liquid water particles, either in the form of drops of more than 0.5 mm in diameter, or of smaller widely scattered drops.

CodePrecipitationType-SMALL_HAIL.comment: Precipitation of translucent ice particles, which falls from a cloud. These particles are almost always spherical and sometimes have conical tips. Their diameter may attain or even exceed five millimetres.

CodePrecipitationType-SNOW.comment: Precipitation of ice crystals, isolated or agglomerated, falling from a cloud.

CodePrecipitationType-SNOW_GRAINS.comment: Precipitation of very small opaque white particles of ice which fall from a cloud and which are fairly flat or elongated with diameters generally less than 1 mm.

CodeProcedureAvailabilityType-UNUSABLE.comment: Temporarily suspended because, for example, a temporary obstacle makes the procedure unsafe

CodeProcedureAvailabilityType-USABLE.comment: The procedure may be flown according to its timetable. Is active and can be used.

CodeRNPCapabilityType-BASIC_RNP_1_ALL_PE.comment: Basic RNP 1 all permitted sensors capability.

CodeRNPCapabilityType-BASIC_RNP_1_DME_DM.comment: Basic RNP 1 DME DME IRU capability.

CodeRNPCapabilityType-RNP_APCH_WITH_BARO.comment: RNP APCH with BARO VNAV capability.

CodeRNPCapabilityType-RNP_AR_APCH_WITHOU.comment: RNP AR APCH without RF capability.

CodeRNPCapabilityType-RNP_AR_APCH_WITH_R.comment: RNP AR APCH with RF capability.

CodeRadarServiceType-ARSR.comment: A system of remotely located, long-range radars that primarily provides a display of aircraft locations over large areas to air route traffic control centres.

CodeRadarServiceType-ASR.comment: A surveillance radar designed to provide relatively short-range coverage in the general vicinity of an airport and to serve as an expeditious means of handling terminal traffic through observation of precise aircraft locations on a radarscope.

CodeRadarServiceType-PAR.comment: Primary radar equipment used to determine the position of an aircraft during final approach, in terms of lateral and vertical deviations relative to a nominal approach path, and in range relative to touchdown.

CodeRadarServiceType-PSR.comment: A surveillance radar system which uses reflected radio signals.

CodeRadarServiceType-SSR.comment: A surveillance radar system which uses transmitters/receivers (interrogators) and transponders.

CodeRadioEmissionType-A8W.comment: AM (unkeyed) plus ON/OFF keying of ident tone.

CodeRadioEmissionType-A9W.comment: Composite AM/FM (unkeyed) plus ON/OFF keying of ident tone.

CodeRadioEmissionType-J3E.comment: AM double side-band suppressed carrier telephony.

CodeRadioEmissionType-NONA1A.comment: Unmod trans. morse ident. carrier emission interrupted.

CodeRadioEmissionType-NONA2A.comment: Unmod. trans. morse ident. carrier emission continuous.

CodeRadioFrequencyAreaType-COV.comment: Actual coverage range (flight checked). Equivalent to Operational Service Volume.

CodeRadioFrequencyAreaType-RES.comment: Restricted (use is restricted to defined sectors).

CodeRadioFrequencyAreaType-T_COV.comment: Theoretical coverage range (not flight checked). Equivalent to Standard Service Volume.

CodeRadioFrequencyAreaType-UUS.comment: Un-usability (use is not permitted in the defined sectors).

CodeRadioSignalType-AZIMUTH.comment: The signal supports the provision/calculation of horizontal angle information.

CodeRadioSignalType-BEAM.comment: The signal provides a directional guidance, in the horizontal or vertical planes.

CodeRadioSignalType-DATALINK.comment: The signal provides a carrier for data.

CodeRadioSignalType-DISTANCE.comment: The signal supports the provision/calculation of linear separation information.

CodeRadioSignalType-VOICE.comment: The signal provides a carrier for voice information.

CodeReasonCancellationType-AIRSPACE_SIZE.comment: Insufficient airspace available (Non suitable airspace available)

CodeReasonCancellationType-EARLY_FINISH.comment: The mission ends earlier than originally planned. It can only happen when the area is active.

CodeReasonCancellationType-NO_SERVICE.comment: A service (ATC, air defence, aircraft maintenance, infrastructure, etc.) essential for the mission is unavailable.

CodeReasonCancellationType-TECHNICAL.comment: Technical problem of aircraft, ATC, etc.

CodeReasonCancellationType-TIME_LENGTH.comment: Insufficient time available (Insufficient time allocated in available exercise airspace)

CodeReasonForAbortingTakeOffType-ABORTED.comment: Take-off aborted, aircraft will return to apron.
Take-off aborted, aircraft will return to terminal.

CodeReasonForDepartureSuspensionType-AIR.comment: Aircraft encounters a severe technical problem.

CodeReasonForDepartureSuspensionType-UNK.comment: The reason for which aircraft cannot depart is unknown or has not been provided.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-ALTRV.comment: A flight operated in accordance with an altitude reservation.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-ATFMX.comment: A flight approved for exemption from ATFM measures by the appropriate ATS authority.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-CPDLCX.comment: Flight conducted wholly or partly in EUR CPDLC airspace and not equipped with CPDLC capabilities but which has been granted an exemption.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-EMERGEN.comment: The aircraft has declared an emergency situation.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-EXM833.comment: Flight exempted from the carriage of the 8.33kHz radios.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-FLTCK.comment: Flight check for calibration of navaids.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-HEAD.comment: Flight with Head of State status.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-HOSP.comment: Medical flight declared by medical authorities.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-HUM.comment: Flight operating on a humanitarian mission.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-MARSA.comment: A flight for which a military entity assumes responsibility for separation of military aircraft.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-MEDEVAC.comment: A flight for a life critical medical emergency evacuation.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-NON_RVS.comment: A non-RVSM capable flight intending to operate in RVSM airspace.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-RESTRIC.comment: Flight for which the details should only be available to a restricted audience, e.g. a security-sensitive flight.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-RNAVINO.comment: Failure or degradation results in aircraft being unable to meet B-RNAV functionality and accuracy requirements.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-SAR.comment: Flight engaged in a search and rescue mission.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-STATE.comment: Flight engaged in military, customs or police services.

CodeReasonForSpecialHandlingType-STATE_O.comment: Flight carrying State officials other than a Head of State.

CodeReferenceLocationType-AERODROME.comment: A defined area on land or water (including any buildings, installations and equipment) intended to be used either wholly or in part for the arrival, departure and surface movement of aircraft.

CodeReferenceLocationType-AIRSPACE.comment: A defined three dimensional region of space relevant to air traffic.

CodeReferenceLocationType-SET_OF_AERODRO.comment: Set of aerodromes used in the scope of Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management (ATFCM).

CodeReferenceLocationType-SIGNIFICANT_PO.comment: A specified geographical location used in defining an ATS route or the flight path of an aircraft and for other navigation and ATS purposes.

CodeReferenceRoleType-ALONG_TRACK_DISTAN.comment: The distance along the guidance course to/from another significant point.

CodeReferenceRoleType-ANGLE_OR_DISTANCE_.comment: The intersection of two angle indications or two distance indications (DME/DME fix).

CodeReferenceRoleType-RAD_DME.comment: Defined by a bearing (angle indication) and a distance (distance Indication) from a navaid.

CodeReferenceRoleType-RECOMMENDED_NAVAID.comment: The recommended navaid providing information for the segment.

CodeReflectorType-RUNWAY_END.comment: Reflector placed off the end of the runway

CodeRegulationCauseType-ACCIDENT_INCIDEN.comment: The regulation corresponding to Accident/Incident. eg. RWY23 closed due accident.

CodeRegulationCauseType-AERODROME_CAPACI.comment: The regulation corresponding to Aerodrome Capacity; eg.Taxiway closure.

CodeRegulationCauseType-AIRSPACE_MANAGEM.comment: The regulation corresponding to Military Activity.

CodeRegulationCauseType-ATC_CAPACITY.comment: The regulation code corresponding to ATC Capacity. eg. Demand exceeds capacity.

CodeRegulationCauseType-ATC_EQUIPMENT.comment: The regulation corresponding to ATC Equipment; eg. Radar failure.

CodeRegulationCauseType-ATC_INDUSTRIAL_A.comment: The regulation code corresponding to ATC Ind Action. Eg. Controllers strike.

CodeRegulationCauseType-ATC_ROUTINGS.comment: The regulation corresponding to ATC Routings. eg. Phasing in of new procedures.

CodeRegulationCauseType-ATC_STAFFING.comment: The regulation corresponding to ATC Staffing. eg. Illness.

CodeRegulationCauseType-ENVIRONMENTAL_IS.comment: The regulation corresponding to Environmental Issues. eg. Noise.

CodeRegulationCauseType-EQUIPMENT_NON_AT.comment: The regulation corresponding to Equipment non-ATC. eg. Runway lighting failure.

CodeRegulationCauseType-NON_ATC_INDUSTRI.comment: The regulation corresponding to Ind Action non-ATC. eg. Fireman's strike.

CodeRegulationCauseType-SPECIAL_EVENT.comment: The regulation corresponding to Special Event. eg. European football cup.

CodeRelativePositionType-AFTER.comment: A location following the reference location.

CodeRelativePositionType-AT.comment: A location at the reference location.

CodeRelativePositionType-BEFORE.comment: A location in advance of the reference location.

CodeRelativePositionType-BOTH.comment: A location distributed on both sides of the reference location.

CodeRelativePositionType-LEFT.comment: A location on the left side of the reference location.

CodeRelativePositionType-RIGHT.comment: A location on the right side of the reference location.

CodeReleaseIndicationType-RELEASED_FOR_A.comment: The flight is released for all actions.

CodeReleaseIndicationType-RELEASED_FOR_C.comment: The flight is released for climb.

CodeReleaseIndicationType-RELEASED_FOR_D.comment: The flight is released for descent.

CodeReleaseIndicationType-RELEASED_FOR_T.comment: The flight is released for turns.

CodeResponsibilityKindType-AERODROME.comment: When the possibility exists in the ATSU to allocate to a role the responsibility of controlling flights to/from a specific aerodrome.

CodeResponsibilityKindType-RUNWAY.comment: When the possibility exists in the ATSU to allocate to a role the responsibility of controlling flights using a specific runway.

CodeResponsibilityKindType-SECTOR.comment: When the possibility exists in the ATSU to allocate to a role the responsibility of controlling flights crossing sector(s).

CodeResponsibilityKindType-SET_OF_FLIGHT.comment: When the possibility exists in the ATSU to allocate to a role the responsibility of controlling flights identified by a specific criterion (e.g. flights arriving via the same STAR).

CodeResponsibilityKindType-SET_OF_RUNWAY.comment: When the possibility exists in the ATSU to allocate to a role the responsibility of controlling flights using a set of runways.

CodeResponsibilityKindType-SET_OF_STANDS.comment: When the possibility exists in the ATSU to allocate to a role the responsibility of controlling flights to/from a set of stands.

CodeRoleKindType-MILITARY_COORDINATOR.comment: The role of a military coordinator

CodeRoleKindType-MSP_CONTROLLER.comment: The role of a Multi Sector Planner Air Traffic Controller.

CodeRoleKindType-PLANNER_ATCO.comment: The role of a planner Air Traffic Controller

CodeRoleKindType-SUPERVISOR.comment: The role of an Operational supervisor.

CodeRoleKindType-TACTICAL_ATCO.comment: The role of a tactical Air Traffic Controller

CodeRoleKindType-TACTICAL_FLOW_MANAGER.comment: The role of a tactical flow manager.

CodeRouteAvailabilityType-OPEN.comment: The route segment may be flown according to its timetable.

CodeRouteDesignatorPrefixType-K.comment: A low-level route established for use primarily by helicopters.

CodeRouteDesignatorPrefixType-S.comment: A route established exclusively for use by supersonic aircraft during acceleration, deceleration and while in supersonic flight.

CodeRouteDesignatorPrefixType-U.comment: Indicate that the route or portion thereof is established in the upper airspace.

CodeRouteDesignatorSuffixType-F.comment: Indicates that on the route or portion thereof advisory service only is provided.

CodeRouteDesignatorSuffixType-G.comment: Indicates that on the route or portion thereof flight information service only is provided.

CodeRouteNavigationType-RNAV.comment: An ATS route established for the use of aircraft capable of employing area navigation.

CodeRouteOriginType-BOTH.comment: The route is both international and domestic.

CodeRouteType-ATS_ROUTE.comment: A specified route designed for channelling the flow of traffic as necessary for the provision of air traffic services.

CodeRouteType-NAT.comment: A route between Europe and North America whose exact location changes daily according to weather and traffic demands.

CodeRouteType-OCEANIC_TRACK.comment: A route that is part of an Organised Track System established for an oceanic area.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-ABBREVIATIONS.comment: A list of alphabetically arranged abbreviations used by the State in its AIP.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-ADDRESSING_FL.comment: Addresses allocated to flight plans, showing: category of flight (IFR, VFR or both), route and message address.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-AERODROME_BIR.comment: Indication of bird concentrations at the aerodrome.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-AERODROME_FLI.comment: The conditions and flight procedures, including radar and low visibility procedures at the aerodrome and associated equipment authorized for use under these conditions.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-AERODROME_HEL.comment: The general conditions of the State's designated authority responsible for aerodromes and heliports availability.
Type of charges which may be applicable at aerodromes/heliports.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-AIRCRAFT_INST.comment: Aircraft instruments, equipment and flight documents to be carried on aircraft.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-AIR_NAVIGATIO.comment: Charges which may be applicable to air navigation services provided for international use, approach control, route air navigation services.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-AIR_TRAFFIC_F.comment: ATFM structure types of flow messages and procedures applicable for departing flights, flight plan requirements and slot allocations.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-AIR_TRAFFIC_I.comment: Definition of air traffic incidents, use of the "Air Traffic Incident Reporting Form", reporting procedures and purpose of reporting and handling of the form.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-ALTIMETER_SET.comment: Altimeter setting procedures in use, containing procedures applicable to operators and cruising levels.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-ATS_AIRSPACE_.comment: Description of ATS airspace classes as applied within the State.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-ATS_SURVEILLA.comment: Primary radar services and procedures, secondary surveillance radar (SSR) operating procedures and automatic dependent surveillance - broadcast (ADS-B) coverage.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-CUSTOMS_REQUI.comment: Customs formalities for passengers and crew.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-DIFFERENCES_I.comment: Significant differences between national regulations and practices of the State and related ICAO provisions.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-ENTRY_TRANSIT.comment: Regulations concerning entry, transit and departure of cargo.
Rules and procedures governing the entry, transit and departure of non-scheduled flights.
Rules and procedures governing the entry, transit and departure of aircraft.
Rules and procedures governing the entry, transit and departure of private flights.
Rules and procedures governing the entry, transit and departure of scheduled flights.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-FLIGHT_PLANNI.comment: Procedures for the submission of a flight plan; repetitive flight plan system; and changes to the submitted flight plan.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-FLIGHT_RULES_.comment: General flight rules as applied within the State.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-HOLDING_APPRO.comment: The criteria on which holding, approach and departure procedures are established for arriving flights and departing flights from any aerodrome/heliport.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-IMMIGRATION_R.comment: Immigration formalities for passengers and crew.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-INSTRUMENT_FL.comment: Instrument flight rules as applied within the State.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-INTERCEPTION_.comment: Interception procedures and visual signals to be used.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-INTERNATIONAL.comment: International agreements in which the State is part and which affect air navigation.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-LOCAL_TRAFFIC.comment: Standard routes for taxiing aircraft, parking regulations, school and training flights and similar but excluding flight procedures.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-MEASURING_SYS.comment: A table of units of measurement, calendar, time systems, geodetic reference system, EGM-96 and public holidays.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-NOISE_ABATEME.comment: Detailed description of noise abatement procedures established at the aerodrome.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-PUBLIC_HEALTH.comment: Public health measures applied to arriving, departing or transit aircraft.
Public health measures applied to disembarking or departing passengers and crew.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-REGIONAL_SUPP.comment: Regional supplementary procedures (SUPPS) affecting the entire area of State responsibility.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-UNLAWFUL_INTE.comment: Procedures to be applied in case of unlawful interference.

CodeRuleProcedureTitleType-VISUAL_FLIGHT.comment: Visual flight rules as applied within the State.

CodeRuleProcedureType-ICAO_DIFF.comment: A difference between the national rules/procedures and the ICAO Standards, Recommended Practices and Procedures.

CodeRuleProcedureType-LAW.comment: A binding rule, enforced by the national/international legislation.

CodeRuleProcedureType-PRACTICE.comment: The usual way of doing something, even if it is not formally prescribed

CodeRuleProcedureType-PROCEDURE.comment: A particular way of accomplishing something or of acting

CodeRuleProcedureType-RULE.comment: A prescribed guide for conduct or action.

CodeRunwayDirectionOperationModeType-ARR.comment: The runway direction is operational for arrivals only.

CodeRunwayDirectionOperationModeType-DEP.comment: The runway direction is operational for departures only.

CodeRunwayDirectionOperationModeType-MIX.comment: The runway direction is operational for both arrivals and departures.

CodeRunwayElementType-DISPLACED.comment: The element between the start of the runway and the position of the displaced threshold.

CodeRunwayElementType-INTERSECTION.comment: Intersection element - with a runway or with a taxiway.

CodeRunwayElementType-RUNWAY_SHOULDER.comment: An area adjacent to the edge of a runway so prepared as to provide a transition between the runway and the adjacent surface.

CodeRunwayElementType-RUNWAY_TURN_PAD.comment: A defined area on a land aerodrome adjacent to a runway for the purpose of completing a 180-degree turn on a runway.

CodeRunwayMarkingType-BASIC.comment: Basic (or Visual) runway marking elements include markings for Runway Designation, Centreline, Threshold (On runways sued or intended to be used by international commercial transports) and Aiming Point (On runways 4000 ft (1200M) or longer used by jet aircraft).

CodeRunwayMarkingType-HELIPORT.comment: Heliport specific marking elements are present.

CodeRunwayMarkingType-NON_PRECISION.comment: Markings appropriate for non-precision approach runway. Non-Precision Instrument runway marking elements include markings for Runway designation, Centreline, threshold and Aiming Point.

CodeRunwayMarkingType-NON_STANDARD.comment: Runway marking elements such as Runway Designation, Centreline, Threshold and Aiming Point may be present, but they are Not standard markings.

CodeRunwayMarkingType-PRECISION.comment: Markings appropriate for precision approach runway. Precision Instrument runway marking elements include markings for Runway Designation, Centreline, Threshold, Aiming Point, Touchdown Zone and Side Stripes.

CodeRunwayMarkingType-RUNWAY_NUMBERS.comment: The only runway marking element present is the Runway Designation.

CodeRunwayProtectionAreaType-ILS.comment: ILS protection area. Protects ILS signal distortion by forbidding large objects in the area.

CodeRunwayProtectionAreaType-IOFZ.comment: Inner Obstacle free zone or surface

CodeRunwayProtectionAreaType-STOPWAY.comment: A defined rectangular area on the ground at the end of take-off run available prepared as a suitable area in which an aircraft can be stopped in the case of an abandoned take-off.

CodeRunwayProtectionAreaType-VGSI.comment: Visual Glide Slope Indicator (VGSI) protection area. Protects VGSI signal coverage by forbidding objects in the area.

CodeRunwaySectionType-1_THIRD.comment: The first third of the runway, starting from the threshold with the lower designation number.

CodeRunwaySectionType-2_THIRD.comment: The second third of the runway, starting from the threshold with the lower designation number.

CodeRunwaySectionType-3_THIRD.comment: The last third of the runway, starting from the threshold with the lower designation number.

CodeRunwayType-FATO.comment: A defined area over which the final phase of the approach manoeuvre to hover or landing is completed and from which the take-off manoeuvre is commenced. Where the FATO is to be used by helicopters operating in performance Class 1, the defined area includes the rejected take-off area available.

CodeSSRCategoryType-CONSPICUITY_SSR_CODE.comment: Reserved for use as a conspicuity code for Mode S.

CodeSSRCodeStatusType-ASSIGNED.comment: The SSR Code assigned to a flight.

CodeSSRCodeStatusType-NEXT.comment: The SSR Code used by the receiving system.

CodeSSRModeType-MODE_1.comment: Mode 1 is used for military surveillance purpose.

CodeSSRModeType-MODE_2.comment: Mode 2 is used for military surveillance purpose.

CodeSSRModeType-MODE_3A.comment: Mode 3A is used for both military and civil surveillance purposes.

CodeSSRModeType-MODE_A_C.comment: Mode A surveillance with supplementary information concerning the flight level.

CodeSafeAltitudeType-MSA.comment: The lowest altitude which may be used which will provide a minimum clearance of 300 m (1 000 ft) above all objects located in an area contained within a sector of a circle of 46 km (25 NM) radius centred on a radio aid to navigation.

CodeSafetyMitigationAdviceType-AIRCRAFT_.comment: Aircraft being turned on intended final approach centre line.

CodeSafetyMitigationAdviceType-FOLLOWER_.comment: Follower aircraft not being turned on intended final approach centre line.

CodeSafetyMitigationAdviceType-LEAD_AIRC.comment: Lead aircraft not being turned on intended final approach centre line.

CodeSafetyMitigationAdviceType-WRONG_AIR.comment: Wrong aircraft turned on the final approach centre line.

CodeSegmentPathType-AF.comment: Arc to a Fix or AF Leg. Defines a track over ground at specified constant distance from a database DME Navaid.

CodeSegmentPathType-CA.comment: Course to an Altitude or CA Leg. Defines a specified course to a specific altitude at an unspecified position.

CodeSegmentPathType-CD.comment: Course to a DME Distance or CD Leg. Defines a specified course to a specific DME Distance which is from a specific database DME Navaid.

CodeSegmentPathType-CF.comment: Course to a Fix or CF Leg. Defines a specified course to a specific database fix.

CodeSegmentPathType-CI.comment: Course to an Intercept or CI Leg. Defines a specified course to intercept a subsequent leg.

CodeSegmentPathType-CR.comment: Course to a Radial termination or CR Leg. Defines a course to a specified Radial from a specific database VOR Navaid.

CodeSegmentPathType-DF.comment: Direct to a Fix or DF Leg. Defines an unspecified track starting from an undefined position to a specific database fix.

CodeSegmentPathType-FA.comment: Fix to an Altitude or FA Leg. Defines a specified track over ground from a database fix to a specified altitude at an unspecified position.

CodeSegmentPathType-FC.comment: Track from a Fix from a Distance or FC Leg. Defines a specified track over ground from a database fix for a specific distance.

CodeSegmentPathType-FD.comment: Track from a Fix to a DME Distance or FD Leg. Defines a specified track over ground from a database fix to a specific DME Distance which is from a specific database DME Navaid.

CodeSegmentPathType-FM.comment: From a Fix to a Manual termination or FM Leg. Defines a specified track over ground from a database fix until Manual termination of the leg.

CodeSegmentPathType-FT.comment: Course from a fix during a specified time. (non ARINC)

CodeSegmentPathType-HA.comment: A holding pattern in lieu of procedure turn course reversal or a terminal procedure referenced mandatory holding pattern at a specified database fix, with an altitude termination.

CodeSegmentPathType-HF.comment: A holding pattern in lieu of procedure turn course reversal or a terminal procedure referenced mandatory holding pattern at a specified database fix, as a single circuit terminating at the fix.

CodeSegmentPathType-HM.comment: A holding pattern in lieu of procedure turn course reversal or a terminal procedure referenced mandatory holding pattern at a specified database fix, with manual termination.

CodeSegmentPathType-IF.comment: Initial Fix or IF Leg. Defines a database fix as a point in space.

CodeSegmentPathType-PI.comment: 045/180 Procedure Turn or PI Leg. Defines a course reversal starting at a specific database fix, includes Outbound Leg followed by a left or right turn and 180 degree course reversal to intercept the next leg.

CodeSegmentPathType-PT.comment: Timed outbound leg to a procedure turn. (non ARINC)

CodeSegmentPathType-RF.comment: Constant Radius Arc or RF Leg. Defines a constant radius turn between two database fixes, lines tangent to the arc and a center fix.

CodeSegmentPathType-TF.comment: Track to a Fix or TF Leg. Defines a great circle track over ground between two known databases fixes.

CodeSegmentPathType-VA.comment: Heading to an Altitude termination or VA Leg. Defines a specified heading to a specific Altitude termination at an unspecified position.

CodeSegmentPathType-VD.comment: Heading to a DME Distance termination or VD Leg. Defines a specified heading terminating at a specified DME Distance from a specific database DME Navaid.

CodeSegmentPathType-VI.comment: Heading to an Intercept or VI Leg. Defines a specified heading to intercept the subsequent leg at an unspecified position.

CodeSegmentPathType-VM.comment: Heading to a Manual termination or VM Leg. Defines a specified heading until a Manual termination.

CodeSegmentPathType-VR.comment: Heading to a Radial termination or VR Leg. Defines a specified heading to a specified radial from a specific database VOR Navaid.

CodeSegmentTerminationType-ALTITUDE.comment: Leg is terminated when reaching the altitude conditions specified in the segment leg.

CodeSegmentTerminationType-DISTANCE.comment: Leg is terminated when the distance has passed.

CodeSegmentTerminationType-DURATION.comment: Leg is terminated when the duration has passed.

CodeSegmentTerminationType-INTERCEPT.comment: Leg is terminated when reaching the limited angle indication or reaching the limiting distance indication associated with the leg.

CodeSeparationAdviceType-CHECK_FOR_CORRE.comment: Check for correctness of airspeed profile.

CodeSeparationAdviceType-SET_ADDITIONAL_.comment: Set additional spacing for arrival pair.

CodeServiceATFMType-ATFM.comment: A service established with the objective of contributing to a safe, orderly and expeditious flow of air traffic by ensuring that ATC capacity is utilized to the maximum extent possible and that the traffic volume is compatible with the capacities declared by the appropriate ATS authority.

CodeServiceATFMType-CLEARANCE.comment: A service providing permissions (entry, landing, overflying, exit, etc.) for a given location.

CodeServiceATFMType-FPL.comment: A service that provides flight planning acceptance and distribution to the ATC Unites concerned.

CodeServiceATFMType-FPLV.comment: A service that provides flight planning validation.

CodeServiceInformationType-AFIS.comment: Aerodrome flight information service, as defined in the ICAO Annex 11.

CodeServiceInformationType-AIS.comment: A service established within the defined area of coverage responsible for the provision of aeronautical information/data necessary for the safety, regularity and efficiency of air navigation.

CodeServiceInformationType-ATIS.comment: The automatic provision of current, routine information to arriving and departing aircraft throughout 24 hours or a specified portion thereof.: Data link-automatic terminal information service (D-ATIS). The provision of ATIS via data link. Voice-automatic terminal information service (Voice-ATIS). The provision of ATIS by means of continuous and repetitive voice broadcasts.

CodeServiceInformationType-FIS.comment: A service provided for the purpose of giving advice and information useful for the safe and efficient conduct of flights.

CodeServiceInformationType-INFO.comment: Limited ad-hoc information provision, about a specific activity at a particular location.

CodeServiceInformationType-NOTAM.comment: Provision of NOTAM service, as defined by ICAO Annex 15.

CodeServiceInformationType-OFIS_HF.comment: HF operational flight information service (OFIS) broadcasts, as defined by the ICAO Annex 11.

CodeServiceInformationType-OFIS_VHF.comment: VHF operational flight information service (OFIS) broadcasts, as defined by the ICAO Annex 11.

CodeServiceInformationType-SIGMET.comment: Information issued by a meteorological watch office concerning the occurrence or expected occurrence of specified en-route weather phenomena which may affect the safety of aircraft operations.

CodeServiceInformationType-VOLMET.comment: The automatic provision of VOLMET information to aircraft in flight.

CodeServiceSARType-ALRS.comment: A service provided to notify appropriate organizations regarding aircraft in need of search and rescue aid, and assist such organizations as required.

CodeServiceSARType-SAR.comment: The performance of distress monitoring, communication, coordination and search and rescue functions, initial medical assistance or medical evacuation, through the use of public and private resources, including cooperating aircraft, vessels and other craft and installations.

CodeSignificantPointDesignatorType-BRG_D.comment: Point with a five-alphanumeric name-code, composed according to the rules provided by the ARINC 424 Specification for unnamed bearing/distance reference waypoints.

CodeSignificantPointDesignatorType-CNF.comment: Computer Navigation Fix - A point used for the purpose of defining the navigation track for an airborne computer system (i.e., GPS or FMS). CNFs include unnamed DME fixes, beginning and ending points of DME arcs and sensor final approach fixes (FAFs) on some GPS overlay approaches.

CodeSignificantPointDesignatorType-COORD.comment: Point with identifier derived from its geographical coordinates.

CodeSignificantPointDesignatorType-DESIG.comment: A point with bearing/distance designator used as control point for procedure design, which is not published.

CodeSignificantWeatherQualifierType-BLOW.comment: Raised by the wind to a moderate height above the ground (2 meters or more).

CodeSignificantWeatherQualifierType-FREE.comment: Precipitation freezing on impact on the ground and on exposed objects.

CodeSignificantWeatherQualifierType-LOW_.comment: In motion due to the action of wind or raised by the wind to a small height above the ground (less than 2 meters).

CodeSignificantWeatherQualifierType-PROX.comment: The weather phenomenon is observed between approximately 8 km and 16 km from the aerodrome reference point.

CodeSignificantWeatherQualifierType-SHAL.comment: Has a very little vertical extent.

CodeSignificantWeatherQualifierType-SHOW.comment: Precipitation, often short-lived and heavy, falling from convective clouds. A shower is characterized by its sudden beginning and ending, and generally by large and rapid changes of intensity.

CodeSignificantWeatherQualifierType-THUN.comment: Sudden electrical discharges manifested by a flash of light (lightning) and a sharp or rumbling sound (thunder). Thunderstorms are associated with convective clouds (Cumulonimbus) and are, more often, accompanied by precipitation in the form of rainshowers or hail, or occasionally snow, snow pellets, or ice pellets.

CodeSlotAllocationStatusType-ALLOCATED.comment: The slot reserved for the flight is allocated.

CodeSlotAllocationStatusType-PRE_ALLOCAT.comment: The slot allocated to the flight has been pre-allocated.

CodeSlotImprovementProposalStatusType-PR.comment: The proposal is pending to be accepted or rejected

CodeSpecialNavigationStationType-GREEN_S.comment: Green slave station of a DECCA chain.

CodeSpecialNavigationStationType-MASTER.comment: Master station of a LORAN or DECCA chain.

CodeSpecialNavigationStationType-PURPLE_.comment: Purple slave station of a DECCA chain.

CodeSpecialNavigationStationType-RED_SLA.comment: Red slave station of a DECCA chain.

CodeSpecialNavigationSystemType-DECCA.comment: Short and medium range (area) navigation system DECCA.

CodeSpecialNavigationSystemType-GNSS.comment: A worldwide position and time determination system that includes one or more satellite constellations, aircraft receivers and system integrity monitoring, augmented as necessary to support the required navigation performance for the intended operation.

CodeSpeedReferenceType-GROUND_SPEED.comment: The speed of an aircraft relative to the surface of the earth.

CodeSpeedReferenceType-INDICATED_AIRSPEE.comment: The uncorrected reading on the airspeed indicator.

CodeSpeedReferenceType-TRUE_AIRSPEED.comment: The speed of the aeroplane relative to undisturbed air.

CodeStandServiceType-INSTRUMENT_DOCKING.comment: Instrument Docking Service available at a Stand

CodeStandServiceType-MARSHAL.comment: Marshal management service available at a stand.

CodeStandServiceType-NOSE_LIFTER.comment: System to push an aircraft backward by rising its nose.

CodeStandServiceType-TRACTOR.comment: System with a bar to push an aircraft backward.

CodeStandServiceType-VISUAL_DOCKING.comment: Docking by means of visual indications on apron or bridge.

CodeStatusAirportType-LIMITED.comment: The facility operates below its nominal parameters, with additional usage restrictions.

CodeStatusAirportType-NORMAL.comment: The facility operates with nominal parameters.

CodeStatusAirspaceType-ACTIVE.comment: The airspace is active (but it might not be in use yet).

CodeStatusAirspaceType-BACK_UP_OR_SPARE.comment: Reserved airspace, in case another airspace is not allocated.

CodeStatusAirspaceType-INTERMITTENT.comment: The Airspace is active but with periods of no real usage.

CodeStatusAirspaceType-IN_USE.comment: The airspace is actually used inside the activation period.

CodeStatusConstructionType-IN_DEMOLITION.comment: Work in progress to remove the item.

CodeStatusNavaidType-CONDITIONAL.comment: Operative subject to published limitations or conditions.

CodeStatusNavaidType-FALSE_INDICATION.comment: Giving false indication, do not use.

CodeStatusNavaidType-FALSE_POSSIBLE.comment: False indication possible, use with caution.

CodeStatusNavaidType-PARTIAL.comment: Operating with limited capabilities. For example, used when just the DME part of a VOR/DME is working.

CodeStatusOperationsType-DOWNGRADED.comment: The system is theoretically able to work at a higher level of service, but it is currently limited to the level described.

CodeSupplyDistributionMethodType-TRUCK.comment: Supplies are brought by truck to the aircraft.

CodeSurfaceCompositionType-BITUMINOUS_MI.comment: Bituminous tar or asphalt and/or oil or bitumen bound, mix-in-place surfaces (often referred to as "earth cement").

CodeSurfaceCompositionType-GRASS.comment: Grass including portions of turf or bare earth.

CodeSurfaceCompositionType-LATERITE.comment: Laterite - a high iron clay formed in tropical areas.

CodeSurfaceCompositionType-MACADAM.comment: A macadam or tarmac surface consisting of water-bound crushed rock.

CodeSurfaceCompositionType-MATS.comment: Landing mat portable system usually made of aluminium.

CodeSurfaceCompositionType-MEMBRANE.comment: A protective laminate usually made of rubber.

CodeSurfacePreparationType-NON_GROOVED.comment: This covers such items as 'APSHALT NON GROOVED' .

CodeSurfaceVehicleIdentificationType-AIR.comment: Vehicle used for aircraft maintenance activities.
Vehicle used for airport maintenance activities.

CodeSurfaceVehicleIdentificationType-ATC.comment: Vehicle used for maintenance activities for ATC equipment.

CodeSurfaceVehicleIdentificationType-BIR.comment: Vehicle used in bird scaring operations.

CodeSurfaceVehicleIdentificationType-BUS.comment: Bus for passenger and crew transport.

CodeSurveillanceCapabilityType-ADS-B_109.comment: ADS-B with dedicated 1090 MHz ADS-B 'out' capability
ADB-B with dedicated 1090 MHz ADS-B 'out' and 'in' capability

CodeSurveillanceCapabilityType-ADS-B_OUT.comment: ADS-B 'out' and 'in' capability using VDL Mode 4

CodeSurveillanceCapabilityType-ADS_B_IN_.comment: ADS-B with dedicated 1090 MHz ADS-B 'in' capability

CodeSurveillanceCapabilityType-MODE_A_AN.comment: Transponder Mode A (4 digits - 4096 codes) and Mode C

CodeSurveillanceCapabilityType-MODE_S.comment: Transponder Mode S, including both pressure-altitude and aircraft identification capability

CodeSurveillanceCapabilityType-MODE_S_ID.comment: Transponder Mode S, including aircraft identification transmission, but no pressure-altitude capability
Transponder Mode S, including aircraft identification transmission, pressure-altitude transmission and enhanced surveillance capability
Transponder Mode S, including aircraft identification transmission, pressure-altitude transmission and extended squitter (ADS-B) capability
Transponder Mode S, including aircraft identification transmission, pressure-altitude transmission, extended squitter (ADS-B) capability and enhanced surveillance capability

CodeSurveillanceCapabilityType-MODE_S_NO.comment: Transponder Mode S without both aircraft identification and pressure-altitude capability
Transponder Mode S, including pressure-altitude transmission, but no aircraft identification capability

CodeTacticalReroutingApplicationType-EXE.comment: Indicates it concerns an execute rerouting. In this case either the FTFM or RTFM are replaced by the rerouting. No proposal flights are created. This rerouting applies to flights in a simulation or flights in status planned (typically all flights on the pre-tactical dataset).

CodeTacticalReroutingApplicationType-FOR.comment: Indicates if proposal flights need to be automatically generated for all successfully rerouted flights and if so, what kind (null means no proposals need to be automatically generated).
Indicates it concerns a rerouting for indication. Optionally proposal flights can be created and the corresponding RRN messages sent.
